jobs.title: Opportunities in R&D Handheld ICE  Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
Help Shape the Future of Professional Outdoor Power Equipment

We're one of the world's oldest start-ups. And we're still innovating. At Husqvarna Group, we combine over 330 years of engineering heritage with a passion for developing innovative products for forestry, landscaping and garden care. From world-leading chainsaws to advanced outdoor power equipment, our products are trusted by professionals and consumers around the globe.

We are now looking for several engineers and technical specialists who want to help develop the next generation of products.

About R&D Handheld ICE

R&D Handheld ICE develops handheld products within Forestry and Landscape & Maintenance Equipment (LME). We work across the entire product lifecycle, from early concepts and new technologies to product improvements and long-term platform development. Together, we create robust, high-performing products used worldwide.

Opportunities

Depending on your background and interests, you may contribute within:

-Mechanical design and product development

-Engine, system and component development

-Electronics, embedded systems and software

-Testing and verification

-Technical leadership and specialist roles

You will work in cross-functional teams, solving complex engineering challenges and influencing products from concept to finished solution.

About You

You are curious, collaborative and driven by solving technical challenges. You enjoy taking responsibility, working in a structured way and contributing to innovative solutions together with others.

We welcome both experienced specialists and engineers earlier in their careers who bring the right technical foundation and eagerness to learn.

We believe you have:

-An engineering degree or equivalent technical background

-Experience or interest in one or more of the areas above

-Good communication skills in English and Swedish

At Husqvarna, you will help develop products trusted by professionals and consumers around the world. Working alongside skilled engineers across multiple disciplines, you will solve real engineering challenges and influence products throughout the entire development lifecycle, from concept to finished solution.

Ready to help shape the future of outdoor power equipment? We would love to hear from you!

Location

This position will be placed in Huskvarna, Sweden.

How we work

We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your Application:

Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill these positions as soon as we have found the right candidates. Please attach your CV and indicate the area or type of role you are primarily interested in. All applications are handled through the application portal to ensure a consistent and correct assessment.

For more information about opportunities within the respective areas, please contact:

    Josef Emme | Power Systems | josef.emme@husqvarnagroup.com
    Mattias Ossiansson | Product R&D Chainsaw | mattias.ossiansson@husqvarnagroup.com
    Marina Karlsson | Product R&D LME | marina.karlsson@husqvarnagroup.com

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Gorjana Dubovina at gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Fokus Meta Ads
jobs.description:
Über uns:

🚀 Globalist ist DIE führende Performance-Marketing-Agentur für nationale wie internationale digitale Marketingstrategien und deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung, made in Stuttgart!

Unsere Agentur ist in Paid Search, Paid Social und Organic Search unterteilt und betreute bereits über 370 Kunden. Wir verwalten jährlich 60 Mio. € Werbebudget und kombinieren Strategie mit operativer Skalierungsexpertise.

Dank direkter Google- und Meta-Schulungen setzen wir auf moderne, datengetriebene Performance-Optimierung. Unser Fokus dabei: Meta- & TikTok- sowie Google Ads, Attribution-Setups und SEO für nachhaltiges Wachstum und maximale Profitabilität.

Zu unseren Kunden gehören Boehringer Ingelheim, La Marzocco, Nø Cosmetics, ASAM BEAUTY und viele mehr!

Was uns unterscheidet: Unser Herz schlägt für den eCommerce. Wir betreuen nicht nur Top-Brands, sondern betreiben auch eigene eCommerce-Shops. Das bedeutet du hast du die einzigartige Chance, dich über das reine Marketing hinaus in Bereichen wie Supply Chain, Product Development und Shop-Systemen weiterzubilden.

Aufgaben

Strategie & Skalierung: Du planst, implementierst und optimierst Paid Social Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok. Dabei verantwortest 5- bis 6-stellige Tagesbudgets und führst unsere Kunden durch High-Peak-Phasen wie Black Friday (mind. 6-stellige Budgets).

Performance-Steigerung: Verantwortungsvolle Steuerung und Skalierung der Budgets unter Berücksichtigung der individuellen Wachstumsziele.

Data & Analytics: Kontinuierliche Analyse der Kampagnendaten, A/B-Testing sowie Insights aus Attributionstools (Triple Whale/GA4)

Creative Direction: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Content-Team zur Erstellung von High-Performance Ads. Du gibst Impulse basierend auf Daten-Insights.

Kundenkommunikation: Du bist strategischer Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden, präsentierst wöchentliche KPI-Reportings und steuerst Projekte eigenverantwortlich von A bis Z.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing (Schwerpunkt eCommerce) mit, idealerweise aus einem Agenturumfeld.
  • Du liebst Zahlen und hast eine akribische, strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Tool-Stack: Du beherrscht den Meta & TikTok Ads Manager und bist sicher im Umgang mit Shopify, GA4 und Attributions-Tools wie Triple Whale.
  • Du hast ein tiefgreifendes E-Commerce-Verständnis über Meta Ads hinaus
  • Du hast den „Drive“, Dinge massiv voranzutreiben, aber die Ruhe und Struktur einer erfahrenen Senior-Kraft. Du denkst unternehmerisch und handelst datenbasiert.
  • Du trittst sicher auf, kannst komplexe Strategien verständlich vermitteln und sprichst fließend Deutsch (C1+).

Benefits

Was wir bieten ❤️

  • Verantwortung & Impact ab Tag 1- kein Mikromanagement. Du hast Budgethoheit und echten Gestaltungsspielraum!
  • Arbeit an spannenden Großprojekten mit hoher Sichtbarkeit
  • Durch unsere eigenen Shops lernst du, wie Marketing die gesamte P&L beeinflusst.
  • Raum für Weiterentwicklung & berufliches Wachstum zum ganzheitlichen E-Commerce-Experten.
  • Deutschlandticket, E-Gym Wellpass, flexible Arbeitszeiten und regelmäßige Teamevents.

✅ Zudem für uns selbstverständlich:

  • MacBook, höhenverstellbare Tische und ein modernes Office im Herzen Stuttgarts mit Dachterrasse.
  • Kurze Wege, flache Hierarchien und ein familiärer Spirit, der Höchstleistung fördert, ohne die Menschlichkeit zu vergessen.
  • Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche, damit du dein volles Potenzial ausschöpfen kannst 🎓

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in epigenetics at the K.G Jebsen Centre of Obesity Research (CORA)
jobs.description:
About the position 

Applications are invited for a 3-year position as postdoctoral researcher in epigenetics and obesity research at the newly established K.G Jebsen Centre of Obesity ReseArch (CORA). The position will be affiliated to Yvonne Böttcher’s research group at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen) at Institute of Clinical Medicine, UiO, physically located at Campus Ahus (Akershus University Hospital).  

The project aims at investigating molecular mechanisms underlying weight regain and long-term weight loss maintenance using advanced molecular biology techniques. In particular, the project will investigate amongst other the concept of epigenetic memory of obesity in humans and closely collaborate with clinical environments involved in treatment of obesity  

The applicant will be involved in tasks related to epigenetic and epitranscriptomic mechanisms potentially being implicated in the regulation of human body weight and adipose tissue biology in general. We are looking for a candidate with extensive hands-on training on a broad spectrum of multiomics analyses in adipose tissue. The applicant will join a team with long-standing experience in translational obesity research whilst other groups in the department Is generally working on translational biomedical research focusing on Alzheimer´s, and cancer research in a precision medicine perspective. 


Project description

Obesity is a growing health problem worldwide. Metabolic surgery or use of GLP-1R analoga are efficient methods to induce significant weight loss in individuals with obesity. However, many individuals struggle to maintain a healthier body weight and often suffer from regain weight after treatment. The newly established K.G. Jebsen Center for obesity research (CORA), lead by Prof. Yvonne Böttcher, aims to understand the biological mechanisms underlying weight regain and obesity relapse, identify individuals at risk, and develop strategies for sustained weight loss and long-term weight maintenance.  

Yvonne Böttcher’ research group (https://functionalgeneticsofobesity.wordpress.com/) is investigating the role of epigenetic mechanisms in obesity, the molecular mechanisms imposed by DNA, RNA and histone modifications and their potential interplay with genetic risk variants. In CORA, the group will specifically focus on the role of epigenetic memory in adipose tissue after weight loss.  

The project aims at investigating mechanisms involved in metabolic memory in human adipose tissue and weight re-gain after weight loss in humans. The candidate will be closely involved in collaborations with excellent clinical environments in Norway and abroad. 

The successful applicant will will work on amongst others on human biomaterial and cell culture models to better understand the potential epigenetic mechanisms responsible for weight regain. The work will include advanced molecular biology techniques such as next generation sequencing and multi-omics technologies as well as potentially single-cell technologies. 

The position will require collaboration both within Norway, and internationally, with clinicians, molecular biologists and bioinformaticians/statisticians in other areas of the centre. The successful candidate is expected to become a driver of the project in close


Your areas of responsibility will be
  • Carry out high-quality scientific research
  • Publish results in high-impact, peer-reviewed scientific journals
  • Apply for research funding 
  • Disseminate research at national and international meetings and conferences 
  • Co-Mentoring of PhD and mentoring of master students 

Qualifications and competence

Qualification requirements:

  • A degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in molecular biology, biomedicine, genetics, or a closely related area. If the degree is not yet formally received, the doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the application date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense are eligible for employment
  • Experience in epigenetics and/or obesity research 
  • Extensive experience in molecular biology laboratory work
  • Hands-on experience in one or more of the following:
    • Single cell sequencing techniques 
    • Omics techniques such as ChIP-seq, CUT & Run; CUT & Tag, ATAC-seq, Whole genome bisulphite sequencing, RNAseq, Nanopore sequencing, ribosome profiling
    • Work with human adipose tissue or primary adipocytes and relevant cell culture models such as 3T3L-1 adipocytes or SGBS cells 
    • Next generation sequencing data analysis 
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
  • Published first author papers in well recognized journals

It is an advantage if you have:

  • Experience working with sensitive data in TSD  
  • Methodologal knowledge in cell sorting 
  • Basic programming skills (R/Python/Unix) 
  • Competence in statistics (R/SPSS/Stata) 

Personal characteristics
  • Team player
  • Self-driven/ independent  
  • Structured and well organized 
  • Good communication and collaboration skills 
  • Positive and enthusiastic 
     

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We can offer you
  • A stimulating environment at a high scientific level at CORA, with possibilities for extensive cross-diciplinary collaborations
  • Excellent laboratory facilities at EpiGen 
  • Career development programs through the Postdoctoral programme (The Medical Faculty, UiO), and through the K.G. Jebsen academy for young scientists 
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 595 00 to 679 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter
  • CV
  • A complete list of publications separating original publications from review articles
  • Transcripts and certificates
  • Contact information for 2-3 references

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

Vi ser etter deg med administrativ kompetanse og gode lederegenskaper. Du er en leder som evner å bygge tillit, skape stabilitet og lede medarbeidere. Her får du bruke hele bredden av din kompetanse, og gjøre en reell forskjell i en viktig del av kommunens tjenestetilbud. 

Barnevernet er en spennende arbeidsplass i et komplekst fagfelt. Vi har som mål å sikre at barn og familier får rett hjelp til rett tid og sørge for god barnevernfaglig kvalitet. Arbeidsmiljøet vårt er preget av gode kollegarelasjoner og ønske om læring og faglig utvikling. Vi legger vekt på å utfordre medarbeidere til å reflektere rundt egen praksis, bruke sine ressurser til å lede sitt eget arbeid og samarbeide godt med barn og unge, deres familie, nettverk, kollegaer og samarbeidspartnere. 

Den interkommunale barneverntjenesten for Kristiansund, Averøy og Gjemnes er organisert som en enhet i Kristiansund kommune. Tjenesten er lokalisert i Frei administrasjonsbygg, i Omsundet på Frei. 

Arbeidsområder
  • delegert lederansvar for personal og økonomi 
  • planlegge, lede og følge opp det administrative arbeidet i barneverntjenesten
  • bistå enhetsleder i forvaltning av budsjett og regnskapsoppfølging
  • forvaltning og oppfølging av leieavtaler og oppdragsavtaler
  • bistå enhetsleder med å utøve kommunens systematisk HMS-arbeid
  • samhandling med interne og eksterne samarbeidspartnere
Kvalifikasjonskrav
  • relevant bachelorgrad innen administrasjon, forvaltning, økonomi eller ledelse
  • relevant videreutdanning innen ledelse eller organisasjonsutvikling, eller forplikte seg til å ta lederutdanning innen kort tid etter tilsetting
  • erfaring fra administrativt arbeid innen offentlig forvaltning
  • gode formidlingsevner i norsk, skriftlig og muntlig
  • gode digitale ferdigheter 
  • godkjent politiattest fremskaffes før arbeidsforholdets start
Ønskelige kvalifikasjoner 
  • mastergrad innen ledelse eller annen relevant mastergrad
Vi søker deg som 
  • har god dialogkompetanse og gode relasjonelle ferdigheter
  • håndterer omstilling, er strukturert og selvstendig
  • har god rolle- og oppgaveforståelse
  • trives med ansvar, variasjon og ledelse i en kompleks organisasjon
Vi tilbyr
  • tett samarbeid med enhetens lederteam
  • et solid og aktivt fagmiljø med kvalitet i fokus
  • en utviklende lederstilling med stor grad av selvstendighet og ansvar
  • dekning av flytteutgifter etter vedtatte retningslinjer
  • Kristiansund kommune har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, inkludert ulykkesforsikring på fritiden.
    Med offentlig tjenestepensjon i KLP får du en av Norges tryggeste pensjonsordninger. Den gir deg økonomisk trygghet livet ut, og sikrer deg en forutsigbar inntekt den dagen du blir pensjonist. Les mer her: KLP
Øvrige vilkår

Tror du at du kan ha fortrinnsrett til stillingen? Du kan lese mer om fortrinnsrett på Kristiansund kommune sine hjemmesider ved å trykke på vedlagt lenke: Søkerveiledning - Kristiansund kommune

Ansettelse skjer etter kommunalt avtaleverk og på de vilkår som framgår av lover, reglement og tariffavtaler.

Kommunen har et ansiennitetsbasert lønnssystem. For alle stillinger teller både offentlig og privat tjeneste etter fylte 18 år - dokumenteres med tjenesteattest fra tidligere arbeidsgivere med informasjon om fra/til-dato, stillingsprosent, eller antall timer arbeidet.

Det tas forbehold om endring av tjenestested, ansvars- og arbeidsområde samt eventuelle tilpasninger i stillingens innhold etter kommunens skiftende behov.

Søknad

Søknad sendes elektronisk via vårt rekrutteringssystem. Søkere som blir innkalt til intervju må ta med attesterte kopier av vitnemål og attester. NB! Når du er i en søknadsprosess anbefaler vi deg å følge med på e-post, inkludert søppelpost.

Kristiansund kommune ønsker mangfold, og vi oppfordrer kandidater som oppfyller kvalifikasjonskravene til å søke stilling hos oss, uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonshemming eller nasjonal/ etnisk bakgrunn.

Kommunen praktiserer meroffentlighet ved tilsettinger. Det innebærer at søkere må begrunne særskilt hvis en søknad ønskes unntatt offentlighet. Begrunnelsen vil bli vurdert i forhold til reglene i Offentlighetsloven, og søkeren vil bli kontaktet. Hvis det etter kommunens vurdering ikke foreligger en særskilt grunn, vil søker komme med på offentlig søkerliste.

Til din informasjon vil søkere til stillinger aldri bli bedt om å oppgi BankID i forbindelse med søknadsprosessen. Med andre ord må du aldri gi fra deg BankID informasjon i forbindelse med jobbsøking.


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Jobb og lev godt i Kristiansund – byen ved havet Ytterst mot storhavet ligger Kristiansund – en sjarmerende kystby med sterk identitet og et levende lokalsamfunn. Bybildet preges av ramsalt historie, moderne næringsliv og et mangfoldig kulturliv. Med 25.000 innbyggere og en kompakt, urban bykjerne, får du det beste fra to verdener – byliv og natur tett på hverandre. Her er det friskere i lufta og varmere mellom folk. Du blir fort en del av fellesskapet, enten du engasjerer deg i idrett, musikk, friluftsliv eller en av de mange festivalene og aktivitetene som preger byen. Kristiansund byr på både hav og fjell, og gir deg alle muligheter for et aktivt og variert liv – hele året. Byen er også i vekst: Campus Kristiansund er nå etablert som en ny møteplass for utdanning, innovasjon og næringsliv – og i løpet av 2025 åpner kulturhuset Normoria, som blir et kraftsenter for kunst og kultur på Nordmøre. I tillegg har vi Kulturfabrikken som byr på forestillinger og konserter gjennom hele året. Og selv om vi ligger ytterst ved kysten, er vi aldri langt unna: Fly tar deg til Oslo på 45 minutter, og hurtigbåten bringer deg til Trondheim på drøyt tre timer. Velkommen til Kristiansund – i medvind uansett vær.

Vi søker etter deg som ønsker å jobbe på et helt spesielt sted og som er opptatt av god service

Vi ser etter en person som er positiv, nøyaktig og effektiv og som ser viktigheten av å yte god service. Du kan gjerne holde på med studier samtidig eller ha arbeid et annet sted, det vil vi tilrettelegge dersom du får klarsignal fra eksisterende arbeidsgiver. Erfaring fra restaurant vil være en fordel, men ingen betingelse da vi søker etter personer med rett innstilling og som er innstilt på å lære.

Av hensyn til alkoholservering må du være over 20 år og du bør kunne kommunisere på norsk, minimum engelsk.

I Unike Hoteller ønsker vi å "gå den ekstra mila" for våre gjester. Du vil få ansvar for gjestebehandling og servering i restauranten og under selskapsarrangement sammen med gode kollegaer.

Dette vil også kunne passe for deg som liker å omgås mennesker og er litt nysgjerrig på restaurantbransjen hvis du ikke allerede har erfaring.

  • Opplæring ved behov.

Du tror nesten ikke dine egne øyne: Bare en halv time med bil fra fergekaien i Moss finner du et konglomerat av flotte bygninger med gartnerier og et av landets mest eksklusive luksushoteller, en førsteklasses restaurant, en økologisk drevet bondegård full av norske truede husdyrraser, en hestestall med hestevogner fra hele verden, og et helt enestående og fantastisk hageanlegg. Pluss huset til Edvard Munch.

Ramme Fjordhotell er vårt kunsthotell med historisk sus. Hotellet består av to bygg med 42 unike værelser, og er nyoppført i 2020.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in bioinformatics at the K.G Jebsen Centre of Obesity Research (CORA)
jobs.description:
About the position

Applications are invited for a 4-year position as postdoctoral researcher in epigenetics and obesity research at the newly established K.G Jebsen Centre of Obesity ReseArch (CORA). The position will be affiliated to Yvonne Böttcher’s research group at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen) at Institute of Clinical Medicine, UiO, physically located at Campus Ahus (Akershus University Hospital). A part of your time shall be available for career-enhancing tasks (up to 25%).  

The project aims at investigating molecular mechanisms underlying weight regain and long-term weight loss maintenance using advanced molecular biology techniques. In particular, the project will investigate amongst other the concept of epigenetic memory of obesity in humans and closely collaborate with clinical environments involved in treatment of obesity.

The applicant will be involved in tasks related to high-end bioinformatics analyses of epigenetic and epitranscriptomic datasetsto be generated in CORA and potentially being implicated in the regulation of human body weight and adipose tissue biology in general. We are looking for a candidate with extensive hands-on training on a broad spectrum of multiomics bioinformatics data analyses and with existing knowledge in adipose tissue The applicant will join a team with long-standing experience in translational obesity research whilst other groups in the department Is generally working on translational biomedical research focusing on Alzheimer´s, and bioinformatics and molecular biology-based cancer research in a precision medicine perspective. 


Project description

Obesity is a growing health problem worldwide. Metabolic surgery or use of GLP-1R analoga are efficient methods to induce significant weight loss in individuals with obesity. However, many individuals struggle to maintain a healthier body weight and often suffer from regain weight after treatment. The newly established K.G. Jebsen Center for obesity research (CORA), lead by Prof. Yvonne Böttcher, aims to understand the biological mechanisms underlying weight regain and obesity relapse, identify individuals at risk, and develop strategies for sustained weight loss and long-term weight maintenance. 

Yvonne Böttcher’ research group (https://functionalgeneticsofobesity.wordpress.com/) is investigating the role of epigenetic and epitranscriptomic mechanisms in obesity, the molecular mechanisms imposed by DNA, RNA and histone modifications and their potential interplay with genetic risk variants. In CORA, the group will specifically focus on the role of epigenetic memory in adipose tissue after weight loss. 

The project aims at investigating mechanisms involved in metabolic memory in human adipose tissue and weight re-gain after weight loss in humans. The candidate will be closely involved in collaborations with molecular biologists and clinical environments in Norway and abroad. The successful applicant will will work on amongst others and not limited to, data set including amongst others, RNA seq, Chip seq, CUT & Tag, CUT & RUN, ribo seq, RNA methylation, DNA methylation and genetic risk markers for obesity originating from both human biomaterial and cell culture models to better understand the potential epigenetic mechanisms responsible for weight regain. The work will involve the analysis of high-throughput sequencing data, including quality control and preprocessing of raw sequencing data, as well as the application of appropriate bioinformatics tools for advanced analyses such as differential gene expression, differential DNA methylation, peak calling, transcription factor (TF) motif discovery, variant calling, and genome annotation and similar.

In particular, we expect the postdoctoral researcher to develop and/or apply computational methods for integrated analysis of multiple types of genomic data, considering diverse genomic features such as gene expression, TF binding, DNA methylation, and genetic mutations.

The position will require collaboration both within Norway, and internationally, with clinicians, molecular biologists and bioinformaticians/statisticians in other areas of the centre. 


Your areas of responsibility will be
  • Carry out high-quality scientific research
  • Publish results in high-impact, peer-reviewed scientific journals
  • Apply for research funding 
  • Disseminate research at national and international meetings and conferences 
  • Co-Mentoring of PhD and mentoring of master students

  • A part of your time shall be available for career-enhancing task (max 25%):

    • Take part in activities of the K.G. Jebsen Academy for young scientists (courses, seminars)
    • Providing training in the use and operation of research infrastructure
    • Assisting other researchers or research groups with various types of research work
    • Norwegian language course, if applicable

     


Qualifications and competence

Qualification requirements:

  • A degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in bioinformatics,or computational biology. However, candidates with relevant backgrounds in other fields, such as statistics, data science, or computer science, will also be considered, particularly those who demonstrate a strong interest in and potential to develop expertise in molecular biology and genome regulation. If the degree is not yet formally received, the doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the application date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense are eligible for employment
  • Experience in extensive data analyses in epigenetics and/or obesity research
  • Hands-on experience in one or more of the following
    • Data anlyses on single cell sequencing techniques
    • Data analyses on data generated by various omics techniques such as ChIP-seq, CUT & Run; CUT & Tag, ATAC-seq, Whole genome bisulphite sequencing, RNAseq, Nanopore sequencing, ribosome profiling
    • Next generation sequencing data analysis in general (manipulation of fastq, BAM, VCF, BED files)   
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
  • Published first author papers in well recognized journals
     

It is an advantage if you have:
We prefer candidates who have the following skills and experience:

  • Proficiency in R, Python, and shell scripting
  • Familiarity with Unix/Linux operating systems. Experience working with the University of Oslo's TSD environment is considered an advantage
  • Containerization (apptainer/singularity, docker)
  • Manage HPC clusters to analyses large data volumes
  • Experience with workflow managers (snakemake, nextflow)
  • Experience with software version control (git)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated experience in large-scale data analysis
  • Documented experience in high-throughput sequencing data analysis and computational genomics, preferably demonstrated through previous research projects, publications, or other relevant work

Personal characteristics
  • Team player
  • Self-driven/ independent 
  • Structured and well organized
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive and enthusiastic

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We can offer you
  • A stimulating environment at a high scientific level at CORA, with possibilities for extensive cross-disciplinary collaborations
  • Excellent scientific environment at EpiGen
  • Career development programs through the Postdoctoral programme (The Medical Faculty, UiO), and through the K.G. Jebsen academy for young scientists
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 595 000 to 679 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter and CV
  • A complete list of publications separating original publications from review articles
  • Transcripts and certificates
  • Contact information for 2-3 references

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

jobs.title: Buchhalter (m/w) – DE & FR
jobs.description:
B&B Logistik ist ein Familienunternehmen, das 1985 von der Familie Braun gegründet wurde. Heute setzen sich mehr als 150 Mitarbeitende täglich mit ihrer Erfahrung und ihrem Engagement für unsere Kunden ein. Als Spezialist für Transport und Logistik bieten wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen im Straßen-, See- und Luftfrachtverkehr. Zu unseren Kunden zählen mittelständische Unternehmen ebenso wie internationale Konzerne aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen, darunter die Automobilindustrie, die Metallindustrie, die Hightech-Branche sowie die Lebensmittel- und Papierindustrie.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Finanzteams am Standort Ulflingen suchen wir einen

Buchhalter (m/w) – DE & FR
Vollzeit – Troisvierges (LU)

Deine Aufgaben:
Als Teil unseres Finanzteams unterstützt du die laufende Buchhaltung unserer Gesellschaften in Belgien und Luxemburg. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit deinen Kollegen zusammen und übernimmst insbesondere folgende Aufgaben:
- Laufende Buchhaltung: Du betreust die laufende Buchhaltung unserer verschiedenen Gesellschaften in Belgien und Luxemburg.
- Eingangsrechnungen: Du erfasst und bearbeitest die Rechnungen unserer Subunternehmer sowie die Rechnungen für allgemeine Betriebskosten.
- Zahlungsverkehr: Du verbuchst und überwachst Kundenzahlungen und unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung und Abwicklung von Lieferantenzahlungen.
- Administrative Meldungen und Anträge: Du bereitest verschiedene Meldungen und Anträge vor, insbesondere zur Rückerstattung der Mehrwertsteuer und der Verbrauchsteuern auf Dieselkraftstoff.
- Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse: Du wirkst bei den monatlichen und jährlichen Abschlussarbeiten mit und unterstützt bei Prüfungen und Audits.
- Zusammenarbeit und Optimierung: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Buchhaltungsteam an spezifischen Aufgabenstellungen zusammen und bringst dich in verschiedene Optimierungsprojekte ein.

Unser Angebot
- Ein familiäres Arbeitsumfeld in einem dynamischen Unternehmen
- Ein überschaubares Buchhaltungsteam, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und gegenseitige Unterstützung großgeschrieben werden
- Vielseitige Aufgaben in der Buchhaltung verschiedener belgischer und luxemburgischer Gesellschaften
- Die Möglichkeit, deine fachlichen Kompetenzen und deinen Verantwortungsbereich schrittweise weiterzuentwickeln

jobs.title: Vi søker montører / We are looking for installers
jobs.description:
Vi søker montører til prosjekt i Oslo!

Vi søker 4 montører til et prosjekt i Oslo. Vi ser etter personer med relevant erfaring innen montasje av aluminium og glass, dører og annet tilsvarende montasjearbeid. Arbeidslag som ønsker å søke sammen er også ønskelig.

Arbeidet består blant annet av:

  • Montering av klemlister og dekklister for glass
  • Montering av dekorbekledning
  • Montering av dører
  • Annet relevant montasjearbeid

Det vil bli gitt opplæring i arbeidsoppgavene, men det er viktig at du har relevant erfaring og kan arbeide selvstendig.

Er dette aktuelt for deg? Send søknad eller ta kontakt på e-post: per@personellgruppen.no

 

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

  • Relevant erfaring fra montasjearbeid
  • Erfaring med aluminium- og glassmontasje er en fordel
  • Erfaring med dørmontasje og annen bygg-/fasademontasje er relevant
  • Evne til å arbeide selvstendig og effektivt
  • Nøyaktig og kvalitetsbevisst
  • God arbeidsmoral og pålitelighet
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og/eller engelsk
  • Erfaring fra arbeid i Norge er en fordel

 

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med hyggelige kolleger
  • Oppdrag med gode muligheter for forlengelse
  • Gode betingelser, forsikringer og pensjonsordning

Søk snarest – kandidater vurderes fortløpende.

jobs.title: Kontaktperson i Barneverntjenesten
jobs.description:
Vi i Barneverntjenesten i Larvik søker en ny kontaktperson i 100 % fast stilling til avdeling oppfølging. Ved internt opprykk kan det også åpne seg mulighet for et vikariat.

Virksomhet barnevern består av barnevernleder, virksomhetsrådgiver, 4 avdelinger og Gyda ressurssenter. De ledige stillingene tilhører avdeling oppfølging som består av avdelingsleder og 10 kontaktpersoner. Avdelingen er delt opp i to lag, hvor ett lag er rettet mot barn 0-12, og ett lag mot ungdom 13-17 samt ettervern 18-25. Lagene har ansvar for gjensidig veiledning, støtte og gjennomføring av tiltakene. Avdelingen overtar saker der det etter undersøkelse er konkludert med tiltak. Avdelingen har ansvar for å iverksette, evaluere og avslutte tiltak. Avdelingen går i fylkesnemnda der det konkluderes med omsorgsovertakelse.

Avdeling oppfølging har fokus på å jobbe målrettet og systematisk, samtidig som vi er opptatt av å være nytenkende og kreative i vårt forsøk på å finne de beste løsningene i samarbeid med familiene og eventuelt familieveiledere. Vi har et sosioøkonomisk og helhetlig perspektiv, og jobber etter modellen med barnets beste i sentrum. Vi har stort fokus på brukermedvirkning og familie- og nettverksarbeid. Vi bruker fagsystemet Modulus, samt at vi er aktive brukere av KI som en støtte til vårt arbeid.

Som nyansatt vil du få tett oppfølging både individuelt og via veiledning i gruppe. Som kontaktperson jobber du mye på egenhånd, selv om vi også har saker hvor flere kontaktpersoner jobber sammen i samme familie. Vi har et godt arbeidsmiljø på avdelingen, med kollegaer som støtter hverandre og gjør hverandre gode. Du må ha førerkort, og virksomheten disponerer tjenestebiler.

Oppstart etter avtale.
Høres dette interessant ut, hører vi gjerne fra deg. 


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Fatte vedtak og utarbeide tiltaksplaner i samarbeid med barn og foreldre
  • Evaluere arbeidet og sørge for at tiltak avsluttes ved måloppnåelse
  • Samarbeide med familien om å etablere kontakt med samarbeidspartnere og annet nettverk som kan bistå, herunder aktivt bruke familieråd og nettverksmøter
  • Sikre barnets medvirkning i barnevernssaken
  • Fortløpende dokumentere all kontakt og alle vurderinger i barnevernssaken
  • Dersom behov for plassering av barn, samarbeide med plasseringsstedet og sikre at foreldre får nødvendig støtte og oppfølging
  • Fremme sak for barneverns- og helsenemnda, dersom behov for det

Listen er ikke uttømmende, og andre oppgaver kan tillegges stillingen.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Du har 3-årig bachelor i barnevern
  • Du må ha erfaring som kontaktperson i barnevernet
  • Du har god skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne
  • Du har god kompetanse på benyttelse av digitale verktøy
  • Det er ønskelig med flerkulturell kompetanse
  • Det er ønskelig med kunnskap knyttet til traumebevisst omsorg
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du jobber selvstendig, strukturert og målrettet
  • Du er ansvarsbevisst og kan ta beslutninger
  • Du er raus og har et anerkjennende blikk på andre
  • Du er god til å kommunisere
  • Du kan stå i krevende prosesser over tid
  • Du spiller på lag, tenker helhetlig og kan samarbeide godt med andre

Vi legger stor vekt på kompetanse, personlig egnethet, erfaring og motivasjon.

Vi tilbyr
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid
  • Gratis parkering og tjenestebiler
  • Gode velferdsordninger, blant annet hytte- og kunstforening, bedriftsidrettslag, tilgang til bedriftshelsetjenester
  • God pensjons- og forsikringsordning i KLP
  • Lønn etter tariff


    Viktig å vite før du starter hos oss
    Som arbeidstaker i kommunen blir du ansatt på de vilkår, rettigheter og plikter som følger avtaler, reglementer og lover.

    Mangfold er en styrke
    Larvik kommune ser mangfold som en styrke. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle som er kvalifiserte til å søke på ledige stillinger hos oss, uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn. Vi tilpasser arbeidsplassen om du har behov for det. Det gjøres oppmerksom på at i forhold til denne spesifikke stillingen må du ha mulighet til å ta deg rundt i hele kommunen og i alle typer boliger.

    Kan bli ført opp på offentlig søkerliste
    Vi gjør oppmerksom på at du som søker kan bli ført opp på offentlig søkerliste, selv om du har bedt om anonymitet. Dette blir du så fall varslet om.

    Vise frem politiattest
    Før du tiltrer må du legge frem politiattest uten merknader som har betydning for arbeidsforholdet.

    Hvordan søke
    Du må sende søknaden din elektronisk innen fristen via Webcruiter, og legge ved attester og vitnemål.

    Hvorfor skal du velge Larvik kommune?
    Som ansatt i Larvik kommune bidrar du til å løse viktige samfunnsoppdrag gjennom verdiene våre nysgjerrig, ærlig, raus og engasjert (NÆRE). Vi har ansvaret for tjenester som er helt sentrale i hverdagen til våre innbyggere. Byutvikling, barnehage, skole, helse, kultur, vann og brann – for å nevne noen. En stor kommune som Larvik tilbyr solide fagmiljøer, fokus på innovasjon og utvikling, og en mangfoldig prosjektportefølje – fra de helt store i hundremillionersklassen til de små og mer hverdagslige.

    En jobb med mening, med mulighet til å utgjøre en forskjell – det får du hos oss!

KontaktinformasjonLinn Kristin Ødegaard-Gjerstad, Avdeliingsleder, 98231655
ArbeidsstedAskeveien 2
3274 Larvik

Referansenr.: 5189168572

Søknadsfrist: 19.10.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Larvik kommune har et areal på 813 km² og over 48.000 innbyggere. Med 3700 ansatte er vi en av de største arbeidsgiverne i Vestfold.

Larvik er en kulturkommune, en havneby og et populært reisemål med fantastisk kystlinje, urbane muligheter og sjarmerende tettsteder. Her er det kort vei til både natur og kultur, nabobyene i Vestfold og Telemark og til den store verden via Torp flyplass.

Larvik har et solid næringsliv og et omfattende tilbud innen kultur, friluftsliv og rekreasjon. Hos oss er mulighetene mange og ambisjonene store. Derfor trenger vi dyktige medarbeidere som vil være med å bygge fremtidens Larvik.

jobs.title: Parfymefri assistent søkes til en aktiv hverdag på gård! 🐎
jobs.employer: MIO BPA AS AVD KONTOR TRONDHEIM
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Oppstart: Så snart som mulig
📌 Stillingstype: Fast heltid/deltid og tilkalling
⏰ Arbeidstid: Dag, kveld og helg

Hei!

Har du sansen for en aktiv og praktisk hverdag, trives godt utendørs og liker å få ting gjort? Da kan dette være en jobb som passer deg.

Jeg er en mamma som bor sammen med barna mine på en gård i Oppdal, og nå ønsker jeg å utvide BPA-teamet mitt med flere gode assistenter. Her går dagene med alt fra vanlige gjøremål hjemme til aktiviteter med barna, hagearbeid, friluftsliv og stell av dyr. Hester er en naturlig del av hverdagen vår, så det er absolutt en fordel om du trives rundt dem.

Jeg har kjemisk miljøintoleranse (KMI), noe som gjør at jeg reagerer kraftig på parfyme og ulike kjemikalier. Det er derfor et absolutt krav at du lever parfymefritt – også utenfor arbeidstid. Dette innebærer at du ikke bruker parfyme eller parfymerte produkter som kan utløse reaksjoner.

En variert og praktisk arbeidshverdag

Som assistent blir du en viktig støtte i både små og store gjøremål. Hva dagen innebærer vil variere etter behov, og du må derfor trives med at ikke alle arbeidsdager ser helt like ut.

Oppgavene kan blant annet være:

  • Husarbeid, klesvask og andre praktiske oppgaver

  • Matlaging og tilrettelegging hjemme

  • Gårdsarbeid og stell av dyr, spesielt hester

  • Følge og bistå på aktiviteter og ærender

  • Oppfølging av barn i skolealder, blant annet kjøring til og fra aktiviteter

  • Praktiske oppgaver ute og inne

Dette er med andre ord en stilling for deg som liker å være i aktivitet, ser hva som trenger å gjøres og ikke er redd for å ta i et tak.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Personlig kjemi og trygghet er viktig for meg. Jeg håper å finne deg som er pålitelig, selvstendig og fleksibel, og som samtidig forstår at du jobber tett på en familie og deres hverdag.

Det er en fordel om du:

  • Trives med fysisk og praktisk arbeid

  • Liker natur, dyr og gjerne har erfaring med hest

  • Tar initiativ og arbeider godt på egen hånd

  • Er stabil, trygg og ansvarsbevisst

  • Forstår betydningen av taushetsplikt og respekt for privatlivet

  • Har førerkort klasse B – BE er en fordel

  • Disponerer egen bil

  • Kan fremvise politiattest

Parfymefrihet er en forutsetning for stillingen. Du må derfor være innstilt på en helt parfymefri hverdag, både på jobb og privat.

Flere muligheter – fra tilkalling til stor fast stilling

Jeg ønsker å bygge et stabilt og godt team rundt meg og familien, og det er behov for flere assistenter. Vi ser blant annet etter:

  • En fast assistent i ca. 80–100 % stilling, med mulighet for tilpasning

  • Assistenter som ønsker mindre deltidsstillinger

  • Tilkallingsvikarer som kan stille opp ved behov

Arbeidstiden vil hovedsakelig være på dagtid, kveldstid og i helger. Skriv gjerne i søknaden hvor mye du ønsker å jobbe og når du vanligvis har mulighet til å stille.

Kanskje dette er jobben for deg?

Hvis du ønsker en annerledes og variert arbeidshverdag hvor du får bruke både praktiske og menneskelige egenskaper, vil jeg gjerne høre fra deg.

Send inn en kort søknad hvor du forteller litt om deg selv, hva du liker å gjøre og hvorfor du tror du vil passe inn hos oss. Vi gjennomfører intervjuer fortløpende og ansetter når vi finner de rette personene.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, kan du kontakte rekrutterer Petter Ariel Skog på petter.skog@mio.no. Søknad sendes via søknadsskjemaet.

Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull jobb med stor variasjon i arbeidsdagen

  • Verdifull erfaring fra BPA og helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: 236,49 kr per time, med tillegg på 67 kr for kveld og 70 kr for helg

  • Grundig opplæring og relevante kurs

  • Oppfølging fra BPA-koordinator

  • Tilgang til fordelsportal med rabatter på blant annet hotell, nettbutikker og hvitevarer

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: PhD position in epigenetics at the K.G Jebsen Centre of Obesity Research (CORA)
jobs.description:
About the position 

Applications are invited for a 3-year position as PhD student in epigenetics and obesity research at the newly established K.G Jebsen Centre of Obesity ReseArch (CORA). The position will be affiliated to Yvonne Böttcher’s research group at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen) at Institute of Clinical Medicine, UiO, physically located at Campus Ahus (Akershus University Hospital).  

The project aims at investigating molecular mechanisms underlying weight regain and long-term weight loss maintenance using advanced molecular biology techniques. In particular, the project will investigate amongst others the concept of epigenetic memory of obesity in humans and closely collaborate with clinical environments involved in treatment of obesity

The applicant will be involved in tasks related to epigenetic and epitranscriptomic mechanisms potentially being implicated in the regulation of human body weight and adipose tissue biology in general. The PhD project aims at investigating molecular mechanisms underlying weight regain and maintenance using advanced molecular biology techniques. 


Project description

Obesity is a growing health problem worldwide. Metabolic surgery or use of GLP-1R analoga are efficient methods to induce significant weight loss in individuals with obesity. However, many individuals struggle to maintain healthier body weight and often suffer from regain weight after treatment. The newly established K.G. Jebsen Center for obesity research (CORA), lead by Prof. Yvonne Böttcher, aims to understand the biological mechanisms underlying weight regain and obesity relapse, identify individuals at risk, and develop strategies for sustained weight loss and long-term weight maintenance. 

Yvonne Böttcher’ s research group (https://functionalgeneticsofobesity.wordpress.com/) is investigating the role of epigenetic mechanisms in obesity, the molecular mechanisms imposed by DNA, RNA and histone modifications and their potential interplay with genetic risk variants. In CORA, the group will also focus, amongst others, on the role of epigenetic memory in adipose tissue after weight loss. 

The project aims at investigating mechanisms involved in metabolic memory in human adipose tissue and weight re-gain after weight loss in humans. The candidate will be closely involved in collaborations with excellent clinical environments in Norway and abroad. The successful applicant will work amongst others on human biomaterial and cell culture models to better understand the potential epigenetic mechanisms involved in long-term weight trajectories. The PhD candidate will be involved in identifying novel epigenetic biomarkers of weight regain using primary adipose tissue derived from ongoing clinical collaborations and advanced molecular biology techniques such as single-cell, next generation sequencing and multi-omics technologies.

The position will require large degree of interdisciplinary collaboration within CORA.


Your areas of responsibility will be
  • Work on scientific projects related epigenetic mechanísms and weight regulation
  • Closely collaborate within the research group, the center and clinical environments important for the center
  • Contribute to th reserarch environments of the research group and the whole center
  • Contribute to and exchange knowledge in the K. G. Jebsen Academy for Young Scientists
  • Be updated on the latest literature in the field
  • Contribute actively to seminars, discussion, presentations, conferences etc.

Qualifications and competence 

Qualification requirements:

  • Master of Science in molecular biology, molecular medicine, genetics, biomedicine or similar with an average grade of B or better at the Master level
  • Hands-on experience in general molecular biology laboratory techniques, such as: RNA/ DNA isolation, protein extraction methods, RT-qPCR, genotyping, western blotting, Immunoprecipitation, adipocyte cell culture
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
  • Ability to independently design, plan, and execute experiments
  • To be admitted to the PhD programmes at the University of Oslo, an applicant must have a five year master's degree or equivalent studies that have been recognised by the faculty as forming a sufficient basis for admission. 
    For more information see: Why choose this PhD programme? - Faculty of Medicine
  • To be employed as a PhD Research Fellow, admission to a doctoral program is required, or there must be a binding agreement for admission. Normally, one must apply for admission to a Ph.D. program within 3 months after the start of the research project leading to the Ph.D. degree. For more information, please see our website: https://www.med.uio.no/english/research/phd/index.html   
     

It is an advantage if you have:

  • Experience in obesity research and/or epigenetics
  • Hands-on experience with methods within epigenetics such as ChIP, Cut & Tag, bisulphite sequencing, ATAC seq, RNA seq or similar
  • Experience with next generation sequencing data analysis and work with sensitive data
  • Basic programming skills (R/Python/Unix)
  • Competence in statistics (R/SPSS/Stata)

Personal characteristics
  • Team player
  • Self-driven/ independent 
  • Structured and well organized
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive, enthusiastic about science

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer / We can offer you / Why should you choose us?
  • A stimulating work environment at a high scientific level at CORA, with possibilities for extensive cross-disciplinary collaborations and career development.
  • Excellent laboratory facilities at EpiGen.
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 to 600 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter
  • CV
  • A complete list of publications
  • Transcripts and certificates
  •  Contact information for 2-3 references

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

jobs.title: Sykepleier i 75 % -100 % fast stilling ved Åslundmarka bokollektiv
jobs.description:

Åslundmarka bokollektiv er en del av Åslundmarka omsorgssenter i Hunndalen. Bokollektivene gir tjenester til mennesker med demens og er tilsammen til 24 beboere fordelt på 4 bokollektiv. Vi søker en engasjert og omsorgsfull sykepleier med interesse for demensomsorg. 

Skriv i søknaden hvor stor stilling du ønsker.

  • Generell god IKT-systemforståelse
  • Evne til nytenkning og forbedring

 Vi kan tilby:

  • En inkluderende arbeidsplass der din innsats har stor betydning
  • 3 dager pr år for egen faglig utvikling
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter og faglig støtte
  • Et positivt og trivelig arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kollegaer

Unntatt offentlighet må begrunnes:

Gjøvik kommune praktiserer meroffentlighet, jfr. offentleglova § 11.

Alle søknader skal sendes elektronisk via vårt søkesystem. 

Vi ønsker et mangfoldig arbeidsmiljø og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke uavhengig av kjønn, etnisk bakgrunn, religion, funksjonsevne, alder og seksuell orientering.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Gjøvik er en fremtidsrettet og mangfoldig servicekommune, en kommune som setter sine innbyggere i sentrum. Våre ansatte leverer kvalitetstjenester, med bakgrunn i god kunnskap og erfaring. Vi arbeider aktivt med kompetanseutvikling for våre ansatte, med visjonen "Kompetanse for framtida - rause, sterke sammen og grønne i vekst". Vi søker engasjerte medarbeidere, med bred kompetanse, som ønsker en inkluderende arbeidsgiver med rom for utvikling. Kommunens verdier: Kompetanse - engasjement - respekt. jobs.title: Teamleiter Recruiting (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die POHL-Gruppe ist ein Familienunternehmen in vierter Generation und besteht aus verschiedenen Spezialunternehmen. Jedes dieser Unternehmen deckt wesentliche Fachbereiche des Energie-, Infrastruktur- und Verkehrswegebaus ab. Ob industrielle Großprojekte, kommunale Vorhaben, gewerbliche Aufträge oder private Energieversorgung.

Als Teamleiter Recruiting (m/w/d) sind Sie der Motor unseres Wachstums. Sie führen unser motiviertes Recruiting-Team fachlich und organisatorisch und schlagen die Brücke zwischen operativer Personalgewinnung und strategischer Unternehmensentwicklung. Sie bewahren die familiäre Kultur unseres Unternehmens und professionalisieren gleichzeitig unsere Prozesse für die Zukunft.

Aufgaben

  • Fachliche Führung & Coaching: Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung des Recruiting-Teams (gewerblich/administrativ Stellenbesetzungen) sowie Förderung einer serviceorientierten Arbeitsweise.
  • Strategische Personalplanung: Ansprechpartner für die Führungskräfte der zugeordneten Unternehmensbereiche von der Bedarfsanalyse hin zur Entwicklung zielgruppenspezifischer Recruiting-Strategien.
  • Prozessoptimierung: Verantwortung für den gesamten Recruiting-Cycle – von der Anzeigenoptimierung bis zum Onboarding. Sie identifizieren Engpässe und führen effiziente Lösungen ein.
  • Personalmarketing & Branding: Weiterentwicklung der Personalmarketing-Maßnahmen und Schärfung unserer Arbeitgebermarke (Employer Branding) in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketing und dem Recruiting Team.
  • Operatives Recruiting: Übernahme von Besetzungsprozessen für zugeordnete Unternehmensbereiche und Schlüsselpositionen sowie Steuerung von Direct-Search-Aktivitäten.
  • Schnittstellenarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Personalleitung, unserer Personalbetreuung, unserem POHL-Campus und Leitungen unserer operativen Einheiten sowie externen Partnern.

Qualifikation

  • Qualifikation: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (BWL, Psychologie, Geisteswissenschaften) oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit fundierter Weiterbildung im Personalwesen.
  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Recruiting (idealerweise im Mix aus gewerblichen und kaufmännischen Profilen aus großen Organisationen) sowie (erste) Führungserfahrung oder die Ambition zum nächsten Karriereschritt.
  • Persönlichkeit: Ein freundliches, verbindliches Auftreten und die Fähigkeit, ein Team durch Humor und Souveränität zu motivieren.
  • Arbeitsweise: Sie arbeiten strukturiert und behalten auch bei hoher Dynamik den Überblick. Sie sind sicher im Umgang mit MS Office und haben eine hohe Affinität zu modernen IT-Anwendungen und Social Media und Social Ads.
  • Kommunikation: Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und eine ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung gegenüber Bewerbern und Fachabteilungen.

Benefits

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in einem sicheren Arbeitsumfeld in einem Familienunternehmen

  • Attraktive Bezahlung inkl. Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld

  • Leistungsbezogene Prämie

  • Moderne Arbeitsausstattung

  • Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten

  • Motiviertes und dynamisches Team

  • Fort- u. Weiterbildungen im POHL-Campus

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Vermögenswirksame Leistungen

  • Mitarbeiter Benefits, die stetig weiterentwickelt werden

  • Hohenwestedt

  • Vollzeit

jobs.title: Waiters and restaurant/kitchen assistants
jobs.description:
Connecting Jobs, run by the non-profit organization Beredskapslyftet, supports newcomers in taking their first steps into the Swedish labour market – while at the same time helping employers access new talent.

Join Connecting Jobs and TENT in Malmö on October 20th for a recruitment event where you will have the opportunity to meet several employers within hospitality in one place.

How does it work?

    This isn’t an open walk-in event — attendance is by invitation only.
    Apply to one or more of the open vacancies below.
    Recruiters will review your CV against that role’s requirements.
    If you’re a good match, you’ll receive an invitation to attend.
    Only candidates who receive an invitation can come to the event — so feel free to apply to as many vacancies as you like to improve your chances.

We are now looking for Waiters and Restaurant/Kitchen assistants for RA Hospitality - the leading staffing company in the Nordic hospitality industry. RA Hospitality have been operating for over 25 years, with offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, and Oslo. They provide staffing, recruitment, and outsourcing services to hotel chains, Michelin-starred restaurants, corporate restaurants, municipalities, conference venues, catering companies, and major arenas.

Location:
Malmö, Lund

Who we are looking for:
Waiters and Restaurant/Kitchen assistants

Responsibilities for Waiters:

    Serving food and drinks at banquets, corporate events, and gala evenings
    Assisting with catering at networking events, private dinners, and parties
    Cleaning during and after events, setting up and packing up after events

Responsibilities for Restaurant/Kitchen assistants:

    Food preparation and basic cooking
    Serving customers and working in the restaurant
    Dishwashing and cleaning
    Preparing for service
    Restocking supplies
    Assisting in the kitchen and restaurant wherever needed

Requirements:

    You have very good command of English language

    You have experience from working as a waiter or as restaurant/kitchen assistant (depending on the role you are applying for)

    You are flexible to work shifts, including evenings and weekends
    Ability to attend interview during the recruitment event in Malmö on October 20th.

Your profile:

    Service-minded and positive
    Responsible and punctual
    Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
    Able to work well with different types of people
    Flexible and quick to adapt to new work environments
    Interested in the restaurant and hospitality industry

What the employer offers:

    Part-time and extra employment opportunities

Important: This position is part of a project that is co-funded by the European Union through the Asylum, Migration and Integration Fund (AMIF). The project aims to support third-country nationals in their integration into the Swedish labor market. The participants hold residence permits in Sweden but do not have Swedish citizenship or EU/EEA citizenship.

jobs.title: Arts Arbeid & Gezondheid
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor UWV een Arts Arbeid & Gezondheid

District Limburg (Heerlen/Roermond/Venlo) & Den Bosch

Wat ga je doen
Als arts arbeid en gezondheid bied je mensen handvatten om te leren omgaan met een diagnose én om weer mee te kunnen doen in de samenleving. Wat betekent de beperking voor het werk van cliënten? En voor hun thuissituatie? Kunnen ze op de oude voet verder of zijn er aanpassingen nodig?
Samen met een team van medische en niet-medische experts bekijk je hoe cliënten hun werk weer kunnen oppakken en weer de regie kunnen nemen over hun eigen leven. Je kijkt niet alleen naar wat er mis is, maar vooral naar wat er mogelijk is. Zodat iedereen mee kan doen in de samenleving.

Wat houdt de functie o.a. in?
- Kennis verbreden en verdiepen
Je krijgt te maken met de hele breedte en diepte van het medische vak. Alle ziektebeelden en prognoses passeren de revue. Je legt een puzzel van medische en werkfactoren, persoonlijke en sociale factoren.
- Voor individu en samenleving
Op basis van jouw anamnese en de regelgeving sociale zekerheid, stel je een advies op en neem je een beslissing. Je doet wat goed is en wat besteding van premiegelden rechtvaardigt. Dankzij jouw expertise kan iemand straks weer verder. Je leert jouw besluit duidelijk te motiveren.
- Kennisontwikkeling arbeid & gezondheid
Je draagt bij aan de medische kennisontwikkeling op het gebied van arbeid en gezondheid. Op eigen initiatief of bij netwerkbijeenkomsten. Er is onder andere een A(N)IOS Netwerk Verzekeringsgeneeskunde.
Als arts bij UWV werk je in een multidisciplinair team met collega-artsen, arbeidsdeskundigen, re-integratiebegeleiders, teamondersteuners, sociaal-medisch verpleegkundigen, medisch secretaresses en procesbegeleiders. Het eerste jaar staat vooral in het teken van kennismaken met én ervaring opdoen van het vak verzekeringsgeneeskunde. Je wordt begeleid door een praktijkopleider en je werkt onder supervisie van een ervaren arts arbeid en gezondheid. Je hebt ruim de tijd voor je cliënten om zo tot een afgewogen oordeel te komen. Je ontwikkelt o.a. je advies- en gespreksvaardigheden. Na de opleiding tot arts arbeid en gezondheid ga je werken met een medisch secretaresse of een sociaal medisch verpleegkundige vanuit de werkvorm taakdelegatie.

Wat we van je verwachten
• Een succesvol afgeronde studie geneeskunde
• Een BIG-registratie
• Betrokkenheid bij cliënten en gedreven in je vak
• Nieuwsgierigheid naar de regelgeving sociale zekerheid.
