jobs.title: Technical Lead - AI Ops
jobs.description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The Role

Brevo is transforming all of its operations to become AI native: We are redefining the way we work internally, the way we consume data (analytical and operational), the way we interact with each other.
From customer support teams to RevOps, from Analytical engineer to finance team, all our jobs will be transformed and we becoming manages of agents. The AI Ops team drives this transformation: it builds and operates AI agents, applications, and the associated tooling, in production. We bring impact at high speed.
We're looking for a Tech Lead to set the technical direction of AI Ops and lead the engineers who build it. You'll own the architecture of our agent platform and raise the bar on how we ship, while staying hands-on in the code.
This is not a research-oriented role: we're looking for a builder with experience making systems work in production.

Why join us ?

  • A rare, AI-native playground: make a profitable scale-up's operations AI-native, with agents in production and visible weekly impact, backed by best-in-class tools (Claude, internal agentic tooling, dedicated observability) and an AI-assisted engineering culture.
  • A fast paced organisation able to redefine itself quicker than any other
  • Real autonomy: define problems with business teams, own solutions through to production.

Your Impact at Brevo:
  • Design, build, and operate AI agents in production.
  • Integrate internal data to build relevant context accurately and in a controlled way (context engineering).
  • Discover needs directly with business teams (CX, RevOps, Data), hand agents over in forward-deployed-engineer mode, and contribute to the architectural vision of the agent platform.
  • Own the architecture of the solutions we build, and make the key technical decisions (multi-agent design, pre-processing, deterministic routing, LLM-as-judge, observability, human in the loop surface of interaction)
  • Own deployment and operations: CI/CD, sandbox/production environments, monitoring, and agent observability.
  • Set engineering standards for code quality, code review, evals, testing, and deployment. Make sure the team follows them.
  • Mentor and grow the engineers on the team

    • Who you are:
    Must-have:
  • Proven tech lead experience: you've set the technical direction for a team, made architecture calls, and mentored engineers.
  • Whole-system thinker: you challenge architecture decisions and weigh the business impact of technical choices.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you turn a fuzzy problem into a shipped solution without a pre-written spec, and help your team do the same.
  • DevOps-fluent: end-to-end deployment, infra-as-code, and debugging network environments (VPN, proxies).
  • Agents & LLMs: hands-on experience shipping agents to production (ADK, LangChain, or similar), including applied prompt engineering and evaluation.
  • You build with AI daily (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) and push the team to do the same.
  • Fluent in French and English.

    • Nice to have:

  • ADK v2 (Google Agent Development Kit) and the A2A protocol.

  • Langfuse or an equivalent LLM observability tool.

  • LLM cost optimization at scale (caching, routing, model selection).


    • Our candidate journey:
  • 30 min call with Talent Acquisition
  • Vision & systems interview with the Chief Data and AI Officer
  • Technical assessment
  • Team meet-and-greet

    • Why people love working at Brevo:
  • A place to grow, together : Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood.
  • Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).
  • Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.
  • Flexible for life : A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.
  • Wellbeing that works : Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and Several services related to prevention, health and personal and professional well-being on Welii platform
  • A culture that cares : From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You’ll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.
    • Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Demande Generation Manager
jobs.description:
About Scality

Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies.
 
Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. 
 
The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F
 
ollow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog.

About the role
Scality is looking for an experienced Demand Generation Campaign Manager to own our global campaign program. You plan, launch, and optimize the campaigns that generate qualified leads and opportunities across our enterprise and mid-market go to market in the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific.
 
This is a hands-on role for a marketer who thinks strategically. You take a pipeline target, decide how to reach it, and run the campaigns that get there. You hold yourself to the numbers: leads and opportunities generated, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and channel efficiency. Most of the work is digital. You also run the campaigns around our webinars, trade shows, and partner programs, from promotion to lead follow up.
 
The main challenge is generating demand in a market that is changing fast. Buyers increasingly get their information from AI tools rather than the channels marketers have relied on, and gated content and volume downloads are losing their effect. This role needs the creativity to build demand where the old playbooks no longer work.

You own the campaign function in an international marketing team. You work closely with the Head of Growth, who runs paid media, SEO, and web, and with marketing operations and nurture. You work with the AMER field marketing manager and the EMEA regional marketing team on campaigns for their events and partner programs, and with product marketing on messaging and assets. You also work with sales, SDR, and partner teams in every region.

What you will be doing
  • Own the global campaign plan and calendar, translating pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid social, paid search, email, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing
  • Take each campaign from brief to launch: audience and targeting, offer, messaging with product marketing, landing pages and forms, promotion, lead routing, and reporting
  • Run campaigns for webinars, trade shows, field events, and partner programs, from promotion before the event to lead follow up after
  • Run the thought leadership and customer webinar program, from topic and speakers to registration, delivery, and follow up
  • Work with the Head of Growth on paid media strategy, spend allocation, and experimentation across LinkedIn, Google, and new channels
  • Build campaigns with marketing operations in HubSpot and Salesforce, and own campaign structure, naming, and attribution in Salesforce
  • Own weekly and monthly lead generation reporting to marketing and executive leadership: leads and opportunities against goal, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and spend by channel and region
  • Align with sales and SDR teams across regions on lead handoff, follow up, and pipeline acceleration
  • Manage campaign budgets and agencies, and prioritize spend against pipeline impact
  • Run experiments across audiences, offers, and channels to improve conversion and lower acquisition cost

    • What you bring to the table
  • Ten years or more of experience in lead generation, demand generation, or digital marketing, running integrated campaigns end to end
  • International experience: you have run campaigns across several regions, ideally including the US, and understand how buyers and channels differ by market
  • Experience in B2B enterprise software, ideally in storage, data management, backup, or adjacent data infrastructure markets
  • A track record of campaigns that produced measurable pipeline, with the numbers to back it up
  • Hands-on experience with paid social and paid search, and with webinar and event campaigns 
  • Strong command of HubSpot and Salesforce and of campaign analytics
  • The ability to shape a plan from a pipeline target while staying hands on in execution
  • The creativity to generate demand where buyers rely on AI over traditional channels and gated content no longer carries the funnel
  • Native or near-native English, written and spoken. You write campaign copy for US and international audiences
  • Comfort working with colleagues across time zones, with regular overlap with the US team in the afternoon

    • Life at Scality
  • We offer careers with an opportunity to bridge international borders, an intensely fun environment with smart people.
  • We encourage promotion and elevation through training and development programs.
  • We care for our employees through company supported programs such as sports and wellness programs, social responsibility programs, and generous benefits packages.
  • We support team building and get together events across all of our locations around the world.
  • Life at Scality is exhilarating. Our internal motto is: work hard, play hard, eat well and amaze the customer!

jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

 

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.  

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. 

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. 

 

 

Vos missions : 

 

Rattaché.e au Responsable Asset Management and O&M, vous aurez pour objectifs d'analyser les performances des centrales éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage et d'en garantir la fiabilité des données. 

 

Vos missions principales seront :  

 

  • Collaborer avec les gestionnaires d’actifs (Asset Managers) pour suivre et analyser les performances des parcs éoliens, photovoltaïques et des systèmes de stockage en exploitation.  
  • Garantir l’intégrité des données collectées, les analyser et les partager afin d’assurer une gestion efficace des tableaux de bord.  
  • Travailler avec les différents départements de Q ENERGY afin d’optimiser la rentabilité de nos projets éoliens, solaires et de stockage ainsi que la performance des centrales.  
  • Mettre en place des tableaux de bord automatisés à destination des parties prenantes.  
  • Administrer les bases de données et exploiter les outils MySQL et Power BI.  
  • Assurer le support dans la gestion quotidienne des données ainsi que dans la création des politiques et autorisations d’accès.  
  • Être responsable de l’historisation SCADA et des plateformes de supervision.  
  • Assurer la supervision des systèmes SCADA et des réseaux, réaliser les diagnostics SCADA, détecter les anomalies et les corriger pendant la phase d’exploitation.  
  • Être le référent technique pour toutes les questions liées au SCADA et à la gestion des installations éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage en exploitation.  
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Développement, Achats et Construction afin d’améliorer les outils de suivi et de partager les bonnes pratiques.  
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue : fiabilité des installations, animation de groupes de travail.  
  • Assurer le suivi des obligations contractuelles du prestataire SCADA en phase d’exploitation. 

 

 

HSE : 

 

Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via :  

 

  • Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides 
  • Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement  
  • Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques 

  

 

 

 

Qualité : 

 

  • Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité  
  • Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité  
  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives 
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs 

Requirements

Votre profil : 

De formation ingénieur généraliste, vous disposez de solides compétences techniques et aimez évoluer dans des environnements à la croisée de plusieurs expertises. 

Vous avez notamment de bonnes connaissances en automatisme, ainsi qu’en informatique et réseaux de communication. Des bases en électricité HT/BT vous permettent également de comprendre les principaux enjeux techniques liés aux installations. 

À l’aise dans les échanges, vous êtes reconnu.e pour vos qualités de communication, votre esprit d’équipe et votre capacité à travailler de manière autonome. Vous savez également prendre des décisions rapidement lorsque la situation l’exige. 

Un bon niveau d’anglais technique est attendu afin de pouvoir évoluer dans un environnement professionnel international. 

Une première expérience dans le secteur des énergies renouvelables serait un véritable atout, mais c’est avant tout votre curiosité, votre autonomie et votre envie de relever des défis techniques qui feront la différence ! 

 

Localisation et déplacements : 

Le poste implique des déplacements réguliers sur les différents sites de l’entreprise à travers la France, représentant environ 25 % du temps de travail. 

Vous êtes donc mobile et appréciez le fait de pouvoir alterner entre travail au bureau et interventions directement sur le terrain.

Benefits

Comment faisons-nous la différence ? 

  • Des valeurs fortes et incarnées   
  • Un management de proximité   
  • Une dynamique d’organisation apprenante   
  • Une entreprise en constant développement  
  • Valorisation et développement des compétences   

 

 

 

Nos avantages sociaux 

  • Flexibilité et bien-être : jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail et flexibilité des horaires 
  • 4 jours de congés par an offerts pour des actions de bénévolat    
  • L’abondement de vos dons aux associations à hauteur de 500€ par an    
  • Forfait mobilité durable pour les déplacements en mobilité douce (vélo...) ou en covoiturage et aides à l’écomobilité  
  • Titres restaurants (10€ pris en charge à hauteur de 5,5€ par la société)   
  • Activités et évènements régulièrement proposés par le CSE   
  • Très bonne couverture mutuelle (famille incluse) et Prévoyance    

 

Nous concourrons à créer un environnement professionnel fondé sur le respect, l'inclusion et la bienveillance, en réunissant des personnes d'horizons différents pour qu'elles nous apportent des idées novatrices et de nouvelles perspectives. 

Convaincu.e.s que la diversité est une richesse, nous veillons à offrir un processus de recrutement accessible et équitable. A compétences égales, toutes les candidatures sont étudiées avec la même attention. Si vous avez besoin d'un aménagement lors du recrutement, n'hésitez pas à nous en faire part, notre référente handicap pourra vous accompagner en toute confidentialité.

jobs.title: Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Work tasks: The Role:
Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

Option to work from home: No

jobs.description:
Work tasks: Automotive and Furniture Upholstery Sewer
(working with genuine leather, faux leather, heavy upholstery fabrics, and Alcantara, and operating heavy-duty industrial machinery). Job Responsibilities ￼ Sewing automotive interior components: Sewing car seat covers, headrests, armrests, door panels, steering wheel covers, headliners, and gear shift/handbrake gaiters. ￼ Creating patterns and templates: Dismantling old covers, assessing wear, and deriving precise new patterns based on them. ￼ Decorative stitching: Executing design stitching (e.g., diamond quilting, double stitching with contrasting thread) and decorative piping. ￼ Adhering to safety requirements: Creating special breakaway safety seams for airbag-equipped seats in accordance with manufacturer standards. ￼ Processing specialized materials: Selecting leather, culling defective pieces, and precision edge thinning (skiving) prior to assembly. ￼ Sewing furniture and cushion covers: Sewing covers for sofas, armchairs, chair seats, headboards, office furniture, and decorative cushions. ￼ Pattern matching and cutting: Precisely positioning and aligning fabric patterns (stripes, checks, large decorative motifs) across different components. ￼ Preparation of edge bindings and piping: Sewing in edge treatments designed to reinforce and decorate furniture edges. ￼ Installation of hardware and fasteners: Sewing on zippers, Velcro strips, buttons, and fastening strips that allow covers to be removed or stretched tight over the frame. ￼ Collaboration with the upholsterer: Checking the fit of covers on the furniture frame and making adjustments if necessary before final stapling. ￼ Material usage planning: Optimizing the layout of fabrics and leathers during cutting to minimize material waste.

We offer: Bee Interior (specializing in exclusive upholstery and interior work for vehicles, watercraft, and furniture) typically offers the following conditions and benefits to its automotive and furniture upholsterers:
Exciting and varied projects: The work is not assembly-line production—every project is unique, ranging from interiors for vintage and luxury cars to motorcycle seats and custom-made furniture. ￼ Competitive pay commensurate with skills ￼ Professional tools and equipment ￼ On-site training and specialization: Support and guidance in executing specific cutting techniques, decorative stitching, and leather preparation. ￼ Stable full-time employment: Long-term job security and a steady workload in a specialized craft sector. ￼ Pleasant work environment: A small, professional, and supportive team that values ​​high-quality craftsmanship.

Option to work from home: No

jobs.title: Senior Server
jobs.description:
Work tasks: - Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages.
- Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Open and close the restaurant in accordance with approved Company procedures and checklists, ensuring that all required opening and closing tasks are properly and fully completed. - Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. - Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. - Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. - Guide, supervise, train, and support servers and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. - Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth restaurant operations. - Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. - Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. - Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. - Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. - Manage and participate in continuous improvement of operations. Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Trustworthy, responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

jobs.title: Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

  • Direction. The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
  • Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
  • Organisation. Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
  • Leaders. Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
  • Quality. Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
  • Product interface. What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.


Your profile

You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention.

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services.
  • 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you.
  • Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage.
  • You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume.
  • Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built.


Why us?

LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification.

This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it.

Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like.

You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market.

We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional.

If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Android/Kotlin
jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Location: You can choose to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, Portugal, or Spain.

➡️ Mission

Join us as an Android Engineer and help us build the mobile experience that 600,000+ European businesses rely on every day to manage their finances. You'll own product-critical features end-to-end — from technical design to rollout — in a large, modular Kotlin codebase where craft and velocity both matter. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and Frontend.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own features end-to-end: You'll take ownership from discovery and technical design through implementation, rollout, and iteration on features that help businesses pay, get paid, and stay in control.
  • Drive technical decisions in your squad: You'll shape solutions with Product, Design, and Backend by clarifying tradeoffs across UX, performance, security, and time-to-market.
  • Raise app reliability and maintainability: You'll improve architecture, performance, and test strategy to scale the app without compromising stability.
  • Tackle complex mobile challenges: You'll contribute to real-time synchronization, resilience patterns, and smooth navigation in a modular codebase with ~1,000 modules.
  • Grow the team's Android craft: You'll lead code reviews and technical discussions, share patterns, and mentor peers to raise the bar on quality and delivery.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Strong Android native experience: You've shipped and maintained production features with Kotlin and are comfortable owning technical decisions end-to-end.
  • Quality-driven mindset: You care about testing (unit, UI, snapshot), clean code, and pragmatic standards that keep teams moving fast.
  • Problem-solving approach: You thrive in ambiguity and turn complex constraints into simple, robust solutions.
  • AI-native workflow: You use AI coding tools daily to amplify your output — not just experiment with them.
  • Collaborative by nature: You're fluent in English and contribute through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • An AI-first engineering environment: Unlimited access to Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot — and a culture that expects you to use them to raise the bar, not just go faster (click here to read our vision statement on AI)
  • Engineering standards that scale: Strong code review culture, continuous refactoring, and a focus on correctness in a regulated context.
  • A technically demanding domain: Fintech constraints — security, compliance, real-time data — push you to solve problems most mobile engineers never encounter.

➡️ Our methodology, the Qonto Way

  • We value upfront technical design, team reviews, and smart slicing — quality drives the velocity our customers need.
  • Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates.
  • Our lean toolbox, Kaizen and PDCA, lets you monitor and drive continuous improvement collaboratively with your peers and manager.

jobs.title: Personlig assistent till 12-årig tjej – vill du göra verklig skillnad?
jobs.description:
Vill du ha ett jobb där du inte bara “går till jobbet” – utan verkligen gör skillnad i någons liv, varje dag?

Vi söker nu en personlig assistent till en 12-årig tjej som bor tillsammans med sin familj. Hon är i en viktig fas i livet där hon blir mer självständig, nyfiken på världen och vill delta i fler aktiviteter – och det är här du kommer in.



Om rollen

Som personlig assistent blir du en viktig del i hennes vardag. Du finns där som stöd, trygghet och möjliggörare – någon som gör det möjligt för henne att göra sådant hon tycker är roligt och utvecklande.

Arbetet sker där hon befinner sig – hemma, på aktiviteter eller utflykter. Vissa dagar är lugna, andra mer aktiva. Det är just variationen som gör jobbet så givande.

Du hjälper till efter skolan, på fritiden och ibland under helger. Tillsammans med familjen skapar ni en fungerande och trygg vardag där hon får möjlighet att utvecklas i sin egen takt.



Vad innebär jobbet?

Du kommer bland annat att:

• Finnas som stöd efter skoldagen och på fritiden

• Följa med på aktiviteter och uppmuntra till delaktighet

• Hjälpa till vid vardagliga situationer som måltider och hygien

• Vara med och skapa struktur, trygghet och glädje i vardagen

Det finns möjlighet att följa med på olika aktiviteter och utflykter, och därför är körkort en stor fördel.



Vem är du?

Vi tror att du:

• Är en trygg och varm person med ett genuint engagemang

• Tycker om att arbeta med barn och ungdomar

• Har tålamod och kan anpassa dig efter situationen

• Är initiativtagande och gärna hittar på aktiviteter

• Trivs i ett nära samarbete med familj

Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – det viktigaste är att du vill, är nyfiken och är rätt person för uppdraget.



Därför ska du söka

Det här är ett arbete där du:

• Får bygga en nära och meningsfull relation

• Är med och påverkar någon annans liv på riktigt

• Får en varierad vardag med både ansvar och glädje

• Blir en viktig del i ett sammanhang där du behövs

Praktisk information

• Arbetstider: Eftermiddag/kväll vardagar samt helg

• Omfattning: Flexibelt, vi kan anpassa och även rekrytera fler personer

• Start: Enligt överenskommelse



Ansökan

Skicka en kort presentation av dig själv.

Vi rekryterar löpande – tveka inte att höra av dig

Join Our Team

We are the Audi Revolut F1® Team.  
   
Audi Revolut F1 Team is the official factory team of Audi, as the brand enters the FIA Formula 1 World Championship for the first time in 2026.   
  
The team is based in three locations: the power unit is developed by Audi Formula Racing GmbH at the Audi Competence Center Motorsport in Neuburg, Germany; the chassis is engineered and race operations are managed from the state-of-the-art facilities of Audi Motorsport AG in Hinwil, Switzerland; while the Audi Motorsport Technology Centre UK in Bicester, United Kingdom, provides a foothold in the heart of 'Motorsport Valley', with direct access to top F1 talent and key strategic partners.

This position for the Audi Revolut F1® Team is based at Audi Motorsport AG in Hinwil (Switzerland).

jobs.title: Security Coordinator
jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION

Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Do you enjoy helping people, keeping things organized and working in a role that combines administration with practical tasks?

Join SSC Space as a Security Coordinator at Esrange Space Center in Kiruna. You will help coordinate visits, guide visitors on site and keep security documentation in order, working closely with our Site Security Officer to ensure visits run smoothly and security routines are followed.

REQUIREMENTS

We are looking for someone who is organized, dependable and service-minded, with sound judgement and a practical approach to work. You are comfortable following established routines, handling confidential information and asking for guidance when something is unclear. A formal security background is not required.

To succeed in this role, you need:

    Experience in administration and confidence using common digital tools to maintain accurate records and documentation.
    The ability to communicate clearly and professionally in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.
    A valid category B driving license for driving within the EEA and a responsible approach to driving.
    The ability to stay calm, prioritize tasks and adapt when plans change.
    The confidence to uphold security routines, including pausing an activity and seeking guidance when requirements are unclear.

Experience in reception, logistics, transport, facility services or security support is an advantage, particularly if you have coordinated visitors, contractors or deliveries. First-aid or defensive-driving training is also welcome.

RESPONSIBILITIES

You will support the day-to-day work of the Security function, combining visitor coordination, administration and practical support.

Working within established instructions and approved access arrangements, you will:

    Prepare and coordinate visits by confirming required information, checking documentation and communicating practical instructions to visitors, contractors and suppliers.
    Support reception and access coordination in line with approved clearances and local security routines.
    Escort visitors within security-sensitive areas, explaining site rules and ensuring movement restrictions are followed.
    Provide safe and professional transport within the site, using authorized vehicles and approved routes.
    Maintain accurate registrations, records, checklists and security documentation.
    Support the Site Security Officer with practical preparations, information gathering and follow-up.
    Promptly report missing documentation, access concerns, incidents or unclear instructions, and contribute to improvements in daily routines.

BENEFITS

We offer you

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.



LOCATION

This is a full-time, permanent position based at our space base Esrange outside of Kiruna.

  

NEXT STEP

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role.



WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

 We help Earth benefit from Space.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

jobs.title: Quantum Information Scientist - Architecture & Performance
jobs.description:
About Quandela:

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. 

Getting there will require several generations of intermediate architectures. Choosing the right ones means understanding what can be built, what these systems can compute and how efficiently they can do so.

About this position:

You will join Quandela’s Quantum Information team within Architecture, working on the evaluation and design of our near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 

Your role will sit between quantum theory, computational capability and real hardware constraints. You will develop methods to evaluate architecture concepts, understand their performance and limitations, and help guide future architecture choices.

Depending on your background, you may draw on complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, benchmarking or related areas. You will work closely with our Device Physics, FTQC and Q.Algorithms Team.

Requirements

What you'll do:

As a Quantum Information Scientist working on Architecture & Performance, you will: 

  • Evaluate and compare the capabilities and limitations of near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 
  • Draw on methods from complexity theory, benchmarking, characterisation and related fields to assess different architecture designs. 
  • Incorporate realistic noise, native operations and physical constraints into your analyses. 
  • Investigate when and how different architectures could provide meaningful computational capabilities or advantages. 
  • Develop scientific models and numerical tools to explore architecture-performance trade-offs. 
  • Study how architecture choices interact with algorithms, resource requirements and QEC strategies. 
  • Progressively propose and lead new research projects around architecture design and performance. 

You will work across our Architecture team and Algorithms and Applications team, connecting questions from the physical layer to computational capability and potential applications. 
-

How you'll grow:

During your first 3–6 months 
Become familiar with Quandela’s technologies, architecture roadmap and ongoing research while contributing to existing evaluation and performance studies. 

Within 1 year 
Take increasing ownership of architecture studies, compare different concepts and bring your own scientific perspective to the team. 

Longer term 
Lead exploratory research projects, propose new architecture directions and contribute to shaping Quandela’s future architecture roadmap.

--

What we're looking for:
We are looking for a scientist with a strong theoretical background in quantum computing, scientific autonomy and an interest in connecting different layers of the quantum-computing stack.

Must-have 

  • PhD in Quantum Information, Quantum Computing, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a closely related field. 
  • Strong expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as quantum complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, performance analysis or quantum algorithms. 
  • Experience connecting theoretical or computational questions with realistic implementation, hardware or experimental constraints. 
  • Ability to assess the capabilities and limitations of quantum systems or architectures. 
  • Experience with scientific modelling, numerical simulation and Python-based scientific computing. 
  • Scientific autonomy and ability to structure open-ended research problems.
  • Collaborative and personable, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly to people from other fields of expertise.
  • Professional English. 

Important, but you can grow here 

  • Quantum Error Correction and early fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Hardware-aware algorithm or architecture design. 
  • Quantum benchmarking and performance metrics. 
  • Noise modelling. 
  • Resource and computational-cost analysis. 
  • Collaboration with experimental or hardware-oriented quantum-computing teams. 

Bonus 

  • Quantum compilation or native-gate-aware circuit design. 
  • Photonic quantum computing. 
  • Resource estimation. 
  • Experience comparing quantum approaches against strong classical baselines. 
  • Previous ownership of collaborative research projects. 

You do not need to cover every topic above. We welcome both candidates with postdoctoral or equivalent industrial R&D experience and strong recent PhDs demonstrating scientific autonomy.

Benefits

Join a growing quantum-computing company and contribute directly to the research behind future generations of quantum architectures. 

  • Explore open scientific questions grounded in real hardware constraints. 
  • Work across Quantum Information, Device Physics, FTQC and Algorithms. 
  • Take ownership of broad and exploratory research projects. 
  • Contribute to the scientific directions of a growing team. 

Plus: 

  • Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and level of responsibility. 
  • Company savings plan.
  • 100% health coverage through Alan. 
  • Transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus. 
  • Swile meal vouchers. 
  • Access to Gymlib. 

Process 

  • Talent Acquisition interview, 30–45 min
  • Interview with Quantum Information hiring manager, 30-45 min
  • Presentation of previous research work and discussion with members of the theory team 
  • Reference checks 
  • Technical discussion based on a scientific paper or research topic
  • Offer 

For the technical exercise, you may be asked to explore scientific material outside your direct area of expertise and discuss how you would connect it to a broader architecture problem.

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

jobs.description:
Deine Mission

Die collana health AG fungiert als digitales Kompetenzzentrum für das schweizerische Gesundheitswesen. Wir begleiten Spitäler, Kliniken und Gesundheitsinstitutionen in allen Phasen der Digitalisierung – von strategischer Beratung über Prozessoptimierung bis zur Implementierung und zum Betrieb von IT-Lösungen. Als Teil der collana Gruppe verbinden wir Branchenexpertise im Gesundheitswesen mit technologischem Know-how.
 
Unsere Mission: Komplexe Herausforderungen im Gesundheitswesen durch smarte, integrierte und nachhaltige digitale Lösungen zu entschärfen. Wir streben danach, Effizienz zu steigern, Prozesse zu harmonisieren und die Qualität der Versorgungsleistung zu verbessern, unter Einhaltung höchster Standards in Datenschutz und Interoperabilität.


Deine Aufgaben

Als Senior Consultant Health bist du eine Schlüsselperson in unserem Beratungsteam und agierst in folgenden Verantwortungsbereichen:

  • Projektleitung und Teilprojektleitung in Digitalisierungs- und IT-Transformationsprojekten im Gesundheitswesen
  • Strategische und operative Beratung von Kunden (Spitäler, Kliniken, Pflegeinstitutionen etc.) entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette
  •  Anforderungsanalyse, Prozessdesign und Konzeption von IT-Lösungen (ERP, Schnittstellen, Systemintegration)
  • Begleitung und Steuerung der Einführung von Standardsoftware, insbesondere im ERP-Umfeld (z. B. Dynamics 365 Business Central)
  • Sicherstellung der technischen und fachlichen Qualität, inkl. Testmanagement, Change- und Betriebsüberführung
  • Verantwortung für Pre-Sales, Angebotsentwicklung und Beteiligung an Akquisitionsaktivitäten
  • Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Fachseite, IT/Architektur, Entwicklung und Betrieb
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsportfolios und Mitwirkung an internen Innovationen
Oder
  • Führung von komplexen Transformationsprogrammen (klassisch oder agil) im Gesundheitswesen
  • Strategieberatung für Kunden – Entwicklung von Digitalisierungsstrategien mit Fokus auf Governance, Interoperabilität, Datenschutz und Effizienz
  • Analyse von Prozessen entlang der Patient Journey, Tarifsystemen, Abrechnungssystemen, Supply Chain im Gesundheitsbereich
  • Konzeption von modularen IT-Lösungen, E-Health-Szenarien, Systemintegrationen und Datenarchitekturen
  • Verantwortung für Pre-Sales, Angebotsentwicklung, Kundenworkshops und Stakeholder-Management
  • Steuerung der Umsetzung: Teil- oder Gesamtprojektleitung, Qualitätssicherung, Änderungsmanagement, Testbegleitung
  • Übergabe in Betrieb / Managed Services, Sicherstellung eines nachhaltigen Handovers
  • Mitwirkung in der Weiterentwicklung des Leistungsportfolios, Einführung neuer Services / Lösungen


Das bringst Du mit

  • Hochschulabschluss (z. B. Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Medizininformatik, Gesundheitsmanagement oder vergleichbar)
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Beratung oder Umsetzung von IT- bzw. Digitalisierungsprojekten, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen
  • Erfahrung in Prozessanalyse, Konzeption und Einführung von ERP-Systemen bzw. modularen IT-Lösungen
  • Vertrautheit mit Schnittstellen, IT-Architekturen und Integrationskonzepten
  • Idealerweise Kenntnisse von Standards und Technologien im Gesundheitswesen (z. B. HL7, FHIR, IHE)
  • Erfahrung in Pre-Sales, Angebotserstellung oder Akquise wünschenswert
  • Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen, pragmatische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Kundenorientierung und überzeugende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
  • Selbstständige und vertrauenswürdige Arbeitsweise mit Verantwortungsübernahme
  • Freude an interdisziplinärer Teamarbeit und Innovationsprojekten
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse (Italienisch und Französisch von Vorteil)


Warum wir?

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum in einem dynamischen, wachsenden Unternehmen
  • Ein professionelles Umfeld mit spannenden Projekten im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen
  • Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Einbindung in strategische Themen
  • Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Zugang zu Innovationen und Austausch im collana IT Netzwerk
  • Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen, Teilzeitmodelle möglich
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit der Option auf hybrides Arbeiten
Rahmenbedingungen:
  • Arbeitspensum: 80-100%
  • Standort: Büro in Bern und Winterthur, Einsätze schweizweit
  • Eintrittstermin: nach Vereinbarung
Wenn dich die Aufgabe reizt, mit uns die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mit digitalen Lösungen mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns über deine vollständigen Unterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse).Für Fragen steht dir deine Recruiterin Julia ----- gerne zur Verfügung.

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

jobs.description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:

? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.

? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Director of Lab Operations
jobs.description:
Single Cell Discoveries is seeking a Lab Operations Director to lead and oversee all laboratory operations at our Gothenburg laboratory, TATAA Biocenter! This is a senior leadership role for a hands-on operational leader who thrives on responsibility, solving complex challenges, and can make confident decisions in a fast-moving environment while maintaining the highest standards of regulatory compliance. You will be responsible for laboratory operations, facility management, and site-wide coordination. You will ensure the site runs smoothly, the infrastructure and processes needed for compliance are in place, and our scientists have everything they need to deliver exceptional results for sponsors around the world.

Are you energized by accountability, motivated by helping teams succeed, and eager to play a key role in a growing, accredited CRO? We would like to hear from you!

Who Are We?

TATAA Biocenter, part of the Single Cell Discoveries Group, is a specialized molecular analysis CRO supporting pharmaceutical and biotech sponsors worldwide. Our laboratory is GCLP-compliant and accredited under GLP and ISO 17025:2017, with deep expertise in qPCR, dPCR, RNA-seq/NGS, and biomarker analysis. We combine scientific excellence with a collaborative and entrepreneurial culture, helping sponsors accelerate innovations in precision medicine.As Lab Operations Director, you will work closely with laboratory teams, quality assurance, IT, business development, vendors, external partners, and company leadership to ensure the smooth and efficient operation of the entire site. You will report directly to the group COO.

What Will You Do?

    Lead and oversee operations of the Gothenburg laboratory site.
    Serve as a key point of escalation for laboratory staff, operational challenges, and project execution issues.
    Ensure laboratory infrastructure, equipment, and facilities are maintained and operate efficiently.
    Coordinate and manage relationships with vendors, service providers, contractors, engineers, and facility partners.
    Support laboratory teams in prioritization, problem-solving, and operational decision-making.
    Drive continuous improvement initiatives across laboratory operations, infrastructure, and processes.
    Partner with scientific and operational teams to support the successful execution of client projects.
    Support capacity planning, resource allocation, and operational growth initiatives.
    Provide strong site leadership, fostering a safe, compliant, and high-performing environment.
    Represent site operations internally and externally, including during client, vendor, and regulatory interactions.
    Have budget responsibility for all operations in our Gothenburg site.
    Design strategies that fit the group’s goals and present progress to our COO and CEO, as well as our board.

Who Are We Looking For?

Essential

    You hold a MSc or PhD in a relevant field, with significant industry experience (preferably within CRO or pharma bioanalytical setting).
    You are an engaging people leader who motivates colleagues through energy, trust, and collaboration.
    You have significant experience managing laboratory operations, preferably within a regulated environment.
    You have experience working within regulated laboratory environments, including GxP frameworks (e.g., GLP, GCLP) and/or accredited quality systems such as ISO 17025.
    You are comfortable taking ownership and making decisions, including under time pressure.
    You have a proven ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously.
    You are a natural problem-solver who enjoys helping others overcome operational challenges.
    You have experience working with external vendors, contractors, facility providers, and technical service partners.
    You possess excellent organizational and communication skills in English, both written and oral.

Preferred

    Experience acting as Test Site Manager, Deputy Test Site Manager, or in a similar regulated laboratory leadership role.
    Experience supporting inspections, audits, and accreditation activities.
    Experience in a CRO, biotech, pharmaceutical, or life sciences environment
    Experience presenting operational matters to senior leadership, company owners, or a board of directors.

Who You Are

    You enjoy responsibility and proactivity.
    You like making things happen.
    You are approachable, and people naturally come to you with questions and challenges.
    You can switch effortlessly between discussions with scientists, engineers, vendors, and leadership teams.
    You bring energy, pragmatism, and common sense.
    You are decisive, confident, and action oriented.
    Quality and accountability come naturally to you.

Why Join TATAA?

    A highly visible leadership role with significant influence on the future of the organization.
    Ownership of laboratory operations within a growing and internationally recognized CRO.
    The opportunity to work with talented scientists in a collaborative and entrepreneurial environment.
    A role where your decisions directly impact employees, sponsors, and business success.
    The chance to help shape the future of precision medicine and advanced molecular analysis.

Join us in accelerating innovations in precision medicine.  

Need more info? For questions about this opening or the recruitment process, please contact us at jobs@tataa.com.

Visit us at https://tataa.com/.

jobs.title: Country Medical Director 20%/ Medical Director 60% Järfälla
jobs.description:
PURPOSE OF THIS POSITION:

This is an 80% combined medical leadership and clinical role, allocated as 20% Country Medical Director and 60% Medical Director. The role provides country-level medical governance, quality oversight and regulatory assurance while retaining primary responsibility for direct nephrology and dialysis care, treatment decisions, patient follow-up and clinical delivery at clinic level.



KEY RESULT AREA AND RESPONSIBILITES:

Country Medical Director — 20% of the role

·        Provide country-level medical leadership and advise the Country Managing Director on medical quality, patient outcomes, clinical risk and regulatory matters.

·        Ensure national implementation of and compliance with Diaverum clinical policies, procedures and guidelines, together with applicable Swedish legal and regulatory requirements.

·        Review medical staff credentials and oversee medical practice to confirm that physicians are appropriately licensed, competent and authorized to work in dialysis services.

·        Ensure adequate physician coverage and medical continuity in accordance with regulatory and operational requirements.

·        Review country and clinic quality information, including patient outcomes, mortality, infection control, medical records, water quality, preventive maintenance and medical-equipment maintenance.

·        Serve as a member of the country management and quality-assurance forums as required, and lead follow-up of agreed medical improvement actions.

·        Act as the senior medical liaison with hospitals, healthcare providers and relevant external stakeholders regarding services delivered to Diaverum patients.

·        Escalate significant medical, clinical or operational risks and drive corrective actions and improvements across the country organization.

Medical Director — 60% of the role

·        The Medical Director is the head of the production of hemofiltration fluids within the dialysis department.He or she is ensuring that the production in the department is medically appropriate. Another task is to ensure the patients’ clinical and medical quality performance.

·        Maintain the licenses, authorizations and liability documentation required to practice medicine and fulfil Diaverum´s  internal medical requirements.

·        Lead the clinic's medical work and ensure safe, evidence-based and high-quality nephrology and dialysis care.



·        Take responsibility for diagnostic and therapeutic decisions for assigned patients, including dialysis prescription, dialysis-related conditions, vascular access, underlying kidney disease and treatment modality selection.

·        Provide individual physician consultations at least weekly, assess treatment progress at least monthly, and complete multidisciplinary treatment reviews at least every six months or more frequently when clinically required.

·        Manage referrals and medical communication with hospitals, specialist services and ambulatory care providers, including transplantation work-up and pre- and post-transplant dialysis.

·        Participate in therapeutic conferences and multidisciplinary activities covering vascular access, nutrition, social support, patient and family education and staff education.

·        Ensure timely, complete and accurate medical records and quality data, including required QI, QMR, HMR and quarterly reporting.

·        Ensure compliance with GDPR, public-health and epidemiological requirements, and implement measures to prevent infection and reduce hepatitis morbidity.

·        Oversee the medical suitability of hemofiltration-fluid production and the quality of water used for dialysis, including monitoring of cultures, endotoxins, disinfection, water-quality results and pyrogenic reactions.

·        Participate in clinic and country meetings as needed and contribute to internal medical education.

Allocation and coordination

The position totals 80% of full-time employment. The 20% Country Medical Director allocation is reserved for national medical governance and oversight; the 60% Medical Director allocation is reserved for clinic-level medical leadership and patient care. Priorities are coordinated with the Country Managing Director to protect both allocations and ensure continuity of care.



QUALIFICATIONS:

Education

University degree in Medical School

Experience

At least 10 years experience in renal services

Languages

jobs.title: Junior konsult till Financial Accounting Advisory Services | Stockholm
jobs.description:
Are your ready to shape your future with confidence?



Företag utvecklar ständigt sin verksamhet genom att lansera nya produkter, säkra ny finansiering, genomföra fusioner och utföra börsintroduktioner. Det är avgörande för företagsledningen att dessa strategiska initiativ presenteras i de finansiella rapporterna på ett sätt som återspeglar den affärsmässiga avsikten.



Vårt Financial Accounting Advisory team arbetar med högkvalitativ rådgivning genom att kombinera strategisk expertis med spetskompetens inom IFRS och kapitalmarknaden. Med vår rådgivning kan företag spegla deras strategiska beslut i de finansiella rapporterna.



Som junior konsult inom Financial Accounting Advisory Services, FAAS, får du arbeta i varierande kunduppdrag tillsammans med erfarna kollegor och specialister. Vi söker dig som är nyutexaminerad inom ekonomi och som vill påbörja din karriär hos oss i augusti 2027.



Möjligheten: ditt nästa äventyr väntar på dig



Som konsult får du tidigt arbeta nära kunder, ta ansvar i projekt och utveckla en bred förståelse för finansiell rapportering och verksamhetsstyrning. Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer exempelvis omfatta följande:

    Delta i projektteam vid IPO-förberedelser, inklusive koordinering och budgetuppföljning  

    Genomföra gapanalyser för företag inför börsnotering (IPO Readiness)  

    Kartlägga och förbättra finansiella processer för ökad effektivitet och stärkt intern kontroll  

    Byte av redovisningsregelverk från Swedish GAAP till IFRS  

    Rådgivning hur våra kunders transaktioner bäst bör redovisas, såsom nya intäktsströmmar, immateriella tillgångar, företagsförvärv och fusioner, nedskrivning m.m.

    Analys och rekommendation kring utformning av finansiella rapporter

    Transaktionsrelaterade frågeställningar inom finansiell rapportering





Vad vi söker



Kvalifikationer

    Universitets-/högskoleexamen inom ekonomi, företrädesvis med inriktning mot externredovisning eller finans

    Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga i både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift

    Analytisk och lösningsorienterad med ett skarpt kritiskt tänkande

    Ett intresse för att arbeta i och driva projekt  
    Förmågan att bygga förtroenden och relationer samt uppskattar att arbeta i team  

    Proaktiv inställning, är nyfiken och har förmågan att driva dig själv framåt

    Mycket goda kunskaper i Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint och Word)

Meriterande

    Masterexamen

    Goda akademiska meriter, relevant arbetslivserfarenhet, utlandsstudier och/eller engagemang utanför studierna

    Erfarenhet av att tillämpa AI för att skapa affärsnytta och effektivisera processer

Vad EY erbjuder dig



    Kontinuerligt lärande: Du utvecklar tankesätt och färdigheter som hjälper dig att navigera in i framtiden.

    Framgång så som du definierar den: Vi ger dig verktygen och flexibiliteten, så att du kan göra skillnad på ditt sätt.

    Transformativt ledarskap: Vi ger dig insikter, coachning och självförtroende för att bli den ledare som världen behöver.

    Inkluderande kultur: Du kommer att accepteras för den du är och få möjlighet att använda din röst för att hjälpa andra att hitta sin.





Är du redo att ”Shape your future with confidence”? Ansök idag.



Skicka in din ansökan innehållande CV, personligt brev och betyg senast den 18 oktober. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vid frågor om tjänsten kontaktar du Stina Holmgren på stina.holmgren@se.ey.com.

Vi finns här för att stötta dig.
