EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Senior System Administrator
jobs.description:
About Univrses

Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. While our roots are in the automotive sector, we have pioneered a new category: Infrastructure Intelligence. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.

The Role

As a Senior Sysadmin at Univrses, you will be the backbone of our technical operations, ensuring that our entire engineering organization has the stable, secure, and scalable infrastructure it needs to thrive.

In this role, you will work closely with the CTO to design and maintain a company-wide infrastructure that is both resilient and secure. You will oversee the cross-functional systems that support all our research, development, and production environments. We are looking for a proactive professional to manage our cloud footprint and on-premise resources, ensuring our team of world-class engineers can work without friction.

This is a on-site position since you will be responsible of our on premise infrastructure.

Responsibilities

    

Strategic Infrastructure Support: implement long-term infrastructure roadmaps that prioritize company-wide stability and data security.

    

Core Systems Oversight: Design, deploy, and maintain robust server environments (both AWS and on-premise) that support multiple project teams.

    

System Reliability & Uptime: Proactively monitor system health and performance across the organization to ensure high availability for all internal and external services.

    

Resource Governance: Manage global resource allocation (databases, storage, compute).

    

Security & Access Control: Implement and enforce company-wide security.

    

Disaster Recovery: Develop and maintain rigorous backup strategies and recovery procedures to protect company data and intellectual property.

Who you are

    

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

    

Experience: 5+ years of experience in Systems Administration, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.

    

Maintenance Pro: Proven track record in patch management, software distribution, and maintaining system integrity across a fleet of machines.

    

Linux Expertise: Deep proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).

    

Networking Specialist: Strong understanding of networking architecture.

    

Cloud & Containers: Proven experience managing AWS environments and containerized applications using Docker.

    

Reliability Mindset: A "security-first" and "stability-first" approach to managing infrastructure, with the communication skills to report directly to technical leadership.

    

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Familiarity with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.

    

Monitoring Stacks: Experience setting up company-wide monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK.

    

Storage Solutions: Experience managing large-scale data storage (S3, NAS, Artifactory).

What’s in it for You?

We provide the environment and the tools for you to do the best work of your career.

    

Responsibility: Become a true stakeholder in a small team where your work actually matters.

    

Professional Evolution: You will be working on exciting projects involving game-changing technology with an opportunity to improve the world through autonomy and intelligence

    

The "Work-Life" Blend: Enjoy flexible work hours and a culture that values output over "desk time".

    

Upsides: A secure Pension Plan and Wellness activities for up to 5 000 SEK per year paid by the company.

    

The Univrses Culture:

    

Monday Momentum: Kick off the week with team breakfast.

    

Thursday Knowledge: Weekly Lunch & Learns where internal or external speakers present interesting topics, while the company pays for and caters the lunch to keep your technical and commercial skills sharp.

    

Friday Wind-down: Celebrate the week’s wins with our Friday After Work sessions (free beer from our well-curated beer fridge!)

    

The Workspace: A bright, collaborative office in Stockholm equipped with the essentials (yes, including the mandatory startup ping-pong table).

Next Steps

If you are a systems-oriented thinker who enjoys building stable environments and working at a strategic level to support a high-performing engineering culture, please submit your resume and a cover letter in English!

jobs.title: Group Portfolio Controller
jobs.description:
At TRATON Group, we believe that the whole can be greater than the sum of its parts. Together with our brands we can make the future of transportation more sustainable - Let´s make a difference together.



The TRATON AB office, located in Södertälje, consists of experienced colleagues with various backgrounds and nationalities from all TRATON Group brands. We enjoy solving strategic problems cross functional and cross brand in the TRATON Group. We strive for a climate where opinions and knowledge are openly shared within and between teams and we welcome new ideas in order to create dynamic synergies.



With its brands Scania, MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus and International, TRATON Group is one of the world’s leading commercial vehicle manufacturers. Its offering comprises light-duty commercial vehicles, trucks, and buses. At TRATON, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Being bigger also means being stronger. Together with our brands, we have the collective power to transform transportation. Find out more: www.traton.com

Role Summary

Group Portfolio Controlling serves as a key link between Group Product Planning, Commercial Solutions and Finance across TRATON and its brands. We provide a Group-wide financial perspective on product portfolio and commercial decisions, translating complex financial and market data into actionable business insights.

Our team supports strategic portfolio decisions, product and market prioritization, pricing and brand positioning, and the allocation of resources across the Group. Through fact-based financial assessments and close cross-functional collaboration, we contribute to maximizing Group value while balancing profitability, strategic objectives and business risks.

Job Responsibilities

As a Group Portfolio Controller, you will act as a financial business partner to Group Product Planning and Commercial Solutions and contribute to strategic portfolio and commercial decision-making across TRATON and its brands.

    Develop and align Group-wide profitability analyses across product segments, brands and relevant markets, creating transparency on financial performance and value potential.
    Assess product roadmaps and commercial plans from a financial perspective, identifying profitability gaps, white spots, risks and value opportunities based on relevant financial KPIs.
    Support regional and country sales strategies with fact-based financial insights, profitability assessments and a holistic Group perspective.
    Conduct financial trade-off and scenario analyses across product and development alternatives to support prioritization and resource allocation decisions.
    Support the development of Group-wide approaches for brand differentiation and price positioning, linking customer value, competitive positioning, pricing and profitability.
    Translate complex financial, product and market data into actionable insights and management recommendations, enabling fact-based portfolio decisions.
    

Collaborate closely with Group Product Planning, Commercial Solutions, Strategy, the TRATON brands and other Finance functions to align assumptions and drive a consistent Group perspective.

Who You Are



    Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in portfolio management, finance/controlling, product management, commercial management or strategic planning.
    Strong understanding of product and commercial economics, with the ability to assess profitability, pricing, business cases and financial trade-offs.
    Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to translate complex financial, product and market data into actionable business insights and management recommendations.
    Proven ability to work and collaborate effectively in a cross-functional and cross-brand environment, challenge assumptions and align different stakeholder perspectives towards Group objectives.
    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to convey complex financial topics clearly and confidently across different management levels.
    Proven knowledge of the truck / automotive industry or any of our brands is a strong merit.
    Proactive and structured working style with a high degree of ownership, including the ability to represent the department's interests and perspectives across the organization.



Besides offering a challenging and international environment, you'll be joining a diverse team that also enjoys spending time together and having fun outside of work.

This Is Us

You will join a highly collaborative team within Group Finance at TRATON, working closely with Group Product Planning and Commercial Solutions Planning. We act as strategic finance partners, supporting portfolio-related decisions that shape the future direction of the business. Our work goes beyond traditional controlling, combining financial insight, business understanding, and strategic thinking to drive value creation. In this role, you will collaborate with stakeholders across multiple functions and contribute to key discussions influencing the Group’s product and portfolio strategy.

TRATON AB Offers

We offer a dynamic, flexible workplace with hybrid work options, including Scania Sergel and Midway hubs. With a structured development plan and courses, TRATON supports your career growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include training at our health center Gröndal or wellness allowance, bonus, flexible hours, and company car leasing. The group also hosts events for employees and their families, and Stockholm residents.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-02. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:

Yunus Birgin, Head of Portfolio Controlling & Holding Controlling: yunus.birgin@se.traton.com

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Site Manager, Sweden-based projects, Nordec
jobs.description:
Nordec is one of the leading providers of steel structures and façade solutions in Northern Europe. We design, manufacture and install steel structures for demanding construction projects, ranging from industrial facilities and logistics centres to large-scale data centres and other landmark developments.

Barona is recruiting Site Managers on behalf of Nordec. The selected candidates will be employed directly by Nordec in a permanent position.

As Nordec continues to strengthen its presence in Sweden and across Northern Europe, we are looking for experienced Site Managers to lead installation works on demanding construction projects.

This is an opportunity for an experienced site professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with people leadership, customer collaboration and hands-on project execution. In this role, you will be at the heart of project delivery, ensuring that installation activities are completed safely, efficiently and according to agreed quality and schedule targets.

As a Site Manager, you will act as one of Nordec's key representatives on site. You will lead installation teams and subcontractors, coordinate daily site operations and work closely with customers, project management and other stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Key responsibilities include:

    Leading and coordinating on-site installation activities

    Managing site teams and subcontractors

    Ensuring quality, safety, schedule, cost control and productivity targets are achieved

    Acting as the main on-site contact towards customers and stakeholders

    Monitoring project progress and reporting to the Project Manager

    Resolving operational challenges and supporting efficient project execution

The role requires sound technical understanding, strong leadership capabilities and the ability to maintain productive relationships with customers, partners and site personnel in a dynamic project environment.

What we are looking for

We are interested in professionals who have gained substantial experience in site management, construction management or related leadership roles within construction and industrial projects.

To succeed in the role, you have:

    Several years of experience in site management, project management or a comparable leadership position

    Proven ability to lead teams and coordinate multiple stakeholders in demanding project environments

    Strong understanding of construction processes, site operations and safety requirements

    Experience from large industrial projects, data centres or other technically demanding construction projects is considered an advantage

    Experience of cost control and budgeting

    Fluent English language skills, Swedish is considered an advantage

    A structured, proactive and solution-oriented way of working

    Willingness to travel according to project requirements

Why join Nordec?

Nordec offers the opportunity to work on some of the most technically demanding construction projects in Northern Europe. The company is involved in projects that combine engineering expertise, high-quality execution and international collaboration.

As a Site Manager, you will have a central role in project delivery and significant responsibility for driving successful outcomes on site. You will work alongside experienced professionals in an international environment where expertise, collaboration and practical problem-solving are highly valued.

The role offers long-term career opportunities within a growing organisation operating across several European markets and project sectors.

Applications will be reviewed during the recruitment process, and positions will be filled once suitable candidates have been identified.

This recruitment is conducted in cooperation with Barona. For further information regarding the position and the recruitment process, please contact Johnny Seijsing at Barona Sweden. jobs.title: Business Controller – bli med og bygg økonomifunksjonen i Podtown
jobs.description:
Business Controller – bli med og bygg økonomifunksjonen i Podtown

Vil du jobbe tett på ledelsen, internasjonale prosjekter og beslutningene som faktisk betyr noe?

Podtown er i sterk utvikling og bygger nå organisasjonen for neste fase. Vi utvikler og leverer modulære rom- og infrastrukturløsninger til krevende markeder som forsvar og beredskap. Nå søker vi en Business Controller som vil få en sentral rolle i selskapet – tett på ledelsen, prosjektene og den operative virksomheten.

Dette er ikke en tradisjonell controllerrolle hvor hovedoppgaven er å rapportere på det som allerede har skjedd. Vi ser etter deg som vil forstå hva som skjer i virksomheten, se fremover og bidra til bedre beslutninger.

Regnskapet håndteres i stor grad eksternt. Din viktigste jobb blir derfor å sørge for at Podtown har kontroll på prosjektøkonomi, likviditet, prognoser, marginer og økonomiske beslutningsgrunnlag. Rollen skal være Podtowns interne økonomiske kontrollpunkt og en viktig sparringspartner for ledelsen.

En rolle med reell påvirkning

Podtown har en liten og kompetent organisasjon og arbeider med komplekse leveranser mot internasjonale kunder. Selskapet har etablert seg i forsvarsmarkedet og står foran en fase hvor både prosjektene og organisasjonen skal skaleres.

Som Business Controller får du en bred rolle. Du vil blant annet:

  • etablere og følge opp prosjektbudsjetter, faktiske kostnader, committed cost, forecast, inntekter og marginer

  • bygge og følge opp rullerende likviditets- og cash flow-prognoser

  • analysere avvik og bidra til at tiltak blir satt inn tidlig

  • etablere en enkel og robust struktur for månedsrapportering, periodiseringer og avsetninger

  • arbeide tett med prosjektansvarlige, leverandører og produksjonspartnere for å forstå kostnadsdrivere, kapasitet og risiko

  • utarbeide økonomiske beslutningsgrunnlag og rapportering til CEO, styre og eiere

  • støtte selskapet i dialog med bank, revisor, regnskapsfører og øvrige rådgivere

  • bidra i finansierings-, garanti-, forsikrings- og kapitalprosesser

  • bygge Podtowns egne økonomiske arbeidsprosesser og systemer etter hvert som virksomheten vokser.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du har noen års erfaring fra controlling, prosjektøkonomi eller økonomistyring og nå ønsker deg nærmere både virksomheten og beslutningene.

Du kan for eksempel arbeide som Business Controller, Project Controller, prosjektøkonom eller Financial Controller i dag. Erfaring fra prosjektbasert virksomhet, industri, maritim sektor, energi eller tilsvarende vil være relevant, men er ikke et absolutt krav.

Vi ser særlig etter deg som har:

  • høyere utdanning innen økonomi, finans eller regnskap

  • gjerne rundt 3–7 års relevant erfaring

  • god forståelse for regnskap og økonomiske sammenhenger

  • interesse for prosjektøkonomi, likviditet, prognoser og business partnering

  • gode ferdigheter i Excel og god systemforståelse

  • evne til å gjøre økonomiske problemstillinger forståelige og beslutningsrelevante.

Like viktig er hvordan du jobber.

Du trives i et miljø med tempo, korte beslutningsveier og tydelige forventninger. Du er selvstendig nok til å drive egne områder fremover, men samtidig trygg nok til å diskutere, utfordre og sparre med ledelsen når tallene tilsier det.

Du trenger ikke være den som alltid har det mest kompliserte regnearket. Viktigere er det at du forstår hva tallene betyr, ser hva som krever handling og klarer å gjøre økonomiske problemstillinger konkrete og beslutningsrelevante.

Vi tror du vil lykkes godt i rollen dersom du:

  • tar eierskap og følger opp til ting faktisk er ferdige

  • arbeider strukturert og trives med ansvar

  • er analytisk, men også pragmatisk og løsningsorientert

  • kommuniserer tydelig på både norsk og engelsk, og tør å stå for egne faglige vurderinger

    bygger gode relasjoner og samarbeider godt på tvers

  • trives med frihet innen tydelige rammer

Hvorfor Podtown?

Dette er en sjelden mulighet til å komme inn på et tidspunkt hvor du faktisk kan være med og forme hvordan økonomifunksjonen skal fungere.

Du får:

  • stor påvirkning og kort vei fra analyse til beslutning

  • tett samarbeid med CEO, COO og selskapets ledelse

  • ansvar for økonomien i komplekse og internasjonale prosjekter

  • innsikt i et spennende marked med krevende kunder og leveranser

  • mulighet til å bygge systemer, arbeidsprosesser og rapportering – ikke bare overta dem

  • en rolle som kan utvikle seg mot et bredere økonomiansvar etter hvert som Podtown vokser.

Du vil få betydelig ansvar og handlingsrom, samtidig som det forventes fremdrift, kvalitet og selvstendighet i rollen.

Podtown passer særlig godt for deg som ønsker mer ansvar og større påvirkning enn du typisk får som én av mange controllere i et større konsern.

Arbeidssted

Grieg Gaarden, Bergen
Stillingen er 100 % og rapporterer til CEO.

jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

Design isn’t just what we do—it’s who we are. At & Other Stories, you’ll create collections that set trends and tell stories. From first sketch to final garment, your vision will shape the future of fashion and inspire a global audience.

As a Product Designer in Knitwear, you will transform creative concepts into outstanding products that align with our brand identity and meet customer expectations. You’ll combine design expertise with technical knowledge to deliver collections that are both innovative and commercially relevant.

Your Responsibilities:

What you will do…

    Design and develop products for seasonal collections, ensuring alignment with brand DNA and creative vision
    Translate trends into key silhouettes, fabrics, colours, and details
    Identify yarns, colours, silhouettes and details that are in line with set seasonal trend and design direction. Plan a coordinated assortment with focus on new, relevant and commercial products
    Participate in fittings and ensure garments meet our high standards of silhouette and design with the right timing, following up closely throughout the development process
    Conduct ongoing research and analysis of fashion trends, customer behaviour, and market movements
    Take ownership of timelines and drive the design process forward with initiative and creativity
    Contribute to assortment creation and curation, ensuring collections are commercially viable and aligned with growth and profitability goals.
    Collaborate closely with design leads, print, buyer, and production teams to deliver cohesive collections.
    Provide informal leadership, leading and developing Junior Designers. Confidently communicate your design and product presentation in a clear, compelling, and inspiring way

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will collaborate daily with Designers, Product Developers, Atelier Designers and the wider Assortment and Buying teams. You’ll be part of a design team of around 15 within a broader group of approximately 25 colleagues, working closely to shape a cohesive knitwear offer.

In this collaborative environment, you’ll share ideas, build on team expertise and work with internal partners and external suppliers to develop high-quality, commercially relevant products from concept through to final delivery.

Qualifications

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with…

    Degree in Fashion Design or a related field
    Proven experience in knitwear design within a fashion retail environment
    Strong technical knowledge of knitwear construction, including yarns, gauges, and knitting techniques (e.g. fully fashioned, circular knit, jacquard)
    Solid understanding of garment construction, materials, and product development processes
    Experience in building and developing commercial assortments in line with brand direction
    Strong ability to research, interpret, and apply trends within a retail context
    High level of design sensibility aligned with brand aesthetics
    Proficiency in design software (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop)
    Confident in working cross-functionally with buying, production, and suppliers
    Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus

And people who are…

    Creative and detail-oriented with a passion for fashion.
    Visionary and curious – eager to push boundaries and explore new ideas.
    Communicative and collaborative – building alignment across teams.
    Resilient and adaptable – thriving in a fast-paced environment with tight timelines.
    Open to feedback and innovation, with a strong focus on sustainability and commercial impact.

Additional Information

This is a full-time permanent position based at our Head Office in Stockholm.

If you feel this opportunity is exciting feel free to apply by sending in your CV and Portfolio in English before 15th October. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through our career page.

Please note that we may take the ad down before the application deadline if we receive a high volume of qualified applications—so we encourage you to apply early.

We value collaboration and believe great ideas thrive when we work closely together. Therefore, this role is primarily office based, with four days per week on site. One day per week, you may work remotely.

Please note that this position is offered on a local contract, and you must have the legal right to work in Sweden before applying.  



WHO WE ARE

& Other Stories is a modern fashion brand that tells expressive stories. Designed for everyday living – with its excitement, curiosity and imperfections – our clothes empower those who think differently. Learn more about & Other Stories here.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

We offer all our employees attractive benefits with broad development opportunities. All our employees receive a staff discount usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to this, & Other Stories-based colleagues also receive:

    30 days holiday
    A collective agreement which includes pension and life insurance
    Wellness benefit 4000kr/year
    Benify Benefits Portal

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

We look forward to hearing from you

Concept Artist
jobs.description:
Do you have an eye for detail and a passion for creating awesome character design concepts, magical environment concepts and whatever is needed to enhance game experience? Are you excited about crafting vibrant visuals for mobile games that captivate millions of players?

As a Concept Artist at Snowprint, you’ll have a broad role with plenty of room to influence the visual direction of our new game project. You’ll mainly work on character and outfit concepts, but also contribute to props, items, environments, key art, and whatever else is needed to bring the game’s visual world together.

You’ll be part of a small team where your ideas and perspective matter. You’ll work closely with the Art Director, other artists, designers, and developers, with the freedom to take ownership of your work and find solutions rather than simply working from a list of tasks.

At Snowprint, we believe that kindness, curiosity, collaboration, and a shared passion for making great games are key to creating a good place to work and great games.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll primarily create concepts for characters and their outfits, developing ideas that can be translated into 3D models and eventually brought into the game. You’ll work from early ideas through to more detailed concepts and turnarounds, making sure your designs communicate the character clearly and give the 3D team what they need to take them further.

You’ll also create key art and title screens, as well as concepts for props, items, environments, and other visual elements when needed. The role gives you the opportunity to work across different types of concept art and contribute to the overall visual quality of the game.

You’ll work closely with the Art Director and the rest of the art team, sharing work early, discussing ideas, and responding to feedback throughout the process. You’ll be encouraged to explore different approaches, adapt your style to the needs of the game, and keep moving rather than over-polishing before getting feedback.

Is this you?

    

You’re an experienced Concept Artist with professional experience working on at least one released game. Experience from a stylized, fantasy, or high-fidelity game is particularly relevant.

    

You have a strong understanding of character design, including anatomy, proportions, clothing, poses, lighting, composition, mood, and surfaces. You know how to make designs feel visually interesting while still having a clear function and purpose.

    

You understand the path from concept to 3D. You know how to create clear character turnarounds and other concepts that give 3D artists what they need to build and implement the asset.

    

You’re adaptable and comfortable working within an established art direction. You can adjust your style to what the game needs and are comfortable working across characters, props, environments, and key art.

What we’ll be looking for in your portfolio

    

Strong character / creature appeal and design fundamentals

    

Dynamic / interesting character presentation

    

Work samples showing confidence in human and animal anatomy

    

A strong understanding of light and material behaviour

    

Clear character sheets for 3D artists

Where you’ll work

Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, with a hybrid working model. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction. Other days, you can work from wherever you feel most productive. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably.

We’re unable to support relocation for this position, so you need to be based in Stockholm, Sweden.

About Snowprint Studios

Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals working together in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment, while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance.

Our games include Legends of Solgard, Rivengard, and Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus. We care about making great games and creating an environment where people can do their best work together.

For more information on Snowprint Studios, visit our website and follow us on social media.

At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace.

Good to know

We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

Are you ready to shape the future with confidence?



Som junior konsult inom Technology Risk hos oss på EY blir du del av ett team i gränslandet mellan teknik, affär och risk. Du får snabbt arbeta med att hjälpa kunder säkra informationshantering och möta regulatoriska krav. Du utvecklar kompetens inom IT-revision, internkontroll och cybersäkerhet – med stöd från erfarna kollegor i en inkluderande kultur.



Vi söker dig som är nyutexaminerad inom systemvetenskap, cybersäkerhet, teknik eller ekonomi och som vill påbörja din karriär hos oss i augusti 2027 – med möjlighet till tidigare startdatum. Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm eller Göteborg.





Möjligheten: ditt nästa äventyr väntar på dig



Du kommer att arbeta med en varierad kundportfölj inom både privat och offentlig sektor, och delta i nationella såväl som internationella projekt.



Som konsult blir du en nyckelperson i rådgivning kring IT-internkontroll, revision, regulatorisk efterlevnad, IT-styrning och cybersäkerhet. Du genomför riskanalyser, utvärderar IT-processer och föreslår förbättringar.



I en dynamisk miljö hanterar du frågor som: Vilka risker medför AI och automatisering? Hur tillförlitliga är molntjänstleverantörers kontroller? Hur skyddas kunddata hos tredje part? Din analytiska förmåga är avgörande för att möta dessa utmaningar och leverera säkra lösningar.





Kvalifikationer:



    Relevant universitetsexamen (exempelvis IT, informationssäkerhet, systemvetenskap, datateknik, civilingenjör, jurist, cybersäkerhet eller civilekonom)

    Hög språklig nivå i tal och skrift, både på svenska och engelska





Meriterande:



    Masterexamen är meriterande

    Relevant IT-teknisk kompetens (exempelvis hantering av affärssystem, operativsystem, databaser) eller kunskap om IT-risk och informationssäkerhet (t.ex. CoBiT, ITIL, ISO27001 och NIST) är meriterande
    



Som person:



    Intresse och förståelse för IT-risker och teknik

    Lyhörd lagspelare med ambitionen att vara högpresterande

    Kommunikativ med god förmåga att arbeta i team

    Nyfiken och entreprenörsdriven

    En fallenhet för att hantera förändring
    Detaljorienterad

    Ansvarstagande och proaktiv





Vad vi erbjuder dig



    Kontinuerligt lärande: Du utvecklar tankesätt och färdigheter som hjälper dig att navigera in i framtiden.

    Transformativt ledarskap: Vi ger dig insikter, coachning och självförtroende för att bli den ledare som världen behöver.

    Inkluderande kultur: Du kommer att accepteras för den du är och få möjlighet att använda din röst för att hjälpa andra att hitta sin.

    På EY kommer vi att hjälpa dig utveckla och anpassa dina färdigheter framåt utifrån en upplevelse i världsklass. Vi stärker dig i en flexibel miljö och låter dig och din kompentens utvecklas i en kultur som värdesätter mångfald och inkludering på en global nivå. Läs mer här.





Är du redo att ”Shape your future with confidence”? Ansök idag.



Skicka in din ansökan innehållande CV, personligt brev och betyg, senast den 23 Oktober 2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vid frågor om tjänsten, kontakta Maria Romanova (Mariia.Romanova@se.ey.com). Frågor om processen? Mejla Klara.Stenqvist@se.ey.com.

På EY värdesätter vi mångfald och uppmuntrar ansökningar från individer från olika bakgrunder. Om du har frågor, behöver stöd, eller anpassning av rekryteringsprocessen på grund av en funktionsnedsättning, tveka inte på att kontakta oss på recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. Vi finns här för att stötta dig.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: AI Video Editor
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Video Editor based in France.

This is a performance-driven creative role focused on producing high-volume, conversion-oriented video content for paid social campaigns.
Video editing is the primary focus, with static ad creation providing additional creative versatility and speed.
You’ll work across UGC-style videos, testimonials, product demos, founder-led content, and direct-response ads.
The role emphasizes rapid testing, strong hooks, compelling CTAs, and creative variations designed to improve performance.
You’ll use modern editing and AI-powered tools to accelerate ideation, scripting, production, and iteration.
Working closely with strategists and growth teams, you’ll turn raw assets and concepts into effective creative at scale.
The ideal candidate is fast, resourceful, coachable, and motivated by measurable results rather than aesthetics alone.


Accountabilities:
  • Edit short-form direct-response video ads for Meta, TikTok, and other paid social platforms, including UGC, testimonials, product demonstrations, and founder-led content.
  • Develop multiple creative variations by testing different hooks, angles, CTAs, messaging, layouts, and offers.
  • Write and adapt scripts and copy for video concepts with a strong focus on engagement and conversion.
  • Use editing platforms such as CapCut, Premiere, After Effects, and other relevant tools to produce high-quality creative efficiently.
  • Leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Runway, Pika, and Descript to accelerate ideation, scripting, editing, and production workflows.
  • Create high-converting static ad creatives for paid social campaigns using templates, creative systems, competitor inspiration, and swipe files.
  • Produce multiple static variations for testing, including different headlines, layouts, messaging, and offers.
  • Work closely with strategists and growth teams to execute creative concepts and respond quickly to performance feedback.
  • Source, organize, and manage creative assets such as UGC, stock footage, hooks, B-roll, and other campaign materials.
  • Maintain a high-volume creative workflow while prioritizing effectiveness, consistency, and timely delivery.

    • Requirements:

    • 2+ years of experience editing direct-response video ads for direct-to-consumer brands.
    • Strong portfolio demonstrating successful paid social video advertising.
    • Solid experience creating static advertisements for Meta and other paid social platforms.
    • Proficiency with an editing tool such as CapCut, Premiere, and/or After Effects.
    • Working knowledge of Photoshop.
    • Strong understanding of performance marketing principles, including hooks, CTAs, creative angles, conversion, and testing.
    • Experience writing or adapting copy for advertising creatives.
    • Familiarity with AI-powered creative and productivity tools such as ChatGPT, Runway, Pika, or similar platforms.
    • Ability to work quickly, manage multiple projects, and consistently deliver several creative assets per week.
    • Strong English communication skills.
    • Motion graphics experience is a plus.
    • Familiarity with Creative OS, Foreplay, Butter, AdCreative.ai, or similar creative platforms is a plus.
    • Understanding of marketing funnels, offers, and paid social strategy is a plus.
    • Performance-oriented mindset with a focus on measurable results rather than aesthetics alone.
    • Resourcefulness, adaptability, coachability, ownership, and reliability in a fast-paced creative environment.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time remote opportunity.
      • High-output creative environment with frequent testing and iteration.
      • Opportunity to work across both video and static paid social advertising.

jobs.title: Dette er ikkje ei tradisjonell stilling innan eitt fagområde!
jobs.description:
Osland-konsernet er et av landets eldste akvakulturselskaper med hovedkontor i Bjordal, Høyanger. Konsernet driver en helhetlig verdikjede innen produksjon av ørret – fra genetikk og settefisk til matfiskproduksjon.

 

Vi søkjer ein strukturert og allsidig medarbeider som skal arbeide på tvers av konsernet.

 

Dette er ei brei og operativ rolle. Du vil støtte fleire fagområde og bidra til at oppgåver blir følgde opp på ein god og systematisk måte. Du vil jobbe med digitalisering og forenkling. Du motiveres av å skape struktur, sikre kvalitet og finne smartere og mer effektive måter å arbeide på.

 

Rolla passar for deg som likar variasjon. Du må trivast med å arbeide med både detaljar og større problemstillingar. Du vil få bred innsikt i selskapets verksemd og være bidragsyter for felles leveranser i konsernet.

 

Arbeidsoppgåver

 

Du vil få oppgåver innan fleire delar av verksemda, både innen verksemdsstyring og prosjekt. Innhaldet vil utvikle seg over tid.

 

Aktuelle arbeidsoppgåver vil vere:

  • Planlegging og gjennomføring av administrasjonsoppgaver
  • Ansvar for vedlikehold og arbeid i kvalitetssystem og interne rutinar etter årshjul
  • Forenkle og effektivisere administrative arbeidsprosesser, blant annet med bruk av KI.
  • Følge opp at lover, krav og interne retningslinjer blir etterlevd
  • Arbeid med rapportering fra prosjekt og støtte til prosjektorganisasjon i utviklingarbeid
  • Planlegge og drive mindre prosjekt, utviklingstiltak og forbedringsarbeid.
  • Støtte og oppfølging i revisjoner, kontroller og avvik.
  • Arbeid i system med arkivering, og oversikt over avtalar og dokumentasjon
  • Arbeid i informasjonskanalar og aktiv kommunikasjon
  • Administrativ støtte innan strukturelle system, utvikling og effektivisering
  • Innhente, strukturere dokumentasjon og styringsinformasjon på tvers av konsernet
  • Støtte økonomiarbeid med rapportering, dokumentasjon og oppfølging
  • Deltaking i prosjekt og forbetringsarbeid

 

Kven ser vi etter?

 

Vi ser etter ein person som er strukturert og nøyaktig. Du må like å få oversikt og sørgje for framdrift. Du har evne til å gripe om deg og er uredd i tilnærming til et større omfang.

 

Du arbeider sjølvstendig og er datakyndig. Samstundes må du kunne samarbeide godt med ulike delar av organisasjonen.

 

Vi ser gjerne at du har utdanning eller erfaring innan eitt eller fleire av desse områda:

 

  • Økonomi og administrasjon
  • Kvalitet eller HMS, juridiske/organisatoriske fag
  • Havbruksledelse

Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning.

 

Det viktigaste er at du har god forretningsforståing. Du må også vere komfortabel med å setje deg inn i nye fagområde og kunne sjå heilheten av kontinuerlig forbedring. Du er god i microsoft verktøy og spesielt Office 365.

 

Vi trur du vil lykkast dersom du

  • Arbeider systematisk og tek ansvar
  • Har høg gjennomføringsevne
  • Er god til å halde oversikt
  • Kommuniserer klart og presist
  • Behandlar konfidensiell informasjon på ein trygg måte
  • Likar å finne praktiske løysingar

 

Ei rolle med stor breidde

 

Dette er ikkje ei tradisjonell stilling innan eitt fagområde.

 

Du vil arbeide i skjeringspunktet mellom kvalitet, etterleving og administrasjon. Du vil også støtte arbeid innan økonomi, HR, KHMS og juridiske saker. Vi er spesielt interessert dersom du har arbeid i skjeringspunktet mellom produksjon, økonomi og andre datautrekk.

 

Rolla gir derfor stor innsikt i korleis konsernet blir drive.

 

For den rette personen vil det vere gode moglegheiter til å utvikle både rolla og ansvarsområdet.

 

Vi tilbyr

 

  • Gode muligheter til å påvirke og videreutvikle konsernets prosesser og digitale løsninger.
  • Moderne systemer og digitale verktøy, samt gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og videreutdanning.
  • Fleksibilitet og mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag.
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og et stabilt og utviklende arbeidsmiljø ved vårt avdelingskontor i Sandviken, Bergen.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen kan du kontakte vår rekrutteringsrådgiver i Lederhuset AS, Bjarne Jacobsen.

jobs.title: Expression of Interest  Freelance International Recruiter
jobs.description:
Remote | Flexible | Commission-based

Do you enjoy connecting with people, building relationships and helping others take the step towards living and working abroad?

Jobs By Nordics is looking to connect with motivated Freelance International Recruiters who want to work remotely and help candidates find exciting job opportunities across Europe.

We recruit multilingual talent for international companies across Europe and are continuously interested in connecting with people who can help us reach more candidates and make great hires.

Right now, we are especially interested in recruiters who speak Danish, German or Dutch, as we have a strong demand for candidates within these markets.

About Jobs By Nordics

Jobs By Nordics is a recruitment agency specialising in connecting multilingual talent with international employers across Europe.

We help Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Icelandic, Dutch and German speakers find opportunities abroad, with many of our positions located in destinations such as Greece, Spain and Cyprus.

Our vacancies are mainly within:

    Customer Service
    

    Technical Support
    

    Sales
    

    Content Moderation
    

    Travel & Tourism

For many of our candidates, accepting a job through us means more than changing employer. It can mean moving to a new country, meeting new people and starting an entirely new chapter in life.

As a recruiter, you will be an important part of making that happen.

The role

As a Freelance International Recruiter, you will manage your candidates throughout the recruitment journey – from finding and contacting them to supporting them through the recruitment process and towards their relocation and new job abroad.

Your responsibilities can include:

    Finding and attracting candidates through social media, job platforms, your own network and other creative sourcing channels
    

    Proactively reaching out to potential candidates
    

    Screening candidates and understanding their motivation, experience and preferences
    

    Matching candidates with suitable opportunities
    

    Presenting positions and relocation opportunities to candidates
    

    Preparing and supporting candidates through assessments and interviews
    

    Following up and keeping candidates engaged throughout the recruitment process
    

    Supporting candidates ahead of their relocation and job start
    

    Keeping candidate information and recruitment statuses updated

You will have the freedom to develop your own ways of finding candidates while working with the vacancies and recruitment opportunities available through Jobs By Nordics.

Who are we looking for?

First and foremost, we are looking for people who are proactive, independent and good with people.

You should enjoy communicating with new people and be comfortable taking initiative rather than waiting for candidates to come to you.

Fluent English is required.

At the moment, we are particularly interested in people who also speak:

    Danish
    

    German
    

    Dutch

Previous experience within recruitment or sales is an advantage, but it is not necessarily a requirement. The right personality, motivation and ability to connect with people are equally important.

We believe you could be a great fit if you:

    Are comfortable approaching and communicating with new people
    

    Are proactive and enjoy finding your own ways to reach candidates
    

    Have a good understanding of social media and online communities
    

    Are organised and good at following up
    

    Can work independently and take responsibility for your own results
    

    Enjoy working with people from different countries and cultures
    

    Have lived or worked abroad, or have a genuine interest in international opportunities
    

    Are motivated by a performance-based way of working

Work remotely – with freedom and responsibility

The collaboration is fully remote, giving you the freedom to work from wherever suits you.

As a freelancer, you decide how you organise your working day and how you approach your candidate sourcing. At the same time, successful recruitment requires consistency, good follow-up and the ability to take ownership of your candidates throughout the process.

Jobs By Nordics provides access to recruitment opportunities, information about the positions and employers, and the tools and support needed to successfully guide candidates through the process.

Commission-based freelance collaboration

The role is commission-based, meaning your earnings are directly connected to your successful recruitments.

This is a freelance collaboration rather than an employment position. You therefore need to have your own registered company or equivalent business structure that allows you to invoice Jobs By Nordics for your services.

As an independent freelancer, you are responsible for managing and complying with the tax, social security, VAT, insurance and other applicable legal requirements in the country where you operate.

Why work with Jobs By Nordics?

You get the opportunity to combine recruitment with the freedom of working independently and remotely.

You can focus on what recruiters do best – finding great people, building relationships and making successful placements – while recruiting for real opportunities with international employers across Europe.

And perhaps most importantly, the people you recruit are often making a major life decision.

You are not simply helping someone find another job.

You might be helping them start a new life abroad.

Interested?

We would love to hear from you.

Send us your Expression of Interest and tell us a little about yourself, the languages you speak, your background and why you believe you would be successful as a Freelance International Recruiter.

We are especially interested in hearing how you would approach finding and engaging candidates for international opportunities.

Join our freelance recruiter network and help more people discover their next opportunity abroad.

jobs.title: Assistant Kitchen Manager – EGON Brygga, Tromsø
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your kitchen career and be part of opening a brand-new EGON restaurant?

 

EGON is one of Norway’s strongest and most successful restaurant concepts. We are now looking for a motivated and ambitious Assistant Kitchen Manager to join the leadership team at the new EGON Brygga in Tromsø.

 

Located directly on the waterfront in the heart of Tromsø, EGON Brygga will be a large new restaurant with approximately 300 seats. This is an exciting opportunity to join from the beginning, help build a strong kitchen team and contribute to establishing the standards, culture and daily operations of a brand-new restaurant.

About the Role

As Assistant Kitchen Manager, you will be the Kitchen Manager’s right hand and an important part of the restaurant’s leadership team. You will work closely with the Kitchen Manager and General Manager and take active responsibility for daily kitchen operations, quality, structure and team development.

 

The position combines hands-on kitchen work with leadership, planning and follow-up. You will also play an important role in creating a strong team and ensuring that EGON’s routines and standards are implemented from day one. For the right candidate, this can also be an excellent step toward becoming a Kitchen Manager within EGON in the future.

Main Responsibilities
  • Support the Kitchen Manager in the daily operation of the kitchen
  • Take responsibility for kitchen operations when the Kitchen Manager is absent
  • Ensure consistently high food quality and presentation
  • Participate actively in food preparation and à la carte service
  • Follow up routines related to HACCP / food safety and hygiene
  • Help train, motivate and develop kitchen employees
  • Contribute to efficient staffing, planning and organization
  • Follow EGON’s routines, systems and operational standards
  • Help create a positive, structured and professional working environment
  • Contribute to building a strong kitchen team at the new restaurant
Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who enjoys responsibility and thrives in a busy restaurant environment.

 

You preferably have:

  • Relevant experience from a professional kitchen
  • Experience from high-volume restaurants or similar operations
  • Previous leadership experience, or a strong motivation to develop into a leadership role
  • Good organizational and communication skills
  • A hands-on approach and willingness to lead by example
  • The ability to remain structured and focused during busy services
  • A positive attitude and strong work ethic
  • A genuine interest in food, people and restaurant operations
  • Good communication skills in English. Speaking Norwegian is a big plus.

Experience as a Sous Chef, Assistant Kitchen Manager, Shift Leader, Team Leader or similar is an advantage.

What We Offer

At EGON Brygga, you will have the opportunity to join a completely new restaurant from the beginning and become part of building the team and operation. EGON offers a structured working environment with established systems, training and opportunities for professional development. As part of a large and growing restaurant group, there are also good opportunities for further career development for employees who want more responsibility.

 

You will become part of an ambitious leadership team in one of Tromsø’s most exciting new restaurant openings.

If you are an experienced kitchen professional who wants more responsibility and the opportunity to develop as a leader, we would like to hear from you.

 

Apply today and become part of the team opening EGON Brygga in Tromsø!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

EGON Brygga will be a brand-new EGON restaurant opening at the historic Bangsundbrygga, directly on the waterfront in central Tromsø. The restaurant will have around 300 seats, including both indoor and outdoor seating. With its spectacular waterfront location and views of Tromsø’s surrounding mountains, EGON Brygga aims to become a natural meeting place for locals and visitors alike. The restaurant will offer EGON’s broad à la carte menu in a warm and informal atmosphere, while the design will preserve the historic character and architecture of Bangsundbrygga.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Machine Learning and Statistics
jobs.description:
About the position

Integreat - the Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning at the University of Oslo invites applications for a doctoral research fellow in Machine Learning and Statistics. We seek a motivated researcher, who values collaboration, inclusivity, and impact, and who would like to contribute to a supportive, interdisciplinary research environment with strong focus on mentoring and career development.

Starting date upon individual agreement and preferably no later than 1st of April 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Integreat - Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning at University of Oslo at Blindern, Oslo.

We welcome applicants with a strong background in machine learning and statistics, who are eager to contribute to cutting-edge methods for generating private and fair synthetic data with good utility. This project involves development of deep learning based synthetic data generators that obtain both good utility and protection of privacy, through tailored model approximation, as well as new measures of privacy and fairness to be used for assessing properties of synthetic generators, or in loss functions for training them. Further, the potentials and limitations of the developed approaches should be critically assessed regarding their implications for fairness, privacy, and utility. This project is at the intersection of machine learning, statistics and ethics.

This position is affiliated with the research group research group in Statistics and Data Science at the Department of Mathematics at University of Oslo, in close collaboration with the machine learning group at the Department of Informatics.


About Integreat

See the video for more information about Integreat.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/-_I52cJHiW4About Integreat 

Integreat - Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning is a Centre of Excellence, funded by the Research Council of Norway. Integreat has two branches, one in Oslo (University of Oslo, UiO) and one in Tromsø (UiT The Arctic University of Norway). This position is in Oslo.

Machine learning is the mathematical and computational engine of Artificial Intelligence (AI), and therefore it is a fundamental force of technological progress in our increasingly digital, data- and algorithm-driven world. Integreat develops theories, methods, models, and algorithms that integrate general and domain-specific knowledge with data, laying the foundations of next generation machine learning. We do this by combining the mathematical and computational cultures, and the methodologies and theories, of statistics, logic, language technology, ethics and machine learning, in new and unique ways.

The focus of Integreat is to develop ground-breaking methods and theories, and therefore solving fundamental problems in science, technology, health and society. Integreat draws on the research strengths of researchers and students from the departments of Mathematics, Informatics, Philosophy, and the Oslo Centre for Biostatistics and Epidemiology at UiO, the Norwegian Computing Centre (NR) and the ML group at UiT, with members from the departments of Physics and Technology, Mathematics and Statistics, and Computer Science.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Qualification requirements:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in computer science, statistics, data science, mathematics, or related field
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Employment and admission to the PhD programme are conditional upon successful completion of the Master's degree and submission of official documentation confirming that the degree has been awarded. Applicants who are in the final stages of completing their Master's degree may still apply.

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience with deep learning models
  • Strong background in programming
  • A keen interest in considering and discussing ethical aspects of the research projects
  • Experience with interdisciplinary work

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements: 

The norm is as follows:

  • the average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • the average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • the Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see: Supplementary Regulations at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences to the Regulations for the Degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo - The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


Personal skills

We are looking for candidates who are curious, open-minded, and motivated to learn. You should enjoy working both independently and as part of a team, and be comfortable communicating your ideas clearly across disciplines. A collaborative spirit, a strong sense of responsibility, and a willingness to contribute to an inclusive and respectful research culture are essential.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

Integreat is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and belonging, guided by our INTEGREAT principles (Integrity, Non discrimination, Tact, Environment, Gratitude, Respect, Empathy, Accountability, Transparency). We embed these values in practice through inclusive hiring and structured evaluations, targeted mentoring and career development, and flexible work arrangements and accommodations to ensure everyone can thrive and contribute.

We particularly welcome applications from women and gender minorities who are underrepresented in STEM, as well as applicants with immigrant backgrounds, disabilities, non linear career paths, or career breaks. We will take career interruptions and diverse career trajectories into account during evaluation.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.


We offer
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK 550 800 – 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2% is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • A unique research environment with multiple opportunities to develop research themes at the forefront of modern science
  • A friendly, inclusive, and collaborative international working environment that values diverse perspectives
  • Access to a strong network of top-level national and international collaborators
  • A reliable and generous pension agreement, along with strong public benefits
  • Comprehensive welfare schemes supporting both personal and professional well-being
  • Full access to public health services through membership in the National Insurance Scheme
  • A vibrant academic environment with an active and supportive research community
  • Structured career development programmes at the faculty level and an individual professional development plan throughout the postdoctoral period
  • Mentoring and support structures tailored to early-career researchers
  • Flexible working conditions, with understanding for different life situations and family responsibilities
  • Research mobility funds supporting short research stays and international collaboration
  • Family-friendly surroundings in Oslo and Tromsø, with rich opportunities for culture, nature, and outdoor activities
  • A clear institutional commitment to gender equality and diversity, with dedicated initiatives and networks for women in science

Integreat provides a researcher training programme, INTREF - the Integreat Young Researchers’ Forum - a fellow driven initiative offering scientific training, transferable skills workshops, mentorship, research visits, and career development support.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter – describe your motivation for pursuing a PhD at Integreat and in Norway, with particular emphasis on your research interests and academic achievements to date relevant for this position and the project
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diploma (see below)
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • If relevant you may attach Master thesis or a draft of your thesis
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)
  • Documentation of English proficiency

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position". Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Focus of Integreat is to develop ground-breaking methods and theories, and by this solving fundamental problems in science, technology, health and society. Integreat draws on the research strengths of researchers and students from the departments of Mathematics, Informatics, Philosophy, and the Oslo Centre for Biostatistics and Epidemiology at UiO, the Norwegian Computing Centre (NR) and the ML group at UiT, with members from the departments of Physics and Technology, Mathematics and Statistics, and Computer Science.

À propos de Lexroom

Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. jobs.title: Er du god med mennesker og liker å finne de beste løsningene for kunden?
jobs.description:
Toyota Haugesund søker kunderådgiver

Du trenger ikke å kunne alt om bil for å lykkes som kunderådgiver hos Toyota Haugesund. Det viktigste er at du liker mennesker, trives med ansvar og motiveres av å skape gode kundeopplevelser.

Som kunderådgiver blir du bindeleddet mellom kundene våre og verkstedet. Du følger kunden gjennom hele besøket, fra bilen leveres inn til nøklene gis tilbake, og sørger for god kommunikasjon og en trygg opplevelse underveis.

Du får en variert arbeidshverdag hvor kundekontakt kombineres med koordinering, salg og administrative oppgaver. Noen dager handler det om å finne den beste løsningen for en kunde, andre ganger om å sørge for at deler er på plass, følge opp en verkstedordre eller sikre at kunden vet hva som skjer med bilen.

Du vil blant annet:

  • Ta imot kunder ved innlevering og utlevering av bil
  • Veilede og følge opp kunder gjennom verkstedbesøket
  • Identifisere behov og tilby relevante verkstedtjenester
  • Følge opp deler og bestillinger
  • Håndtere ordre og fakturering
  • Sørge for god kommunikasjon mellom kunde og verksted
  • Bidra til at kundene våre får en best mulig opplevelse
Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som naturlig setter kunden først. Du er god til å lytte, forstå behov og finne løsninger, samtidig som du klarer å holde oversikt når det er mye som skjer.

Du trives med mennesker og kommuniserer godt med ulike typer kunder. Samtidig har du interesse for bil og en teknisk forståelse som gjør at du raskt kan sette deg inn i kundens behov og problemstillinger.

Erfaring fra bilbransjen er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Har du jobbet med kundeservice, rådgivning eller salg og kjenner deg igjen i rollen, ønsker vi også å høre fra deg.

Vi tror du:

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsevner og liker kundekontakt
  • Har interesse for bil og god teknisk forståelse
  • Er serviceinnstilt og opptatt av gode kundeopplevelser
  • Er strukturert og løsningsorientert
  • Har god arbeidskapasitet og tar ansvar
  • Er komfortabel med IT som arbeidsverktøy
  • Trives med både selvstendig arbeid og samarbeid
Hvorfor Toyota Haugesund?

Hos Toyota Haugesund blir du en del av en komplett bilforhandler hvor salg, verksted, karosseri, lakkering, klargjøring, deler og dekk er samlet under samme tak.

Du får jobbe med en av verdens mest kjente bilmerkevarer og blir en del av et fagmiljø hvor kvalitet, kontinuerlig forbedring og gode kundeopplevelser står sentralt.

Hos oss får du blant annet:

  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Opplæring og faglig utvikling gjennom Toyotas opplæringsprogrammer
  • God støtte fra dyktige kollegaer
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Bedriftshelsetjeneste og tilgang til personalhytte
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med fokus på gode arbeidsforhold
  • Muligheten til å utvikle deg i en solid virksomhet og en bilbransje i stor utvikling
Om Toyota Haugesund

Toyota Haugesund er en del av Jæger Automobil AS og er en komplett bilforhandler på Haugalandet. Fra anlegget i Salhusvegen tilbyr vi blant annet nye og brukte biler, verkstedtjenester, deler og tilbehør, dekkhotell, karosseri, lakkering og klargjøring.

Jæger Automobil er en del av Jægergruppen, Vestlandets største bilforhandler, og representerer Toyota, Lexus, BMW og MINI. Konsernet har over 250 ansatte og en årlig omsetning på 1,6 milliarder kroner.

Klar for å bli Toyota Haugesund sitt nye ansikt ut mot verkstedkundene?
