jobs.title: 3Unika søger Montør / værkstedsmedarbejder
jobs.description:
3Unika søger Montør / værkstedsmedarbejder

Vi søger en dygtig og alsidig medarbejder til en stilling, hvor arbejdsdagene er delt mellem montage hos kunder og arbejde på vores værksted.

3Unika fremstiller og monterer specialbyggede, indbyggede reoler, skabe og opbevaringsløsninger. Vi er 7 medarbejdere og holder til i Ebeltoft. Vi er en virksomhed i vækst og udvikling, hvor kvalitet og godt håndværk er i fokus.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Montage og opsætning hos private kunder

  • Klargøring og bearbejdning af materialer på værkstedet

  • Samling og forskellige værkstedsopgaver

  • Kvalitetskontrol og aflevering af det færdige resultat

Vi forestiller os, at du har en håndværksmæssig baggrund som fx snedker, tømrer eller køkkenmontør – eller tilsvarende erfaring inden for træfaget.

Du er kvalitetsbevidst, serviceminded og har sans for detaljen. Du arbejder selvstændigt, men er samtidig en god teamplayer. Almindelig god fysik.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Fire dages arbejdsuge, mandag-torsdag

  • En varieret hverdag med både værksted og montage

  • Gode kollegaer og et uformelt arbejdsmiljø

  • God løn efter kvalifikationer

Vi tager udgangspunkt fra Elsegårdevej 7 i Ebeltoft og monterer løsninger i hele landet. Der må forventes op til to udeliggende arbejdsdage om ugen.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning til kontakt@3unika.dk.

Samtaler afholdes løbende, og vi ønsker ansættelse snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

3Unika
www.3unika.dk
www.instagram.com/3unika

jobs.title: Lakimies / juristi – yritysjuridiikka ja perintätoimen vastuuhenkilö
jobs.description:
Espoon Laki- ja yrityspalvelut Oy hakee lakimiestä yritysjuridiikan tehtäviin ja perintätoimen vastuuhenkilöksi Espooseen.

Tehtävässä hoidat yritysasiakkaiden oikeudellisia asioita ja neuvontaa. Työn keskiössä ovat yritys- ja osakeyhtiöjuridiikan kysymykset, sopimusten laatiminen ja arviointi sekä yhtiöiden päätöksentekoon, hallintoon ja vastuisiin liittyvät asiat.

Toimit myös perintätoimen vastuuhenkilönä. Vastaat perintätoiminnan asianmukaisuudesta, menettelytapojen ja hyvän perintätavan noudattamisesta sekä käytännön perintäasioiden juridisesta hoitamisesta.

Edellytämme oikeustieteellistä tutkintoa, keskeisten yritys- ja osakeyhtiöjuridiikan asioiden hallintaa sekä kykyä soveltaa osaamista käytännön asiakastyössä. Tehtävä edellyttää perintää koskevan sääntelyn ja hyvän perintätavan tuntemusta, huolellista ja itsenäistä työotetta sekä selkeää kirjallista ilmaisua.

Verojuridiikan ja yritysten verotuksellisten kysymysten osaaminen katsotaan eduksi. Arvostamme myös kokemusta yritysasiakkaiden neuvonnasta ja perintäasioiden hoitamisesta.

Työ sijoittuu Espooseen. Aloitus, palkkaus ja muut työehdot sovitaan valittavan henkilön kanssa.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi osoitteeseen info@espoonlaki.fi viimeistään 4.11.2026. Kerro hakemuksessa yritys- ja osakeyhtiöjuridiikan osaamisestasi, perintäkokemuksestasi sekä mahdollisesta vero-osaamisestasi. Voit liittää mukaan palkkatoiveesi ja tiedon siitä, milloin voisit aloittaa. Sähköpostin aiheeksi Lakimies / juristi.

Lisätiedot: 0100-7711.

jobs.description:

Haemme yhteistyöhön sekä omalla autolla toimivia taksiyrittäjiä että ilman omaa autoa aloittavia itsenäisiä ammatinharjoittajia. Voit hakea mukaan myös, jos olet vasta aloittamassa yrittäjänä.

OMALLA AUTOLLA TAI ILMAN

Jos sinulla on oma taksiauto, kerro hakemuksessa sen varustelusta ja matkustajapaikoista. Jos oma auto puuttuu, ota yhteyttä rekrylomakkeella ja kerro tilanteestasi. Meiltä voi myös ostaa auton mittareineen, jolla liikenteen pystyy aloittamaan heti, kun tarvittavat luvat ja ajokohtaiset edellytykset ovat kunnossa. Auton hankinta ja yhteistyön käytännöt sovitaan erikseen.

MONIPUOLISIA AJOJA

Ajoja on sekä hyvinvointialueiden sote-kuljetuksissa, Kela-kuljetuksissa että omissa tilausajoissamme. Haemme kumppaneita palvelemaan tilauksiamme paikallisesti ja lähialueilla. Ajot ja yhteistyön laajuus sovitaan yhdessä.

ARVOSTAMME HYVÄÄ PALVELUA

Asiakkaamme arvostavat täsmällisyyttä, luotettavuutta, turvallista ajotapaa, siistiä kalustoa ja ystävällistä asiakaspalvelua. Odotamme hyvää suomen kielen taitoa ja tehtävään soveltuvaa osaamista. Ruotsin kielen taito ja kokemus erityisryhmien kuljetuksista katsotaan eduksi.

Kuljettajalta edellytetään voimassa olevaa taksinkuljettajan ajolupaa. Omalla autolla toimivan yrittäjän lupa-, vakuutus- ja kalustoasiat sekä ajokohtaiset vaatimukset tarkistetaan ennen liikenteen aloittamista. Taksi Helsingin ja Lähitaksin kuljettajakortit katsotaan eduksi.

Kyseessä on alihankkijayhteistyö / yrittäjäpaikka. Korvaus, laskutus, kaluston käyttö ja muut yhteistyöehdot sovitaan erikseen. Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.

HAKEMINEN

Hakemukset rekrylomakkeen kautta: https://www.espoontaksikuljetus.fi/rekry.html

Mainitse hakemuksessa "alihankkija – Myrskylä". Kerro toiminta-alueestasi, ajokokemuksestasi, luvistasi ja siitä, toimitko omalla autolla vai ilman. Ilmoita myös, jos olet kiinnostunut ostamaan auton mittareineen.

jobs.title: Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique (H/F)
jobs.description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoindre le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique capable de suivre les projets de manière autonome, de coordonner les différents intervenants et de contribuer au développement commercial du groupe.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, les équipes techniques et les partenaires du groupe, vous prenez en charge le suivi des affaires depuis l'analyse du besoin client jusqu'à la coordination de la réalisation.
Votre rôle consiste à faire le lien entre les clients, les bureaux d'études, les équipes commerciales, les partenaires techniques et les unités de production afin de garantir le bon déroulement des projets.
Ce poste est basé à Barcelone, avec une activité tournée principalement vers le développement et le suivi des affaires en France et sur les autres marchés du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Suivi des affaires et coordination technique
- Analyser les demandes clients, les dossiers techniques, plans et cahiers des charges ;
- Participer à l'étude de faisabilité technique et commerciale des projets ;
- Préparer, suivre et relancer les offres commerciales ;
- Coordonner les échanges entre clients, bureaux d'études, partenaires techniques et équipes internes ;
- Suivre l'avancement des projets, les délais, les priorités et les points de blocage ;
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction ;
- Veiller à la bonne transmission des informations nécessaires à la production et à la réalisation des projets.
Développement commercial et relation partenaires
- Développer et entretenir un portefeuille de clients et partenaires ;
- Représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur : entreprises, bureaux d'études, architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, partenaires industriels ;
- Identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires sur les marchés ciblés ;
- Participer à la structuration des méthodes commerciales et du suivi client ;
- Contribuer au développement des activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives.
Profil recherché
- Expérience confirmée en chargé d'affaires, conduite de projets, développement commercial BTP, construction métallique, ingénierie ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne compréhension des dossiers techniques, plans, métrés, chiffrages et contraintes chantier ;
- Capacité à piloter plusieurs affaires en parallèle avec rigueur et autonomie ;
- Aisance dans la relation client, la négociation et la coordination d'interlocuteurs variés ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, sens de l'organisation et capacité à structurer son activité ;
- Profil terrain, réactif, fiable et orienté solutions ;
- Une expérience dans la construction métallique, le bâtiment industriel, l'enveloppe du bâtiment ou les structures métalliques serait fortement appréciée.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;
- Anglais apprécié ;
- Turc apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une solide compréhension technique et commerciale, nous recherchons une personne capable de prendre en main des affaires de manière autonome, de sécuriser le suivi des projets et de contribuer concrètement au développement du groupe.
Cadre de la collaboration
- CDI ou collaboration selon profil ;
- Poste basé à Barcelone ;
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et auprès des clients / partenaires ;
- Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

jobs.title: Koulutettu hieroja
jobs.description:
Haussa koulutettuja hierojia uuteen hyvinvointikeskukseen!

Etsimme joukkoomme ammattitaitoisia hierojia uuteen avattavaan hyvinvointikeskukseen Joutsensillalle.

Oletko sinä:

- koulutettu hieroja (Hierojan ammattitutkinto)

- ammattitaitoinen ja asiakkaan luottamusta herättävä

- hyvä työkaveri


Meillä pääset:

- mukaan rakentamaan laadukasta hyvinvointikeskusta

- työskentelemään viihtyisässä ja arvostavassa työyhteisössä, jossa jokainen saa kokea olevansa tärkeä osa yhteisöämme

- osaksi henkilöstömme jatkuvaa jatkokoulutusta - haluamme, että meillä työskentelee alan osaavimmat ja ammattitaitoisimmat tekijät

- suunnittelemaan työaikasi joustavasti ammatinharjoittajana


Toimit meillä itsenäisenä ammatinharjoittajana, ja ansaintasi muodostuu tekemistäsi hierontahoidoista. Jokaisen asiakaskäynnin tuotosta suurin osa kuuluu sinulle ja sovittu osuus meille.

Meidän tehtävämme on tehdä sinun työstäsi mahdollisimman sujuvaa. Huolehdimme tiloista, ajanvarauksesta, myynnistä ja markkinoinnista sekä monista niistä käytännön asioista, joita toimivan hierontapalvelun arki vaatii. Järjestämme tarvittavat välineet ja tarvikkeet, huolehdimme asiakaskokemuksen ympärillä olevista käytännön järjestelyistä ja teemme töitä sen eteen, että kalenterissasi riittää asiakkaita.

Haluamme myös, että meillä työskentelevillä ammattilaisilla on mahdollisuus kehittyä ja pysyä alansa huipulla. Siksi panostamme aktiivisesti osaamisen kehittämiseen ja koulutuksiin.

Ajatus on yksinkertainen: sinä saat keskittyä siihen, minkä osaat parhaiten – asiakkaiden kohtaamiseen ja laadukkaaseen hierontatyöhön. Me puolestamme hoidamme ympärillä olevan kokonaisuuden ja rakennamme yhdessä edellytykset sille, että sinun on hyvä tehdä työtäsi.

Mikäli yrittäjänä/ammatinharjoittajana toimiminen on sinulle uutta tai vierasta, niin autamme sinua kädestä pitäen oman yrityksesi perustamisessa ja toiminnan aloittamisessa.

Kiinnostuitko?

jobs.title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation

  • Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch

  • Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases

  • Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API

  • Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage

  • Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers

  • Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning

  • Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc)

  • Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

  • A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

jobs.title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Basel
jobs.description:
Du hast noch nie im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet, möchtest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlernen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Basel dein eigenes Netzwerk auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software – von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

Deine Rolle

  • Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

  • Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu – telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

  • Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

  • Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

  • Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

Das bringst du mit

  • Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

  • Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch – egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

  • Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

  • Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

  • Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

  • Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

  • Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

  • Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region – du startest nicht allein.

  • Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

  • Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

  • Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

  • Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

  • 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

  • Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

  • Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

Wie geht es weiter?

  1. Bewerbung & Sichtung – wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

  2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30–45 Minuten).

  3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

  4. Field Day – zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software – von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

Deine Rolle

  • Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

  • Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu – telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

  • Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

  • Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

  • Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

Das bringst du mit

  • Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

  • Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch – egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

  • Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

  • Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

  • Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

  • Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

  • Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

  • Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region – du startest nicht allein.

  • Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

  • Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

  • Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

  • Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

  • 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

  • Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

  • Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

Wie geht es weiter?

  1. Bewerbung & Sichtung – wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

  2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30–45 Minuten).

  3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

  4. Field Day – zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

jobs.title: ☀️️German-Speaking Customer Support Specialist-Relocate to Sunny Greece🇬🇷
jobs.description:
Ready for a Work-Life Upgrade under the Mediterranean Sun?

Imagine swapping cold commutes and grey skies for morning frappés, after-work dips in the Aegean, and weekends exploring island hideaways or ancient historic streets. If you speak German and have been dreaming of an exciting international fresh start, this is your sign!

At Next Job Abroad, we don't believe in a one-size-fits-all approach. We treat your job search like a personalized matching service. We partner with leading international customer experience hubs in Greece working with some of the world’s most recognized brands (think top-tier tech, e-commerce, gaming, travel, and automotive giants). Together, we make sure you land in a role that fits your background, strengths, and long-term goals.

What You’ll Be Doing (The Role)

As a Customer Experience Specialist, you will be the voice and face of global brands for German-speaking customers across Europe:

  • Be the Problem Solver: Assist customers via phone, live chat, and/or email with inquiries regarding products, order tracking, bookings, or account support.
  • Deliver Top-Class Service: Turn tricky situations into positive customer moments through clear, empathetic, and friendly communication.
  • Troubleshoot & Guide: Walk users through basic technical issues, service setups, or account features step-by-step.
  • Collaborate Globally: Work side-by-side with international colleagues in an inspiring, multicultural environment.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay updated on the latest brand features, tools, and updates with ongoing support.

Requirements

  • Fluency in German: Native or fluent (C1/C2 level) in both written and spoken communication.
  • Good English Knowledge: (B2 level or higher) to navigate company systems and communicate with international team members.
  • Work Eligibility: EU Passport or a valid legal work permit for Greece.
  • Age Requirement: At least 18 years old.
  • Digital Literacy: Comfortable navigating computers, multi-screen environments, and basic software applications.
  • Soft Skills: Strong communication skills, active listening, empathy, and a positive problem-solving mindset.
  • Relocation Readiness: Willingness and motivation to relocate to Greece in the coming weeks.

Benefits

  • 14 Salaries per Year: In Greece, you receive extra salary bonuses for Easter, Summer, and Christmas!
  • Monthly Performance Bonuses: Extra financial rewards based on your achievements and team KPIs.
  • Full Relocation Support:
    • Flight tickets booked to Greece
    • Complimentary hotel or apartment stay upon arrival
    • Dedicated assistance with local paperwork (AFM tax number, social security, bank accounts)
    • Real estate guidance to help you find your permanent apartment in Athens
  • Paid Professional Training: Comprehensive onboarding program to get you fully confident before taking your first customer inquiry.
  • Career Progression: Clear growth paths into Quality Assurance, Team Leadership, Training, or Operations within major global companies.
  • Mediterranean Lifestyle: Over 300 days of sunshine a year, vibrant city life, world-famous cuisine, and incredible beaches right on your doorstep.

A Recruitment Process Built Around Your Profile

We know moving to another country is a big decision, so we make the journey smooth and completely transparent:

  1. Application: Submit your CV in English or German.
  2. Personal Consultation: A friendly 1-on-1 interview with the recruitment team at Next Job Abroad to discuss your experience, interests, and preferred project types.
  3. Profile Matching: We match your background with current active openings in Greece and present you directly to the best-fit opportunity.
  4. Guidance & Placement: We guide you through the client interview, offer confirmation, relocation logistics, and onboarding—every single step of the way!

Why Athens, Greece?

Athens seamlessly blends rich ancient history with a buzzing, modern lifestyle. Enjoy low living costs relative to Western Europe, an unbeatable café culture, vibrant nightlife, and quick weekend ferry rides to islands like Aegina, Hydra, and Mykonos.

Ready to start your Greek adventure?

Click Apply Now and let Next Job Abroad help you make your move to Greece a reality!

jobs.title: Ryhmäliikunnanohjaaja MTC:lle, Tampere (Lielahti)
jobs.description:
**Ryhmäliikunnan ohjaaja MTC:lle, Tampere (Lielahti)**

Etsimme MTC:lle innostavia ryhmäliikunnan ohjaajia, jotka osaa ohjata monipuolisia tunteja, esimerkiksi PUMP, RPV, kehonhuoltoa ja kuntopiirejä. Lisäksi haemme erityisesti myös Pilates ohjaajaa. Jos sinua kiinnostaa, voit halutessasi tehdä myös asiakaspalvelutunteja salillamme.

Valmennuskeskus MTC on matalan kynnyksen liikuntakeskus Lielahdessa, Tampereella. Meillä on lämminhenkinen ja yhteisöllinen meininki: asiakkaamme viihtyvät luonamme, ja moni tulee paikalle myös jutustelemaan, ei vain treenaamaan. Suurin osa asiakkaistamme on keski-ikäisiä ja eläkeikää lähestyviä naisia, joille tärkeintä on arjen toimintakyky ja hyvä olo. Meillä ei siis lasketa kaloreita eikä juosta maratoneja, vaan keskitytään kokonaisvaltaiseen hyvinvointiin ja mukavaan fiilikseen.

Työ koostuu ryhmäliikuntatuntien ohjaamisesta, ja jos kiinnostusta löytyy, mukaan on mahdollista ottaa myös asiakaspalvelua. Ryhmätunnit painottuvat iltapäiviin ja iltoihin, mutta tarjolla on myös aamupäivätunteja.

**Työn alkaminen:** Työ alkaa joustavasti syksyn aikana sopimuksen mukaan.

**Työn muoto:** Alkuvaiheessa työtä tehdään yrittäjänä tai kevytyrittäjänä laskuttaen.

Jos osaat innostaa ryhmää liikkumaan ja haluat olla osa lämminhenkistä ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä, ota yhteyttä ja kerro itsestäsi!

Sähköasentaja konevuokraamoon Ouluun

Etsimme sähköasentajaa vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen tehtävään Oulussa toimivaan konevuokraamoon. Tarjolla on monipuolinen työ, jossa pääset vastaamaan monipuolisesti työmaan ja vuokrattavan kaluston sähköistyksestä.

Sähköasentajana vastaat työmaiden sähköistysratkaisujen toteuttamisesta sekä työmaapääkeskusten asennus-, käyttöönotto- ja ylläpitotöistä. Tehtävä sisältää monipuolisesti sähköasennuksia, kytkentöjä, palautustarkastuksia sekä sähköjärjestelmien huolto-, korjaus- ja muutostöitä. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluu myös vikojen selvittäminen ja tarvittavien korjaustoimenpiteiden toteuttaminen. Työ suoritetaan pääosin asiakkaan toimipisteellä Oulussa, mutta tehtävänkuvaan kuuluu myös säännöllinen käynti työmaakohteissa.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?
Olet etsimämme henkilö, mikäli sinulla on sähköalan koulutus, voimassa oleva S2-pätevyys sekä kokemusta vahvavirtapuolen sähköasennuksista. Aiempi tausta toimitila- tai talosähköpuolen asennuksista antaa sinulle erinomaiset valmiudet tehtävässä menestymiseen

Työskentelet mielelläsi sekä itsenäisesti että osana ammattitaitoista tiimiä. Tartut toimeen oma-aloitteisesti, kannat vastuuta työstäsi ja pidät laadukkaasta työnjäljestä. Arvostamme huolellisuutta, yhteistyökykyä sekä halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi jatkuvasti. Tehtävässä vaaditaan voimassa olevia sähkötyöturvallisuus- ja työturvallisuuskortteja sekä B-ajokorttia.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
Tarjoamme sinulle pitkäaikaisen työmahdollisuuden vakaassa yrityksessä, jossa osaamista arvostetaan ja työntekijöistä pidetään huolta. Saat monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän, jossa pääset hyödyntämään nykyistä osaamistasi ja kasvattamaan ammattitaitoasi edelleen. Ympärilläsi on kannustava työyhteisö sekä kokenut joukko ammattilaisia, jotka tukevat sinua työssäsi. Käytössäsi ovat laadukkaat työvälineet ja työvarusteet, jotka mahdollistavat sujuvan työskentelyn arjessa.

Työtä tehdään arkisin päivävuorossa. Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Palkka määräytyy osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella. Tehtävässä on kiinteä kuukausipalkka.

Klikkaa hakulinkkiä ja kirjaudu Eezy Osaajat -palveluun tai rekisteröidy uutena käyttäjänä. Täytä hakemus tehtävään ja lisää CV – järjestelmä poimii työkokemuksesi automaattisesti profiilillesi.

The Role

You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

What You'll Work On

  • Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

  • Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.

  • World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.

  • Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.

  • Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.

jobs.description:

The Role

You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight.

This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built.

What You'll Work On

  • Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them.

  • Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab.

  • Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change.

  • Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you.

  • Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does.

  • Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test.

  • Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover.

  • Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers.

Who We're Looking For

A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume. You have judgment about what is worth testing: we want a safety net, not a wall of green ticks that hides the real risk. And you are comfortable being the person who says a build is not going out.

Your Background

  • 4+ years in test, validation, reliability, SRE or platform engineering on a product that shipped to customers.

  • Experience with a complex system at scale: autonomous driving, drones, industrial automation, medical devices or similar.

  • Strong Python and/or C++, with solid CI/CD and containerised infrastructure skills.

jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description:
About Flink

Flink Robotics delivers superhuman physical work. We are a Zürich-based deep tech startup developing a physics-based world model that lets machines reason about the physical world and do work robots couldn't do before - starting with logistics.

We're a team of engineers and researchers with roots at ETH Zürich, backed by leading European investors. The technology is ambitious; now we want the way we look and show up to match it.

The role

You make Flink look as cool from the outside as it is on the inside. As our first brand & marketing hire, you own how Flink shows up to the world and help shape how it feels to work here.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership from day one. You'll work directly with the CEO and the whole team, and you'll have real freedom to set the tone. We care more about taste, energy and drive than years of experience; junior profiles are very welcome.

What you'll do

  • Own our look and feel. Evolve and guard Flink's visual identity. Logo use, colours, typography, photo and video style: and make sure everything we put out is consistent.

  • Run our website. Keep flink.so fresh, fast and on-message: new pages, news, job posts, visuals. Work with freelancers or agencies where needed.

  • Build our social presence. Plan and create content for LinkedIn and other channels. Robot footage, behind-the-scenes, team stories, milestones and grow an audience that gets excited about what we do.

  • Run marketing campaigns. Turn our story into campaigns, from product launches and trade fair pushes to customer and recruiting campaigns. You own the creative and the message, and work closely with the Growth team on goals, audiences and channels.

  • Tell our story visually. Create or coordinate photos, videos, graphics and animations of our robots and technology. Support pitch decks, investor updates and sales materials so they look world-class.

  • Organise events. From trade fairs and demo days to meetups, customer visits and team events. Plan them, run them and make them memorable.

  • Make our space amazing. Shape how our office and workshop look and feel, so every visitor - investor, customer or candidate - gets the Flink vibe.

  • Strengthen our employer brand. Help us attract top engineers: careers page, job ads, recruiting content, how candidates experience Flink.

  • Bring the brand inside. Help build team culture through internal communication, onboarding touches, swag; you name it.

What you bring

  • A strong eye for design and visuals: you know what looks great.

  • Creativity and ideas of your own: you don't wait for a brief to start making things

  • Hands-on skills in design tools (e.g. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva) and comfort creating content for social media

  • A portfolio that shows your taste: professional, freelance, student or side projects all count

  • Organisational talent: you can juggle an event, a website update and a video shoot in the same week

  • Excellent written and spoken English

  • Curiosity about technology and robotics: you don't need to be an engineer, but you want to understand what we build

  • First experience in branding, marketing, design or communications (internships count)

Nice to have

  • German (spoken or written)

  • Photo or video shooting and editing skills

  • Experience with website design

  • Interior design, set design or event production experience

  • Previous startup or tech-company experience

What we offer

  • The chance to build a brand from the ground up at a deep tech startup on the rise

  • Real ownership and direct access to the founders: your work is visible from day one

  • Robots, a workshop and a story worth telling: some of the most exciting content in tech, waiting to be shown to the world

  • A growing, ambitious team in Zürich

  • Competitive salary and employee stock options

  • Budget and freedom to try new ideas

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Overview

Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence.

At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence.

We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us.

The Role

You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role.

This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone.

What You Will Do

  • Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships.

  • Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps.

  • Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action.

  • Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is.

  • Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks.

  • Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes.

  • Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination.

Who You Are

  • A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle.

  • Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched.

  • Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers.

  • A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity.

  • High ownership and bias toward action.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others.

  • Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out.

  • Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck.

  • A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too: Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering.

  • Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience.

Requirements

  • Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate.

  • Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia.

  • Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles.

  • Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred.

At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change.

We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence.

With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Industrialization
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.
 
We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.
 
This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.
 
 

The Opportunity

You will join the Industrialization team, the group that turns ANYmal from something engineers can build into something a factory can build, test, and release at volume. Every robot that leaves our production line passes through the test systems this team owns. When those tests are effective, quality issues are caught in Zurich before reaching a customer's industrial site. That is the leverage of this role.Sitting directly at the intersection of software and hardware, you will write Python code to interface with physical devices, help define reliable pass/fail criteria for ANYmal subsystems, and deploy test routines to our manufacturing shopfloor. Working alongside Manufacturing Engineers, test technicians, and hardware design teams, you will gain hands-on experience bridging cutting-edge robotics design with scalable industrial production.
 
 

The Market & Our Technology


ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Founded as an ETH Zurich spin-off, we build autonomous mobile robots (ANYmal) that solve complex inspection tasks in challenging industrial environments such as energy, chemical, and mining facilities. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people in Zurich and work on cutting-edge robot technology that is transforming industrial operations globally.

Your Impact
  • Develop, test, and help deploy Python-based automated test procedures for ANYmal hardware subsystems
  • Instrument and control hardware devices, sensors, and cameras directly through software interfaces
  • Collaborate with test technicians and manufacturing engineers to refine shopfloor testing workflows
  • Learn to write clean, resilient, and reproducible code using established software engineering best practices
  • Contribute directly to test documentation and technician procedures to ensure seamless shopfloor execution

    • Your Profile
  • Ongoing or recently completed degree (BSc or MSc) in Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering
  • Solid Python programming foundation with experience building projects that interact with hardware, sensors, or external APIs
  • Practical hands-on experience with hardware interfaces through university labs, student projects, or personal builds
  • Structured approach to problem-solving and a keen interest in measurement fundamentals like tolerances and repeatability
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfortable explaining technical concepts and drafting structured procedures
  • Proactive mindset with a desire to learn quickly, ask questions early, and work in a hands-on production environment
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Zurich, with a commitment to regular on-site presence near the hardware and shopfloor

    • Bonus Points
  • Experience with ROS or ROS2
  • Basic understanding of image processing or computer vision pipelines (OpenCV)
  • Exposure to sensor calibration techniques (IMU, camera intrinsics/extrinsics, depth, or thermal)
  • Familiarity with Docker or devcontainer environments
  • Background in student engineering teams such as Formula Student, Swissloop, or ARIS Rocketry, especially on testing or integration
    • Internship Details:
     
    Start date: any time of the year and always on the 1st of the month
    Duration: 6 months 
    Workload: 100% (Full time, Onsite)
     
    Who can apply:
    EU applicants for internships
    The internship can be voluntary
    A work permit is not required but the candidate needs a residence permit
    Must be enrolled in a University
     
    Non-EU applicants for internships:
    Internship must be mandatory (supported by a letter from a university)
    A work permit is required
    Must reside in CH
     
     
    Interested? Submit your application
    We will contact you if your skills and experience are a good fit for the team and the role. Please note due to the high load of applications we will only contact those that are relevant. Thank you for your understanding.
     
    What We Offer:
    - Hands-on experience working on advanced locomotion software.
    - Mentorship from industry experts.
    - Opportunities to contribute to innovative projects.
    - A dynamic and collaborative work environment.
    - Potential for future full-time opportunities.
     
    We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive and fun environment in the city of Zurich.

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.

Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.

Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.

Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.

Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.

Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.

Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.

External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring

  • Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists

  • You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it

  • Month-end close ownership across two or more legal entities in different currencies

  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606, applied to at least one revenue model without clean precedent, and defended to an auditor

  • You operate in the detail. You build the calendar, do the reconciliations, and touch the ledger

  • Experience developing a small team or a single direct report

Nice to have

  • Active CPA license

  • Usage-based or consumption billing experience, particularly Tabs, Metronome, Maxio, or similar

  • Public accounting background, especially audit

  • Software development capitalization under ASC 350-40, including the time capture that makes it auditable

  • Experience replacing manual accounting work with automation, and a clear view on what should stay manual

  • Swiss entity experience, including CHF functional currency and Swiss statutory or VAT exposure

  • Digital assets, payments, or regulated financial services exposure

Benefits

Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere! $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment. MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs. Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need. Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

Apply Today!

If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. Notabene considers a broad array of candidates, including those without blockchain experience. Whether you're returning to work after a gap in employment, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar.

Notabene is proud to be an equal employment workplace and an affirmative action employer. By valuing inclusion and diversity of all forms, we strictly prohibit and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, ancestry, citizenship, sexual orientation.

jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive III to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer, not just closing the deal in front of them. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role carries real weight. You'll be responsible for a book of enterprise accounts where the deals are complex, the buying committees are large, and the technical bar is high. There's meaningful room here to shape how your territory gets built, not just execute against someone else's plan.

As an Enterprise Account Executive III, you'll own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, working alongside sales engineering, customer success, and leadership to get complex deals across the line. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large, strategic accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Build and drive strategic account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and executive buyers.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure smooth handoff after close.

  • Represent Camunda's value to senior leaders and technical buyers, tailoring the pitch to what each audience actually cares about.

  • Forecast accurately and manage pipeline health with discipline, not optimism.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Significant experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end, ideally six figures or more, with a track record across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

  • Comfort navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked deals with C-suite, IT, legal, and procurement in the room at the same time, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Strong territory and account planning instincts. You can build a plan independently, not just work from a list handed to you, and you know how to prioritize where your time actually pays off.

  • The ability to sell technical products credibly. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage here, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

  • Negotiation experience under genuine pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

  • A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor, and you know what it took to earn that.

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United Kingdom: £176,600.00 to £290,500.00

  • Singapore: S$349,400.00 to S$524,000.00

  • Canada: C$298,700 to C$491,300

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Statuta Dječjeg vrtića „Mali svijet“ i Odluke Upravnog vijeća od 29.09.2026.g., Dječji vrtić „Mali svijet“, Kamenjak 6, Pula objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za radno mjesto
  • Odgojitelj/ica, na određeno, nepuno radno vrijeme od 20 sati tjedno radi povećanog opsega posla za razdoblje do 31.08.2027.g. (produljeni rad vrtića), 1 izvršitelj.
Kandidati moraju udovoljavati sljedećim uvjetima: 1. imati vrstu i razinu obrazovanja za odgojitelja sukladno članku 24. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne Novine“, broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26) 2. utvrđenu zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta iz ovog natječaja 3. da ne postoje zapreke iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne Novine“, broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26). Na oglašeno radno mjesto mogu se prijaviti kandidati oba spola. Riječi i pojmovi koji imaju rodno značenje koji se koriste u natječaju za osobe u muškom rodu uporabljeni su neutralno i odnose se na muške i ženske osobe. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu zamolbu treba priložiti sljedeće: 1. Životopis 2. Dokaz o državljanstvu 3. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta odgovarajuće vrste i razine obrazovanja određene ovim natječajem 4. Elektronički zapis mirovinskog staža Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne stariji od dana objave natječaja) 5. Dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno članku 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26): - potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz stavka 1. članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26) ne starije od dana objave natječaja - potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak za neko od prekršajnih djela iz stavka 3. članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26) ne starije od dana objave natječaja - potvrdu Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidatu nije izrečena mjera žurnog izdvajanja djeteta iz obitelji iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26) ne starije od dana objave natječaja -potvrdu da kandidatu nije izrečena mjera za zaštitu osobnih prava i dobrobiti djeteta u nadležnosti suda iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26) ne starije od dana objave natječaja. Navedeni dokazi prilažu se u izvorniku ili presliku koji ne treba biti ovjeren, a izabrani kandidat dužan je prije izbora predočiti izvornik ili ovjerene preslike navedenih dokumenata. Ako kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (preslik vjenčanog ili rodnog lista i sl.). Uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnoga mjesta izabrani kandidat dužan je dostaviti po obavijesti o izboru, a prije zasnivanja radnog odnosa. Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti po Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), Zakonu o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), Zakonu o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21, 13/26) te Zakonu o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu sa Zakonom o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, po Zakonu o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21, 13/26) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu sa Zakonom o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Dokaz o invaliditetu smatraju se javne isprave na temelju kojih se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom iz članka 13. navedenog Zakona. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Osoba koja ne podnese pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja, neće se smatrati kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj. Rok za podnošenje prijava s potrebnim dokazima o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta natječaja je najmanje 8 dana od dana objave natječaja na web stranici Dječjeg vrtića „Mali svijet“, na oglasnoj ploči i web stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje – podružnica Pula. Pisane prijave s dokumentacijom o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja potrebno je dostaviti poštom na adresu: Dječji vrtić „Mali svijet“ , Upravno vijeće Kamenjak 6, 52100 Pula s naznakom „Prijava na Natječaj za izbor odgojitelja na određeno (produljeni rad vrtića)-ne otvaraj“ ili osobno u tajništvo vrtića na adresu: Dječji vrtić „Mali svijet“, Upravno vijeće Kamenjak 6, 52100 Pula s naznakom „Prijava na Natječaj za izbor odgojitelja na određeno (produljeni rad vrtića) -ne otvaraj“ O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni najkasnije u roku od petnaest (15) dana od dana donošenja Odluke o izboru kandidata na web stranici vrtića www.dvmalisvijet.hr Dječji vrtić „Mali svijet“ zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja. Prijavom na ovaj natječaj kandidat potvrđuje da je upoznat s pravnim temeljem prikupljanja osobnih podataka i njegove svrhe, kao i o zaštiti njihova čuvanja, te njihovim pravima, a sve u skladu s Uredbom (EU) broja 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i vijeća od dana 27. travnja 2016. godine o zaštiti pojedinca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka. Kandidat prijavom na ovaj natječaj daje suglasnost Dječjem vrtiću „Mali svijet“ na prikupljanje i obradu svojih osobnih podataka u svrhe natječajnog postupka kao i suglasnost za objavu istih na web stranici i oglasnoj ploči vrtića kao rezultata natječaja. Informaciju o zaštiti osobnih podataka, te s tim u svezi navedene kontakte možete saznati na web stranici vrtića www.dvmalisvijet.hr

jobs.title: DOSTAVLJAČ/DOSTAVLJAČICA
jobs.description:
Opis poslova:
  • dostava robe kupcima
  • utovar i istovar robe
  • briga o vozilu i urednosti dokumentacije
  • komunikacija s kupcima i timom
Poslodavac traži:
  • vozačka dozvola B kategorije
  • odgovornost i točnost u radu
Poslodavac nudi:
  • službeno vozilo
  • mogućnost dugoročne suradnje

jobs.title: PRODAVAČ/PRODAVAČICA U PEKARI
jobs.description:
Tražimo odgovornu i komunikativnu osobu za radno mjesto prodavača/prodavačice u pekari u samom centru grada. Nudimo rad isključivo u jutarnjoj smjeni od 06:30 do 14:30 sati, odličnu i lako dostupnu lokaciju te ugodno radno okruženje.

Opis posla: prodaja pekarskih proizvoda, komunikacija s kupcima, rad na blagajni, slaganje proizvoda na police te održavanje čistoće i urednosti prodajnog prostora.

Od kandidata očekujemo ljubaznost, urednost i odgovornost prema radu.
Iskustvo u trgovini ili ugostiteljstvu je poželjno, ali nije uvjet.

Za dodatne informacije, detalje o plaći i dogovor za razgovor javite se na broj telefona 091 587 8608.

Mogućnost stalnog zaposlenja.

jobs.title: VOZAČ/VOZAČICA TERETNOG VOZILA S PRIKOLICOM
jobs.description: Opis posla: prijevoz teretnim vozilom s prikolicom za međunarodni cestovni prijevoz tereta.

jobs.title: MONTER / MONTERKA NAMJEŠTAJA
jobs.description:
MONTER NAMJEŠTAJA (m/ž)

Benefiti za zaposlenike

  • naknade za prijevoz
  • pogodnosti za kupovinu namještaja
  • Allianz dopunsko zdravstveno osiguranje
  • sustav stimulacije i nagrađivanja
  • slobodni dani za događaje od osobne važnosti

Što nudimo?

  • stabilno zaposlenje i sigurne radne uvjete
  • službeni alat i oprema za montažu
  • ugodno radno okruženje
  • mogućnost dodatnog usavršavanja i napredovanja
  • radno vrijeme organizirano u jutarnjoj smjeni

Tko je idealan kandidat?

  • iskustvo u montaži namještaja ili sličnim poslovima (prednost, ali nije uvjet)
  • sposobnost samostalnog i timskog rada
  • fizička spremnost i spretnost u radu s ručnim alatima
  • vozačka dozvola B kategorije
  • pouzdanost, preciznost i odgovornost u radu

Tvoj posao će biti:

  • montaža namještaja kod kupaca prema uputama i nacrtima
  • priprema i kontrola robe prije montaže

  • Suradnja s dobavljačima usluga
  • Pomoć u organizaciji i administraciji poslovnih putovanja i individualnih i grupnih aranžmana

jobs.title: MEDICINSKA SESTRA/TEHNIČAR/ZDRAVSTVENI RADNIK U PZZ 3 M/Ž
jobs.description:
Na temelju čl. 30. i čl. 33. Statuta 025-01/24-01/8 URBROJ:2186-01-10-24-5 od 11.7.2024., i čl. 24. Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za javne službenike i namještenike ( NN 29/2024) Dom zdravlja Varaždinske županije, raspisuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za prijem u radni odnos na određeno vrijeme na radno mjesto

medicinska sestra/tehničar /zdravstveni radnik u primarnoj zdravstvenoj zaštiti 3

u ord. dentalne medicine na lokaciji Breznica - 1 izvršitelj (m/ž) –

zamjena do povratka na rad privremeno odsutne radnice – uz probni rad.

Na natječaj se pod ravnopravnim uvjetima mogu javiti osobe oba spola.

MEDICINSKA SESTRA/TEHNIČAR/ZDRAVSTVENI RADNIK u primarnoj zdravstvenoj zaštiti 3

Uvjeti:

  • SSS - završena škola za medicinske sestre/tehničare opće njege ili srednja škola za zanimanje dentalni asistent
  • položen stručni ispit (oni koji su u obvezi)
  • odobrenje za samostalni rad-licenca
  • vozačka dozvola B kategorije.

Uz prijavu, kandidati su dužni priložiti:

  1. Zamolbu
  2. Životopis
  3. Presliku dokaza o državljanstvu (osobna iskaznica, putovnica ili domovnica)
  4. Presliku dokaza o stečenoj stručnoj spremi
  5. Odobrenje za samostalni rad
  6. E - zapis o radnom stažu iz HZMO-a
  7. Uvjerenje suda o nekažnjavanju ( ne starije od 6 mjeseci).

Dokumentacija se dostavlja u neovjerenim preslikama, a izabrani kandidat dužan je nakon donošenja odluke o odabiru dostaviti na uvid originalne dokumente.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu Domu zdravlja za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u prijavi u svrhu zapošljavanja, a u skladu s odredbama Opće uredbe o zaštiti osobnih podataka.

Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom podnose se ili preporučenom poštanskom pošiljkom ili osobno na urudžbeni na adresu:

DOM ZDRAVLJA VARAŽDINSKE ŽUPANIJE

Kolodvorska 20, 42 000 Varaždin

„Za natječaj Medicinska sestra/tehničar/ zdravstveni radnik u PZZ

u ord. dentalne med. – Breznica''

Prijave na natječaj podnose se do popunjenja radnog mjesta.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju pod jednakim uvjetima sukladno posebnom propisu, dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dostaviti i dokaze utvrđene posebnim propisom iz kojih je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz kojeg je vidljivo navedeno pravo, dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca, te dokaz da je nezaposlen.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi čl. 102. stavak 1-3 Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članova njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17), da bi ostvarili prednost pri zapošljavanju pod jednakim uvjetima, dužni su priložiti pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta natječaja kao i sve potrebne dokaze navedene u članku 103. stavak 1. navedenog Zakona (link: Zakon o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843)

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN broj 157/13.,152/14 i 39/18.), uz molbu na natječaj dužni su, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje o utvrđenom invaliditetu, odnosno drugi dokaz o invaliditetu.

Dom zdravlja pridržava pravo za kandidate koji ispunjavaju uvjete ovog natječaja provesti testiranje i usmeni razgovor, a o čemu će kandidati biti obaviješteni, putem internetske stranice Doma zdravlja.

Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju.

Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati.

Dom zdravlja Varaždinske županije pridržava pravo, bez obrazloženja, djelomično ili u cijelosti, u svako doba poništiti natječaj bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima.

Rezultati izbora bit će objavljeni u zakonskom roku na oglasnoj ploči i na web-stranici Doma zdravlja Varaždinske županije.

Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 07/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23).
