jobs.title: Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director (m/f)
jobs.description:
Digital Factory - Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Anywhere in Region
Salary: Competitive

Job description
Requisition ID:  1729702

Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Role Overview:

The Associate Director - Digital Solution Lead is accountable for leading a defined portfolio of digital projects for EY Luxembourg's Assurance Service Line. Acting as a program manager equivalent, the role translates Assurance priorities into an executable digital roadmap, governs demand and delivery across multiple squads, and ensures solutions are adopted, controlled, and delivering measurable value. The Digital Solution Lead partners with Assurance leadership, project teams, Digital Architects Team, to deliver high-impact digital capabilities with strong governance, financial discipline, and client-service focus.

Responsibilities:

• Own and manage a defined portfolio of Assurance digital projects from intake and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and benefits realization.
• Translate Assurance Service Line priorities into a practical digital roadmap, aligning portfolio choices with business value, regulatory expectations, user needs, and Digital Factory strategy.
• Lead demand intake, triage, business case shaping, and prioritization with Assurance Partners, Directors, Senior Managers, product owners, and operational stakeholders.
• Establish and run portfolio governance, including steering committee materials, decision logs, RAID management, dependency tracking, and clear escalation routes.
• Manage delivery plans, milestones, scope trade-offs, risks, issues, and interdependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives, intervening directly when delivery confidence is at risk.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across Assurance subject matter experts, business analysts, developers, data engineers, UI/UX, QA, change management, and enabling functions.
• Oversee portfolio budget, capacity planning, resource allocation, and financial tracking, ensuring transparency between planned investment, actual spend, and expected value.
• Ensure digital solutions meet business requirements and EY quality expectations, including data protection, cybersecurity, independence, auditability, risk management, and compliance considerations.
• Drive adoption with Assurance users through stakeholder engagement, communication, training readiness, feedback loops, release planning, and post-implementation support.
• Provide concise, executive-ready reporting to Assurance leadership and Digital Factory governance on progress, value, risks, decisions required, and portfolio health.
• Coach project managers, and delivery teams, building delivery discipline and a culture of accountability across the portfolio.
• Promote reuse, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across Assurance digital assets, delivery practices, and operating model ways of working.

Expectations:

• Act as a trusted advisor to Assurance leadership, able to challenge priorities constructively and recommend pragmatic portfolio decisions.
• Operate with senior judgment, balancing strategic portfolio ownership with hands-on delivery support when projects require intervention.
• Influence effectively in a matrix environment, aligning senior stakeholders who may have different commercial, operational, technical, and risk perspectives.
• Represent the Digital Factory in Assurance forums with credibility, clarity, and a strong understanding of how digital delivery improves audit quality, efficiency, and user experience.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Project Management, Finance, Audit, or a related field.
• Experience in digital transformation or software/product delivery or program management, ,
• Proven track record leading teams, engagements, budgets, dependencies, risks, and measurable business outcomes.
• Experience in Assurance, audit, professional services, financial services, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred; willingness to build Assurance domain depth quickly is essential.
• Command of Project Management and Agile delivery methods, with the ability to apply governance pragmatically rather than mechanically.
• Working knowledge of digital solution delivery, including data and analytics, workflow automation, AI-enabled capabilities, integration considerations, testing, release management, and support transition.
• Strong financial management, capacity planning, benefits tracking, and executive reporting capabilities.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate between business, operational, and technical audiences.
• People leadership experience, including coaching delivery contributors and building high-performing teams in a matrix organization.
• Fluent English is required.

Preferred Experience and Certifications:

• Recognized project, program, product, or agile certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, SAFe, Scrum Master, or Product Owner are an asset.
• Experience with delivery and collaboration platforms such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, or equivalent enterprise tooling.
• Exposure to audit technology, data governance, automation, AI adoption, or digital operating model transformation in a professional services environment.

What we offer you

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
EY  |  Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Our offer of employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and pre-screening requirements. The candidate acknowledges that all information provided must be accurate.

jobs.title: Staff Services Supervisor (m/f)
jobs.description:
Staff Services Supervisor (m/f/d)

Job Description

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. If you are eager to learn, are interested in growing rapidly and strive to make an impact in a diverse environment, you're in the right place at the right time.

Learn more about Careers at KPMG Luxembourg
We are seeking a Staff Services Supervisor (m/f/d) to join our Facilities team.
As a Workplace Supervisor, you will play a key role in coordinating the team, overseeing daily operations and ensuring a consistently high level of employee and internal client satisfaction.

You will be responsible for:

•    Coordinating daily Staff Services operations and ensuring high-quality service delivery.
•    Planning and organizing work, including timelines, resource allocation and prioritization.
•    Managing and monitoring multiple activities and projects simultaneously, ensuring effective follow-up.
•    Supervising, coaching and supporting a team of junior staff members.
•    Organizing schedules, prioritizing workloads, delegating effectively and managing team capacity.
•    Acting as a primary point of contact for external service providers, overseeing contracts and managing attendance schedules.
•    Monitoring employee and internal client satisfaction, collecting feedback and coordinating appropriate actions.
•    Developing and contributing to high-quality internal concierge services and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
•    Strengthening the visibility of the team and developing effective relationships with other internal teams.
•    Ensuring service delivery, processes and deadlines are met in line with internal standards, service commitments and employee expectations.
What you will be working on

You will lead and support the continuous development of Staff Services, including:

•    Supervising daily operational activities and ensuring consistent service quality.
•    Leading, training and mentoring team members to deliver exceptional, hotel-grade service standards.
•    Managing team schedules, workloads and priorities to ensure efficient resource allocation.
•    Monitoring activities and preparing regular performance reports and KPIs.
•    Identifying operational gaps, analyzing root causes and proposing sustainable solutions.
•    Leading operational projects from needs identification and business case development through to provider engagement, process design, testing, deployment and change communication.
•    Identifying opportunities for process improvements, efficiency gains and operational innovation.
•    Developing and expanding concierge service offerings and identifying new value-adding services and partnerships.
•    Supporting the development of team members through regular feedback, coaching and individual development plans.
•    Fostering a motivating work environment that encourages initiative, continuous improvement and the sharing of best practices.

What we look for

•    A graduate-level qualification.
•    At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar position.
•    Proven experience in supervising a team and managing administrative activities.
•    Strong project and team management skills, including performance management and decision-making.
•    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
•    Excellent organizational, prioritization and time management skills.
•    A pragmatic and solution-oriented approach, with strong problem-solving capabilities.
•    Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
•    Strong client and employee orientation, with a focus on service quality and satisfaction.
•    Experience in team leadership and people management, with the ability to coach, motivate and develop staff.

Description de tâches:

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

CDI – Temps plein – Kleinbettingen (Luxembourg)
Rejoignez un acteur industriel engagé de l'alimentation européenne
Entreprise familiale indépendante fondée au Luxembourg, Les Moulins de Kleinbettingen est un acteur reconnu de la transformation céréalière en Europe.
Depuis onze générations, nous développons un savoir-faire solide dans la fabrication de produits destinés à l'alimentation humaine: farines, semoules, mixes et solutions alimentaires à destination des artisans, industriels et de la grande distribution.

Notre développement repose sur trois piliers essentiels:  qualité – innovation – respect des ressources naturelles

Dans le cadre du développement de nouvelles activités industrielles, nous renforçons nos équipes afin d'accompagner notre croissance et de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence sur l'ensemble de nos lignes de fabrication.

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

Votre mission:

Intégrez une équipe dynamique et participez activement à la fabrication de produits agroalimentaires de qualité.
Sous la responsabilité du Chef d'équipe Production, vous contribuez à la transformation des matières premières en produits finis dans le respect des standards de qualité, d'hygiène, de sécurité et de performance industrielle.
Ce poste vous offre une réelle polyvalence au cœur de l'atelier : vous intervenez sur différentes étapes de la production et pouvez être amené(e) à occuper plusieurs postes selon les besoins. Cette diversité des tâches vous permet de développer vos compétences, de gagner en autonomie et de jouer un rôle clé dans la fluidité de la production.

Vos principales responsabilités:

Production

• Assurer la conduite et la surveillance des équipements d'extrusion.
• Effectuer le suivi des paramètres de production et signaler toute anomalie.
• Veiller au respect des objectifs de production, de qualité et de rendement.
• Réaliser les changements de production selon les procédures établies.

Contrôle qualité

• Effectuer les contrôles horaires des produits en cours de fabrication.
• Réaliser et enregistrer les résultats des contrôles dans le système de gestion de la qualité.
• Prélever des échantillons et effectuer des analyses simples au laboratoire de production:
• Identifier les écarts de qualité et informer la hiérarchie en cas de non-conformité.

Gestion des matières premières

• Assurer le vidage et l'approvisionnement des matières premières nécessaires à la production.
• Contrôler la disponibilité et la conformité des matières utilisées.
• Participer à la gestion des stocks de matières premières selon les procédures en vigueur.

Packaging et préparation de commandes

• Réaliser les opérations de conditionnement et d'emballage des produits finis.
• Vérifier la conformité de l'étiquetage et du conditionnement.
• Préparer les commandes selon les instructions de production et les exigences clients.
• Assurer la traçabilité des produits emballés.

Entretien et nettoyage

• Effectuer le nettoyage régulier des équipements, des postes de travail et des zones de production.
• Respecter les procédures d'hygiène, de sécurité et de nettoyage en vigueur.
• Participer aux opérations de maintenance de premier niveau.

Conditions particulières

• Travail posté selon les besoins de la production.
• Port des équipements de protection individuelle obligatoire.
• Respect strict des procédures qualité, sécurité et hygiène.

Perspectives d'évolution

Ce poste offre une réelle perspective d'évolution vers une fonction de Chef d'équipe Production.
Selon votre engagement, votre maîtrise des équipements et votre capacité à coordonner les activités de production, vous pourrez progressivement évoluer vers un rôle à responsabilités comprenant:

• Encadrement opérationnel d'une équipe de production
• Organisation et suivi des plannings de fabrication
• Coordination des changements de production
• Support technique et organisationnel aux opérateurs
• Contribution active à la performance globale de la ligne

Un accompagnement interne et des formations pourront être proposés afin de soutenir cette évolution.

Compétences requises

• Formation technique, industrielle ou agroalimentaire (ou expérience équivalente)
• Une première expérience en production est un atout, mais non obligatoire
• Vous êtes rigoureux(se), impliqué(e) et appréciez le travail en équipe
• Vous avez le sens des responsabilités et de la qualité
• Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement industriel structuré
• Vous êtes disponible pour travailler en horaires postés
• Vous maîtrisez le français
• L'anglais et/ou l'allemand constitue un avantage

Nous offrons

• Une entreprise familiale solide et reconnue au niveau européen
• Un environnement industriel moderne en pleine évolution
• Un poste concret, formateur et polyvalent
• Une formation complète à nos procédés et équipements
• Une équipe engagée et un management de proximité
• Une véritable opportunité d'évolution vers un poste de Chef d'équipe Production

Job Description:  
It's never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.  

At Vistra our purpose is progress. We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Risk Manager. Reporting to the Managing Director, this full-time and permanent position is based in Luxembourg and offers regional coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact to our Operations and its' growth.

Purpose of the Role

The Risk Officer supports the permanent risk management function under the direction of the Conducting Officer and contributes to the effective implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies.

The role involves monitoring investment and operational risks, overseeing risk limits and controls, supporting regulatory and internal reporting obligations, including Annex IV reporting, and ensuring timely escalation of relevant risk matters where appropriate.

The successful candidate will work closely with internal IFM functions and external stakeholders, including valuation, portfolio management delegates, compliance, and oversight functions, to promote effective risk governance and transparent communication across the organisation.

The position requires strong analytical and organisational capabilities, a good command of risk system applications and reporting tools, and a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.

The Risk Officer is expected to contribute actively to the continuous development and optimisation of risk processes and controls, demonstrating flexibility, collaboration, and clear communication skills in a dynamic environment. Exposure to UCITS risk management frameworks would be considered an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Risk monitoring for alternative investment funds

• Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies, including risk monitoring, controls, and limit oversight.
• Perform regular risk reporting activities, including contribution to Annex IV reporting, escalation of breaches or anomalies, and maintenance of accurate risk data within risk management systems.
• Contribute to the enhancement of risk management processes, systems, and operational procedures by identifying practical improvements and supporting the implementation of efficient and scalable solutions
• Responsible of the accuracy and timeliness in the production of risk assessment, analysis and reporting including annex IV.
• Perform the monitoring of investment compliance of the AIFs
• Support the development and enhancement of internally developed risk IT tools, including testing of new reporting solutions, data aggregation processes, controls, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the accuracy and reliability of risk analytics and reporting.

Client management

• Serve as a key contact for clients on risk management matters, ensuring appropriate escalation of relevant issues to senior members of the permanent risk management function. Support the delivery of regular client reporting and communication on risk exposures, risk monitoring, and related risk management matters, while responding to client queries in a timely and professional manner.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Liaise effectively with internal IFM functions including portfolio management, valuation, compliance, to ensure consistent risk governance and information flow. Present risk findings and reports to AIF senior management.
  
Attributes/Technical Skills

• Good knowledge of alternative investment fund risk management frameworks for liquid and illiquid strategies.
• Understanding of AIFMD regulatory requirements and Annex IV reporting obligations.
• Experience with risk monitoring tools, limit management systems, and risk reporting applications Knowledge of market, liquidity, counterparty, leverage, and operational risk measurement methodologies.
• Ability to analyse and interpret portfolio risk metrics and exposure reports.
• Familiarity with data aggregation, reconciliation controls, and risk data quality processes
• Exposure to user acceptance testing (UAT) and enhancement of internally developed risk systems and reporting tools
• Good command of Excel and risk reporting tools; knowledge of Power BI, SQL, or data visualisation tools would be an advantage
• Understanding of fund structures, valuation processes, and delegated portfolio management oversight within an IFM/AIFM environment
• Ability to identify control gaps and contribute to process improvement initiatives in a regulated environment.

Relevant Experience

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, or a related field.

Marketing & Communication Manager | SEB, Luxembourg

SEB is a leading international financial services group with a strong and well-established client base among both corporate and financial institutions. We consistently earn recognition for our expertise and customer centric approach, achievements made possible by truly listening to our clients, committing to quality and trust, and fostering an entrepreneurial mindset throughout the organization.  

SEB Luxembourg branch serves as the hub for Private Wealth Management & Family Office (PWM&FO) services to Nordic nationals living abroad. As part of the new strategy for PWM&FO we aim to become the leading wealth accumulator in our core markets and that requires a state-of-the-art core banking offering and financial infrastructure. It is also the base for many of SEB's funds and offers global custody and related depositary services to financial institutions.

SEB in Luxembourg has supported our home market clients with their international needs since 1973. Today the Branch has approximately 170 employees of over 25 different nationalities.

About the role

You will be part of a team, executing on an ambitious growth and transformation agenda. We foster an inclusive leadership culture built on empowerment and involvement to creating an environment where innovation can thrive.  
As the Marketing & Communication Manager for SEB AB Luxembourg Branch, your responsibilities stretch across borders, including PWM&FO in Luxembourg, Singapore, Norway, Finland and the United Kingdom, as well as our support offices in Nice and Switzerland. You will act as a strategic partner to the business, supporting growth and development by aligning marketing and communication activities with business objectives.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Overall responsibility for the coordination and implementation of the SEB Group Marketing and Communications approach in relation to corporate branding, visual and written identity. Daily tasks include maintenance and development of templates, internal awareness-raising and education activities, and providing advice on sponsoring and other branding matters.
• Maintaining close collaboration with the SEB Group Marketing and Communications department, other relevant stakeholders across the business division, and external parties.
• Responsible for production, distribution and record-keeping of marketing materials, including product sheets, sales material, newsletters, brochures, advertisements and event invitations, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment with cross-border policies and standards.  
• Support the planning and coordination of events in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, including the creation and distribution of invitations and follow-up activities.
• Responsible for external and internal communications, including production, distribution and record-keeping of client letters, newsletters, reports, statements, social media content and press materials. Support the bank`s employer branding, employee engagement and networking activities.
• Own & manage the banks of web and digital channels, including  creation, publication, and maintenance of content in internal and external platforms.
• Support the development of marketing and communication initiatives that strengthen the SEB brand and support business priorities.

To thrive in this role, we believe you have:

We believe you will bring a combination of marketing and communication expertise, strong project management capabilities, and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, taking ownership of your responsibilities while maintaining a structured approach to delivering high-quality results.
You demonstrate integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive information, communicate effectively with wide range of stakeholders and can combine practical problem-solving skills with analytical thinking.

In addition, you have:

• At least 3 years of working experience, with proven track record of working with Marketing and / or Communication.
• A bachelor's or master's degree within Marketing or another relevant field
• Experience planning and coordinating marketing and communication initiative across multiple channels
• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite tools such as InDesign, Photoshop and Illustrator, combined with strong Microsoft Office skills
• Fluency in written and spoken English and Swedish, or other Scandinavian languages
• Knowledge of any of the three official languages in Luxembourg (French, German, Luxembourgish) is considered a strong advantage in dealing with local stakeholders, press and other external stakeholders.

What we offer

We offer many experiences and benefits to our employees, and there is nuance to every individual's career experience, but the elements that define the core of our offering are:

• Innovative company at the forefront of technology international opportunities and working environment
• Attractive compensation and access to SEB staff banking with exclusive benefits 
• A flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of views
• Possibility to work from home part of the working time
• A diverse, inclusive and equal environment with focus on health & wellbeing

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.  
Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts:
https://sebgroup.com/career & https://bit.ly/SEBcareer

Ready to join?

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application with your CV and Cover Letter in English as soon as possible, but at the latest on 13 October 2026.

Please be informed that candidate selected for this role will need to provide their Criminal Record Certificate and a name screening against sanctions list will be performed as a part of the background check process.

SD-26150-POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN CARBON FIBRE SURFACE ENGINEERING AND COMPOSITE MANUFACTURING
Fixed term contract | Hautcharage | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

You will be mainly in charge of:

·        Developing and optimising carbon fibre recovery and recycling processes, with a focus on preserving fibre quality and length.
·        Investigating and optimising fibre surface treatments and sizing strategies to improve fibre–matrix compatibility and interfacial performance.
·        Developing fibre alignment strategies and semi-finished products based on recovered carbon fibres.
·        Manufacturing and optimising recycled carbon fibre composite materials and components using suitable processing routes.
·        Performing mechanical and microstructural characterisation and evaluating structure–process–property relationships.
·        Contributing to the manufacturing and validation of composite demonstrators.
·        Analysing and communicating research results through technical reports, scientific publications and presentations.

Education

·        PhD in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Polymer/Composite Engineering or a closely related field.
·        A strong research background in composite materials, preferably involving surface engineering, carbon-fibre-reinforced polymers and/or recycling.

Experience and skills

·        Strong background in fibre-reinforced polymer composites and composite manufacturing.
·        Experience in carbon fibre recycling, surface treatment and/or sizing.
·        Experience in composite processing and mechanical/material characterisation.
·        Knowledge of fibre alignment and semi-finished product manufacturing would be an asset.
·        Ability to independently plan, conduct and analyse experimental research.
·        Strong communication, scientific writing and teamwork skills.

Language skills

•              Fluency in English, oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

jobs.description:
Je recherche aujourd'hui pour un de mes clients, basé à Guyancourt, une ou un Gestionnaire Middle-office référentiels données de marché.

Vous rejoignez l'équipe Middle Office Référentiel - Market Data Administration, qui a pour vocation de gérer l'ensemble des données de marché que ce soit pour les prix (données dynamiques) ou pour les descriptions des différents instruments financiers (données statiques) : actions, obligations, futures, options listées, warrants etc.
Pour cela, le Middle Référentiel utilise les flux des différents providers : Reuters, Bloomberg.et procède à un certain nombre de contrôles afin de fiabiliser ces données avant de valider leur diffusion à l'ensemble des acteurs concernés dont notamment : les Front Offices, les Middle Offices opérationnels, la Direction des Risques ainsi que les Back Offices et la Comptabilité pour l'établissement des résultats comptables.

Dans ce cadre,
- vous gérez le référentiel de données de marché via son processus d'acquisition-contrôle-distribution ;
- vous paramétrez et maintenez les instruments dans l'ensemble des systèmes d'information de la Banque ;
- vous gérez les projets au travers d'une participation de Market Data Administration à tous les projets de la Banque ayant un impact sur les données de marché.

De formation spécialisée en Banque/Finance/Gestion (à partir de Bac+5), vous possédez idéalement une première expérience (stage, intérim, apprentissage, CDD.) sur un poste similaire idéalement sur du Middle-office sur les instruments financiers, sur des données de marché ou plus globalement sur les activités de marché.
Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des outils de bureautique usuels.
Un bon niveau d'anglais est indispensable du fait de l'usage quotidien dans un contexte international.

Vous êtes reconnu pour votre rigueur, votre capacité d'analyse, votre capacité à gérer des dead lines serrées du fait de l'interaction avec les Front-offices, votre force de travail et de proposition, votre indépendance, votre esprit d'équipe.

Le poste est basé à Guyancourt (78) dans un campus verdoyant qui vous réserve bien des surprises.
Cette mission d'intérim s'étale sur 6 mois potentiellement renouvelable.

La rémunération brute annuelle fixe est comprise entre 40 et 45 K€ selon le profil.
Un modèle de travail hybride est prévu, avec minimum 2 jours par semaine de télétravail après la validation du manager.


Processus :

Si votre profil correspond, nous échangerons par téléphone pour faire un point sur votre parcours et votre projet professionnel.
Nous validerons ensemble si le poste correspond à vos critères de recherche et les attentes du client.
Si tel est le cas, nous nous rencontrerons en entretien, puis un rendez-vous sera organisé avec votre futur responsable.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Specialist - Island of Ireland (Restaurator/in im Steinmetz- und Steinbildhauerhandwerk/Master Professional für Restaurierung im Handwerk)
jobs.description:
Introduction

Elementar UK, part of the Elementar Group, is responsible for the sales and support of the expanding range of Elemental Analysers and related instruments in the UK as well as being an award-winning manufacturer of Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometer (IRMS) systems covering a diverse and exciting range of applications.

We research and develop for basic human needs: Our devices ensure quality of life and are used when it comes to water, food, education, health, the environment, climate, energy or product quality.

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Technical Sales Specialist to generate sustainable and profitable growth for Elementar products and services. This is an exciting opportunity to drive the growth of Elementar's innovative solutions across Ireland and Northern Ireland, taking ownership of a high-potential territory and building lasting customer partnerships.

This is a remote-based role for someone passionate about scientific instrumentation, value-led selling, and developing long-term customer relationships in a technical, solution-focused environment. You will play a key role in expanding our presence by combining strong commercial acumen with a genuine curiosity for scientific and industrial applications.

You’ll work closely with our team in Greater Manchester, where our facilities support the assembly and testing, and house a dedicated Application lab and full R&D team, providing the expertise and resources needed to deliver exceptional customer solutions.

Duties & Responsibilities

In this role, you will take full ownership of the sales cycle - from prospecting through to closing business and nurturing long-term customer relationships. You will actively develop new sales opportunities by understanding customer needs and applying our technologies to deliver value-driven solutions.

A key part of your role will be presenting both technical and commercial arguments with clarity and confidence, demonstrating how our products and services solve real-world challenges.

You will develop and execute a local business plan in partnership with the Sales Manager, ensuring alignment with growth targets and market opportunities. You'll use market insights and industry trends to identify opportunities, shape local strategy and drive continued growth across your territory, while maintaining accurate sales reporting and forecasting.

Working closely with local service and support teams & the application lab, you will deliver an outstanding customer experience from product demonstration through to after-sales support, while contributing to wider UK sales initiatives when required.

Experience, Essential Skills and Person

We are looking for someone with a degree in a scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent experience) and at least 5 years’ experience in scientific instrumentation sales or a strong background in technical commercial environments. Experience working with CRM systems such as SAP would be advantageous.

The ideal candidate have a proven track record of winning new business through value-led selling and the ability to identify and convert opportunities within a technical sales environment. You will thrive in an autonomous role, balancing strategic territory development with effective pipeline management to consistently deliver results.

You will possess strong communication skills and be equally comfortable engaging with scientific specialists and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex concepts into meaningful customer value. You should be confident in negotiation, resilient in the face of challenges, and committed to delivering excellent customer experiences. A collaborative mindset, adaptability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving are key to success in this role.

This role requires residence in the Repub

jobs.title: Majandusosakonna juhataja
jobs.description:
Türi Vallavalitsus otsib majandusosakonna juhatajat

Tööülesanded: 1) juhataja korraldab iseseisvalt ja koostöös osakonna teenistujatega ning asjaomaste hallatavate
asutustega teede ja tänavate ehitust, remonti, haldamist ning korrashoidu, keskkonnakaitset, vallas ehituse, ehitiste ja maakorralduse ning muinsuskaitsega seotud ülesannete täitmist, kalmistute haldamist ning jäätmemajanduse korraldamist, maakorraldust, energeetikat, kanalisatsiooni, haljastust, valla vara kasutamise korraldamist ja hulkuvate loomadega seonduvat tegevust ning vajadusel teisi vallamajandusega seonduvaid küsimusi; 2) korraldab majandusosakonna teenistujatele nende ametijuhendites loetletud ülesannete täitmiseks vajalike tingimuste loomist ja tagamist; 3) koostab koostöös vallavanemaga osakonna teenistujate ametijuhendid; 4) teeb juhul, kui asendamine ei ole tagatud teenistusülesannetega, vallavanemale ettepanekuid osakonna ametnike asendamiseks ning ametnikele tulemuspalga ja lisatasu määramiseks; 5) korraldab kontrolli majandusosakonna tegevusvaldkondades kasutatavate materiaalsete ja eelarveliste vahendite üle; 6) korraldab majandusosakonna pädevuses olevate eluvaldkondade arengukavade, tööplaanide, õigusaktide ja muude dokumentide eelnõude koostamist ning nende elluviimist; 7) informeerib Türi Vallavolikogu, Türi Vallavalitsust ja kodanikke vajadusel majandusosakonna tegevusest; 8) kaitseb ametiasutuse ning kodanike huve majandusosakonna tegevusvaldkondadesse puutuvates küsimustes; 9) teeb koostööd oma ülesannete täitmisel teiste ametiasutuse osakondade, vallavalitsuse liikmete, vallaasutuste juhtide, vallavolikogu komisjonide ning teiste isikute ja organisatsioonidega; 10) koordineerib oma tegevusvaldkonnas rahastamisplaanide koostamist ning vallaeelarve menetlemist; 11) osaleb projektitöös vallaeelarvele lisaks täiendavate rahaliste vahendite taotlemisel, kasutamisel ning vastava aruandluse tegemisel; 12) korraldab oma tegevusvaldkonnas tehnilis-majanduslike põhjenduste väljatöötamist, projekteerimist, vastavalt riigihangete seadusele hankemenetlust koos vastava aruandlusega, ehituslepingute sõlmimist ning juhib ehitustegevust selle kõigis etappides; 13) osaleb ehitiste ja rajatiste ülevaatuskomisjonide töös; 14) võtab teenistusülesannete täitmisel vastu juriidilisi ja füüsilisi isikuid; 15) kontrollib oma tegevusvaldkonnas valla omandis olevate ehitiste ehituslikku seisundit, teeb nende remondiks ettepanekuid, kogub uute objektide renoveerimis-ja ehitusprojektide tellimiseks lähtematerjale ning valmistab ette ja korraldab uute objektide ehituskonkursse; 16) teostab järelevalvet oma tegevusvaldkonnas valla objektidel ehitus- ja remonttööde üle; 17) peab, hoiab korras ja säilitab toimikute loetelule vastavaid toimikuid ja registreid; 18) teostab osakonna ametnike katseaja-, arengu- ja hindamisvestlused. 3.2 Majandusosakonna juhataja korraldab oma osakonna siseselt ametnike asendamise või asendab ise edasilükkamatute ametiülesannete täitmisel, kui osakonna ametniku avaliku võimu teostamise õigus on ajutiselt peatatud või ta on tööülesannetest vabastatud järgmistel juhtudel: 1) põhi- ja lapsepuhkuse ajal; 2) täiskasvanute koolituse seaduse tähenduses õppepuhkuse ajal; 3) ravikindlustuse seaduse tähenduses ajutise töövõimetuse ajal; 4) distsiplinaarmenetluse ajaks ajutiselt teenistusülesannete täitmisest vabastamise ajal; 5) õppekogunemise ajal, samuti ajaks, kui reservväelane mobilisatsiooni tõttu ei saa täita oma teenistusülesandeid. Käesoleva punkti alapunktides 2-5 sätestatud alustel asendamine on ametniku teenistuskohustuseks mitte rohkem kui 30 kalendripäeva aastas.

Omalt poolt pakume: vastutusrikast ja mitmekesist tööd;
võimalust panustada Türi valla arengusse; toetavat ja koostööle suunatud meeskonda; võimalust kasutada töösõitudeks ametiautot või saada isikliku sõiduauto kasutamise eest hüvitist; enesetäiendamise ja erialase arengu võimalusi; tervise- ja spordikulude hüvitamist; 35 kalendripäeva põhipuhkust; kolme tasustatud tervisepäeva kalendriaastas. Töötasu on katseajal 2800 eurot bruto kuus ning pärast katseaja edukat läbimist 3000 eurot bruto kuus.

Muud nõuded: juhtimiskogemust või valmisolekut vastutada meeskonna ja valdkonna juhtimise eest;
head organiseerimis-, analüüsi- ja otsustusvõimet; väga head suhtlemis- ja koostööoskust; vastutustunnet, algatusvõimet ja lahendustele orienteeritust;

jobs.title: Vi søger en passioneret underviser i tysk til Ballerup
jobs.description:
Er du passioneret omkring det tyske sprog og kultur? Har du lyst til at dele din viden med 6–8 motiverede kursister i et professionelt og fleksibelt undervisningsmiljø? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Lengua‑Global søger en kompetent og engageret underviser i tysk til medarbejdere fra en spændende virksomhed i Ballerup.

Om stillingen:

Du underviser ét eller to hold medarbejdere face‑to‑face på arbejdspladsen i Ballerup. Undervisningen ligger 1–2 gange om ugen og består af 2–3 lektioner pr. mødegang (á 50 minutter). Dage og tidspunkter aftales i samarbejde med deltagerne.

 Inden opstart testes deltagerne efter CEFR‑skalaen, hvorefter de opdeles i to hold efter niveau.


Vi forestiller os, at du:

• har erfaring med undervisning af voksne
• har en relevant uddannelsesbaggrund
• er født eller opvokset i et tysktalende land
• kan undervise i tysk sprog og kultur
• er fleksibel og god til at tilpasse undervisningen efter deltagernes behov
• har evnen til at motivere og engagere kursisterne
• kan starte snart eller efter aftalen
• har stærke kommunikationsevner og en professionel attitude

Vi tilbyder: 

• en spændende og meningsfuld stilling med engagerede kursister
• samarbejde med dygtige kollegaer og en støttende ledelse
• mulighed for flere undervisningsopgaver, både fysisk og online
• fleksibel arbejdstid i samarbejde med kursisterne
• konkurrencedygtig løn

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og fjerner opslaget, når den rette underviser er fundet. Send din ansøgning og CV til info@sprog-kursus.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig snart!


Lidt om os:

Vi er et privat sprogfirma, etableret i 2003, som har specialiseret sig i at tilbyde sprogkurser til virksomheder, kommuner, foreninger og private. Med vores 14 forskellige sprogkurser tilbyder vi både face2face og online undervisning, enten som enelektioner eller lukkede firmahold. Alle vores sprogkurser skræddersys i tæt samarbejde mellem kursister og undervisere, så vi kan sikre, at undervisningen altid er af høj kvalitet og fleksibilitet, der passer til den enkelte kursistens behov.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Mobile Core (Android)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is building the operating system for knowledge work, and we want people to be able to do substantive knowledge work from their phone.

A great native app is what makes that possible. On Android, that means Notion should feel like it was built for the platform: fast to open, smooth to scroll, and reliable offline or on a spotty connection. We’re investing in a more native foundation for how people read, write, and edit in Notion. That lets users capture ideas in the moment, find answers across their workspace, manage tasks and projects, and work with teammates, with the speed, polish, and dependability people expect from the best apps on their phone.

As an Android engineer, you’ll help build that native foundation, from how pages render and how people write and edit, to the navigation and app chrome people use every day, like Home, Search, and Inbox, along with the shared frameworks the rest of the app is built on. You’ll work across the Android stack, with chances to dig into our shared Rust layer and the AI tools we use for mobile development. Along the way, you’ll pair with experienced product and mobile AI engineers to find what slows the team down, try new Android capabilities, and help decide what ships in the app.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Ship the core Notion experience on Android: Build and polish the surfaces people use every day—opening and reading pages, writing and editing, navigating the app, and the Home, Search, and Inbox tabs—on a native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose stack that is fast to open, smooth to scroll, and dependable offline.

 - Build with product and design, and iterate fast: Partner with product managers and designers to turn ideas into shipped features, then use feedback and data to make them better. Use AI coding tools and agents to build, test, and investigate faster, while you stay accountable for review, validation, and quality.

 - By the end of your first year, own a core product area: Take a core part of the Android app, like Home, Inbox, or a piece of the editor, from idea to launch, and shape it into an experience that helps people do their life’s work from their phone.

 - Make the app feel fast and reliable: Find and fix issues in startup time, scrolling, typing latency, crashes, and memory use across the surfaces you own, and add the tests and monitoring that catch regressions before users do.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Solid Android fundamentals: You’ve built and shipped Android apps, through work, internships, or your own projects, and you’re comfortable with modern Android—Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, and Gradle. Experience with a large, modular codebase is a plus.

 - Care for native UI and performance: You enjoy making UI feel fast and smooth, and you’re curious about things like custom text rendering, complex lazy lists, or rich-text editing. Experience with performance profiling, realtime collaboration, or offline sync is a plus.

 - Product instincts: You care about how the app feels to use, not just how it works. You sweat the details of interactions and polish, and you use feedback and data to decide what to build next.

 - Thoughtful problem-solving and clear communication: You build a clear picture of the problem before jumping to a fix, you can explain trade-offs in writing, and you ask for help early when you’re stuck. Experience moving a hybrid or web-based surface to native, or building something from 0→1, is a plus.

 - AI-native, end-to-end engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective. Web experience (TypeScript, React, Node) is welcome but not required.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THIS JOB

We're looking for a Head of Marketing Strategy & Operations to run the business side of marketing. Our marketing team went from two people to 25 this year, organized around four functions: product marketing, brand and consumer, enterprise, and growth. This is the first operations hire on that team. You'll own the marketing budget with Finance, run our planning cycle and operating cadence, keep hiring aligned with the plan, and partner directly with the CMO on how marketing sets priorities and tells its story to the executive team and the board.

It's a role for someone who has sat close to a CMO and a CFO, likes turning ambiguity into a plan people can execute, and is comfortable building the function themselves before building a team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Budget & Financial Operations

 - Own the marketing budget end to end with Finance: allocation across teams and channels, tracking against plan, forecasting, variance flags, and the tradeoff conversations that follow

 - Build the layer of visibility leadership needs (spend by team, channel, and program) on top of the spend-tracking tools we already have, so decisions get made with numbers

 - Run quarterly, half-year, and annual budget planning, and make marketing's case to Finance and the executive team

 - Own marketing's vendor and agency contracts end to end: evaluations, procurement, renewals, and a clear view of what we pay for and why



Planning & Operating Cadence

 - Own marketing's planning cycle: translate company goals into marketing objectives, OKRs, and resourced plans, and keep them current as priorities shift

 - Bring a point of view. Pressure-test plans, frame the tradeoffs, and help the CMO decide where marketing places its bets

 - Design the lightweight processes and internal tools (planning, intake, reporting) that let a 25-person team operate like a much bigger one

 - Run the operating rhythm for the marketing leadership team: meetings, all-hands, team-wide readouts, agendas, decisions, and follow-through

 - Keep the marketing functions connected so plans, launches, and budgets move together



Executive Partnership

 - Partner directly with the CMO on board materials, executive readouts, and strategy documents. Own first drafts and make them data-backed and on-message

 - Extend the CMO's reach across the team: surface risks early, chase decisions to closure, and keep priorities clear week to week

 - Represent marketing in cross-functional planning with Finance, Sales, and Product



Hiring & Org Operations

 - Partner with Talent Acquisition and marketing leads on headcount planning, requisition tracking, and interview process, and keep hiring plans aligned with budget and org design

 - Standardize the basics across sub-teams (job descriptions, interview loops, scorecards) and help new leaders land well




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 10+ years in marketing strategy and operations, business operations, strategic finance, management consulting, or a similar role supporting a CMO, GM, or business unit leader

 - You've owned a sizable marketing or departmental budget end to end and can talk about spend, forecast, and variance the way Finance does

 - You've built or run a planning cycle (annual or half-year, OKRs) and an operating cadence for a leadership team

 - You've drafted board or executive materials for a senior leader and know the difference between a readout and a narrative

 - Experience with headcount planning and hiring operations alongside a Talent team

 - You've run vendor evaluations and procurement alongside Finance and kept a clean view of contracts and renewals

 - Comfortable as an individual contributor. This is the first ops hire; you'll do the work before you have a team

 - You scope light and move fast. We plan in weeks, not quarters, and you build just enough process to keep a fast team aligned

 - You build trust quickly, from individual contributors to the C-suite

 - Bonus: you're comfortable building your own tools with AI. We use Replit to run Replit



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

 



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

jobs.title: Rengøringsleder søges til MB Rengøring ApS
jobs.description:
MB Rengøring ApS søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst rengøringsleder til en fuldtidsstilling

MB Rengøring ApS er en virksomhed i udvikling, som leverer professionelle rengørings- og serviceydelser til erhvervskunder på forskellige lokationer. Vi oplever en stigende aktivitet og søger derfor en engageret og struktureret rengøringsleder, som kan være med til at sikre en stabil og effektiv daglig drift samt høj kvalitet i vores leverancer til kunderne.

Som rengøringsleder får du en central rolle i virksomheden og bliver ansvarlig for koordinering, planlægning og opfølgning på den daglige rengøringsdrift. Du vil fungere som bindeled mellem ledelsen, medarbejderne og vores kunder og vil derfor have en vigtig funktion i forhold til både kvalitet, kundetilfredshed og medarbejdernes daglige arbejde.

Stillingen indebærer et betydeligt selvstændigt ansvar, og vi forventer, at du kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag, prioritere opgaver og sikre, at vores aftaler med kunderne bliver overholdt.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet bestå af planlægning og koordinering af den daglige rengøring hos virksomhedens kunder. Du skal være med til at sikre, at de rette medarbejdere bliver fordelt på de rette opgaver, og at arbejdsplanerne tilpasses efter kundernes behov, ferie, sygdom, ændringer i bemanding og øvrige driftsmæssige forhold.

Du vil have ansvar for løbende kvalitetskontrol af det udførte arbejde. Dette indebærer blandt andet kontrolbesøg hos kunder, opfølgning på rengøringsstandarder og sikring af, at medarbejderne følger virksomhedens arbejdsbeskrivelser, procedurer og kvalitetskrav. Hvis der konstateres mangler eller fejl, forventes det, at du følger op og sørger for, at forholdene bliver rettet hurtigt og professionelt.

En vigtig del af jobbet vil være oplæring og vejledning af rengøringsmedarbejdere. Du skal kunne introducere nye medarbejdere til arbejdsopgaverne, forklare virksomhedens metoder og kvalitetskrav samt følge op på deres arbejde. Du skal desuden være med til at sikre, at medarbejderne arbejder effektivt, sikkert og i overensstemmelse med virksomhedens retningslinjer.

Du vil også have løbende kontakt med vores kunder. Det kan eksempelvis være i forbindelse med ændringer i arbejdsopgaver, ekstra rengøring, særlige ønsker, kvalitetsopfølgning eller andre forhold vedrørende den daglige drift. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan kommunikere professionelt og serviceminded og samtidig finde praktiske løsninger, når der opstår ændringer eller udfordringer.

Stillingen omfatter desuden opfølgning på igangværende opgaver og sikring af, at aftalte deadlines overholdes. Du vil være med til at håndtere akutte situationer, eksempelvis sygdom blandt medarbejdere, ændringer fra kunder eller behov for ekstra bemanding. Det kræver, at du kan reagere hurtigt, finde løsninger og sikre, at kunden fortsat modtager den aftalte service.

Du vil ligeledes få ansvar for fordeling af arbejdsopgaver blandt medarbejderne og for at følge op på, om arbejdet bliver udført inden for den forventede tid og kvalitet. Det forventes, at du løbende kommunikerer med medarbejderne og støtter dem i deres daglige arbejde.

Praktisk deltagelse i rengøringsopgaver kan forekomme efter behov. Det kan eksempelvis være i forbindelse med opstart af nye kunder, oplæring af medarbejdere, kvalitetskontrol, sygdomsdækning eller særlige opgaver. Hovedvægten i stillingen vil dog være på koordinering, planlægning, kvalitetssikring og den daglige driftsledelse.

Arbejdet vil primært foregå på forskellige kundeadresser, og der vil derfor ikke nødvendigvis være ét fast arbejdssted. Du skal være indstillet på at bevæge dig mellem forskellige arbejdssteder og have kontakt med både kunder og medarbejdere i løbet af arbejdsdagen.

Vi søger en person, som er ansvarsbevidst, struktureret og selvstændig. Du skal kunne planlægge din egen arbejdsdag og samtidig bevare overblikket over flere medarbejdere og forskellige kundeopgaver. Det er vigtigt, at du kan tage ansvar og træffe beslutninger i forbindelse med den daglige drift.

Vi forventer desuden, at du har gode samarbejdsevner og kan kommunikere professionelt med både kunder, medarbejdere og virksomhedens ledelse. Du skal kunne håndtere forskellige typer mennesker og situationer og være i stand til at løse problemer på en rolig og professionel måde.

Erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen, servicebranchen, personaleledelse, arbejdsplanlægning eller koordinering vil være en fordel. Det er ligeledes en fordel, hvis du tidligere har haft ansvar for medarbejdere eller arbejdet med kvalitetskontrol og kundekontakt.

Vi lægger stor vægt på, at du har en praktisk tilgang til arbejdet og er villig til at tage ansvar for, at opgaverne bliver løst korrekt. Du skal have forståelse for, at kvalitet, stabilitet og god kundeservice er afgørende i rengøringsbranchen.

Hos MB Rengøring ApS tilbyder vi en fast fuldtidsstilling med et stort selvstændigt ansvar og mulighed for at få indflydelse på den daglige drift. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor der er fokus på kvalitet, gode kunderelationer og en professionel arbejdsform.

Du vil få mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med virksomhedens ledelse og være med til at udvikle og forbedre vores interne arbejdsgange, kvalitetsprocedurer og planlægning.

Vi søger en medarbejder, som ønsker et langsigtet samarbejde og som har lyst til at være med til at udvikle MB Rengøring ApS i takt med, at virksomheden får flere kunder og flere medarbejdere.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling, og arbejdet vil primært foregå på forskellige kundeadresser.

Ansøgning med relevante oplysninger om erfaring og tidligere beskæftigelse sendes til MB Rengøring ApS.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Mobile Platform (iOS)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the iOS platform that helps engineers ship confidently. As Notion’s mobile team grows, we’re turning the first generation of mobile foundations into a durable platform: clearer architecture, ergonomic testing, dependable observability, and faster CI/CD. This role is broad—you’ll shape the iOS stack end to end, from shared frameworks and build systems to release quality, with opportunities to work across our shared Rust layer and AI infrastructure for mobile development. You’ll pair with mobile AI and core product engineers to understand friction, evaluate new iOS capabilities, and decide what should become part of the platform.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Make the iOS platform agent-ready: Give engineers and agents dependable ways to build, run, test, screenshot, and iterate through the app so mobile teams can move faster without lowering the quality bar.

 - By the end of your first year, define how iOS features are built: establish architecture and ship developer tools, then partner with product engineers to adopt them.

 - Raise the bar for iOS reliability and release quality: Improve the systems that catch regressions, prevent incidents, and help engineers understand issues quickly across builds, tests, observability, and CI/CD.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Deep iOS engineering experience at scale: You’ve helped build and deploy mobile applications used by millions, and understand the reliability, performance, and operational practices required at that scale.

 - Platform or infrastructure experience: You’ve worked below the product-feature layer on mobile CI/CD, testing platforms, build systems, developer tooling, or shared frameworks—and can turn recurring friction into durable systems.

 - Strong architectural judgment: You’re familiar with multiple approaches to iOS architecture and can explain the trade-offs clearly, choosing patterns that make features easier to build, test, and maintain.

 - Cross-functional influence: You can partner closely with product engineers, understand their pain points, and earn adoption for new platform APIs, workflows, and standards without relying on authority.

 - AI-native engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective.

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Myyjä, Sale Naantali, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
NAANTALI

Etsimme myyjää Sale Naantaliin ihan tavallisiin töihin, harvinaisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon!
Tehtävä on vakituinen ja osa-aikainen 10 tuntia viikossa. Tämä tehtävä sopii myös opiskelijalle! Työt olisi tarkoitus aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Salessa myyjän työpäivät koostuvat ihan perustehtävistä, kuten asiakaspalvelusta, kassa- ja hyllytystyöstä, robotilauksien keräilystä sekä myymälän yleisestä järjestelystä ja siivouksesta. Työssä muun muassa varmistat tuotteiden saatavuuden ja tuoreuden sekä sen, että myymälä on asiakkaille houkutteleva. Työskentely on nopeatempoista ja vaatii kykyä hypätä työtehtävästä toiseen. Käytät kaupan järjestelmiä, huolehdit saldojen oikeellisuudesta ja näin vaikutat omalla tekemiselläsi suoraan myyntiin. Seuraat myymälän toimintatapoja ja viestintää, huolehdit turvallisista ja ergonomisista työtavoista sekä osallistut tarvittaessa uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämiseen. Myymälässä työskentely on fyysistä, sillä liikumme päivän aikana paljon, nostamme ja siirrämme tavaraa ja olemme suurimman osan päivästä jaloillamme.

Työhön sisältyy myös hetkiä, jolloin työskentelet vuorossa yksin, joten edellytämmekin sinulta täysi-ikäisyyttä. Työvuorot vaihtelevat arkisin ja viikonloppuisin kello 6.30–22.00 väillä. Varmistathan, että sinulla on mahdollisuus kulkea toimipaikkaan kaikkina kaupan aukioloaikoina.

Olet saletisti etsimämme myyjä, jos sinulla on reipas ja positiivinen työskentelyote. Haluat olla luomassa onnistunutta asiakaskokemusta ja tervehtiminenkin tulee sinulta luonnostaan. Nautit työskentelystä hektisessä myymäläympäristössä, jossa toimit sovittujen toimintatapojen mukaisesti ja edistät omalla tekemiselläsi yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamista. Olet valmis tarttumaan oma-aloitteisesti erilaisiin työtehtäviin ja pidät tiimityöskentelystä, jossa pääset jakamaan omaa osaamistasi työkavereille sekä auttamaan muita onnistumaan. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevissa vuoroissa ja työtehtävissä sekä kohtaat paljon ihmisiä päivän aikana. Eduksi katsomme aiemman työkokemuksen vastaavista työtehtävistä, mutta tärkeintä on halu oppia, toimia tehokkaasti ja tavoitteellisesti sekä työskennellä asiakaslähtöisesti.

Myyjän palkka perustuu Kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen palkkaluokkaan B. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 10,89-14,57 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

Ihan tavallisia töitä, epätavallisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Työskennellessäsi meillä, saat rahanarvoisia ostoetuja S-etukortillasi, kuten S-ryhmän ravintoloista –25 %,Sokos ja Emotion myymälöistä -15 % tai autopesusta –50 %

jobs.title: Ergoterapeut til Helhedsplejen
jobs.description:
Er du en fagligt stærk ergoterapeut med interesse for rehabilitering og genoptræning? Brænder du for at gøre en forskel for ældre borgere – med udgangspunkt i deres egne ønsker og mål? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i Frit Valg Svane Pleje Nørresundby.

 

Om os

I Frit Valg Svane Pleje arbejder vi ud fra ældrelovens værdier om selvbestemmelse, fokus på borgerinddragelse og personcentreret omsorg. Vores tilgang bygger på et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og en helhedsorienteret indsats, hvor borgerens ressourcer og livskvalitet er i centrum.

I Frit Valg Svane Pleje arbejder vi teamorganiseret. Du bliver tilknyttet et eller flere teams bestående af en planlægger, SOSU-assistenter, SOSU-hjælpere og ufaglærte. Du får desuden en fysioterapeut som kollega i afdelingen og du bliver en del af et engageret terapeutteam på tværs af alle vores 14 afdelinger, hvor der er mulighed for sparring.

Om stillingen

Opgaverne som ergoterapeut spænder bredt inden for forebyggelse, vedligeholdelse, rehabilitering og genoptræning. Du skal fungere som forløbsansvarlig hovedsaligt for borgere visiteret efter Ældreloven, herunder afklaring af hjælpsbehov og vurdering af rehabiliteringspotentiale samt planlægning af borgerens forløb efterfølgende.

Du har desuden til opgave at understøtte, at alle SOSU-assistenter, SOSU-hjælpere og ufaglærte arbejder rehabiliterende, hvilket vi forestiller os sker via daglig sparring med kolleger, deltagelse i teammøder og tværfaglige møder, undervisning og supervision. Det er derfor en forudsætning, at du er nysgerrig og har lyst til at varetage en vejledende rolle ift. dine kollegers faglige udvikling.

Du får mulighed for generelt at bidrage i kvalitets- og udviklingsopgaver, f.eks. skal vi implementere velfærdsteknologiske løsninger og styrke samarbejdet med frivillighed og civilsamfund.

En typisk dag starter ude ved borgerne, hvor du fx opstarter et rehabiliteringsforløb, træner at borgeren kan blive selvhjulpen i bad eller til måltid, foretager en arbejdspladsvurdering eller understøtter dine kolleger i hverdagsrehabilitering. Senere har du fx administrative opgaver på kontoret, hvor du bestiller hjælpemidler, udfører dokumentationspraksis og dagen afsluttes måske med et tværfagligt møde.

 

Dine opgaver

  • Som forløbsansvarlig skal du vurdere borgerens rehabiliterings- og genoptræningspotentiale og opstarte den rette hjælp eller træning og sikre løbende opfølgning på forløb

  • Inddrage kolleger i borgerens plan, således alle arbejder med borgernes mål og med afsæt i den rehabiliterende tankegang

  • Varetage aktivitets- eller genoptræning i borgerens hjem eller som holdtræning

  • Sikre faglig refleksion, facilitere tværfaglige møder og teammøder

  • Understøtte tværfagligt samarbejde med kommunale samarbejdspartnere, herunder myndighed

  • Sætte fokus på frivillighed og civilsamfundets betydning for borgerens liv

  • Bidrage til oplæring af nye medarbejdere og understøtte opgavefordeling efter kompetencer

 

Om dig – faglige kompetencer

  • Du arbejder struktureret, reflekteret og med høj faglighed

  • Du formidler tydeligt – både skriftligt og mundtligt

  • Du ser stor værdi i tværfagligt samarbejde og kan facilitere møder på tværs

  • Du er motiveret for at dele viden, skabe læring og udvikle kollegers kompetencer

 

Om dig – personlige kompetencer

  • Du trives med alsidige opgaver og en til tider uforudsigelig hverdag

  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Du er samarbejdsorienteret og bidrager til et positivt og lærende arbejdsmiljø

  • Du brænder for at støtte borgeren i at nå sine mål og bevare livskvaliteten

 

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag

  • Mulighed for at påvirke implementeringen af den nye ældrelov og mulighed for at påvirke implementering af den nye sundhedsreform i 2027, hvor genoptræning efter §140 forventes at indgå for private leverandører

  • Mulighed for vidensdeling på tværs af afdelingerne samt Svane Plejes kvalitetsgruppe

  • Kort mellem handling og beslutning

 

Ansøgning og ansættelsesforhold

Der er tale om en fastansættelse på 32-37 timer, hvor du kan være med til at aftale ugentlig arbejdstid ved ansættelse. Arbejdstid planlægges typisk indenfor tidsrummet kl. 7-16, men eftermiddag og/eller aftenarbejde kan forekomme.

Vi ønsker stillingen besat fra 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Ansøgningsfrist den 18/10-2026

Samtaler forventes afholdt uge 43. Der kan indgå en kort case til samtalen.

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller ønsker stillingsopslaget uddybet, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

-          Direktør Tina Jørgensen 41402010 hverdage mellem kl. 08.00 og 14.00 eller på e-mailadressen tij@svanepleje.dk

-          Faglig chef for rehabilitering og genoptræning Trine Bassett på. tlf. 92 43 51 22 eller på e-mail tpi@svanepleje.dk (træffes i uge 31-33)

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold forhandles ved dialog.

jobs.title: Sosiaaliohjaaja Etelä-Suomen alueelle - Lastensuojelun, perhesosiaalityön ja aikuispalvelun tiimi
jobs.description:
**Haemme kolmea sosiaaliohjaajaa Etelä-Suomen avopalveluiden tiimiin. Tällä hetkellä haemme yhtä (1) kokoaikaista- ja kolmea (3) tuntityöntekijää.** Lähtökohtaisesti toivomme, että mikäli työskentelet meillä tuntityöntekijänä, olisit valmis työskentelemään yli 50 h/kk - mahdollisuuksien mukaan voimme tarjota sinulle haluamasi määrän työtunteja aina kokoaikaiseen työhön asti. Huomioi, että voit halutessasi hakea myös molempia tehtäviä.

Tulevaan Sosiaalipalvelut - olemme 100 % suomalainen, valtakunnallisesti toimiva yhteiskunnallinen perheyritys. Meille työssä tärkeintä ovat asiakkaat ja se, että he saavat laadukasta, oikea-aikaista ja hyvin suunniteltua palvelua.

Vaikka työ on itsenäistä, et ole koskaan yksin. Työkavereiden sekä esihenkilöiden tuki on aina saatavilla, olemme avoin ja matalan kynnyksen organisaatio, jossa kaikki ovat samaa työtä tekeviä työkavereita. Tehtävämme on tuottaa Suomen parhaita sosiaalialan palveluja - yhdessä ja hyvällä fiiliksellä.

Olemme suomalaisen työn liiton jäsen sekä suositeltu sotetyöpaikka. Sote Solutions toteuttaman työpaikkatutkimuksen mukaan henkilöstömme työlle ja työtyytyväisyydelle antama arvio on 94 %.

Tutustu tarkemmin toimintaamme videon muodossa (7min): https://youtu.be/UClN2loxz7w

Mitä me haemme ja mitä tarjoamme sinulle: Haluaisitko sosiaaliohjaajaksi työskentelemään osana toiminnallista, ammattitaitoista, persoonallista ja huumorintajuista tiimiä?

Haluaisitko työskennellä itsenäisesti ja suunnitella omat työvuorosi? Haluatko tehdä merkityksellistä ja tärkeää työtä yhteiskunnallisessa yrityksessä? Onko sinulle tärkeää, että pääset vaikuttamaan työsi sisältöön ja työn suunnitteluun?

Jos vastasit kyllä ja olet sosiaali- tai terveysalan ammattilainen, jolla on kokemusta lasten, nuorten tai perheiden kanssa työskentelystä, ota yhteyttä ja tule mukaan tekemään Suomen parhaita sosiaalialan avopalveluja Etelä-Suomen alueelle.

Meillä sinuun luotetaan ja saat vaikuttaa omaan työhösi. Jokaista työntekijää ja heidän ammattitaitoaan arvostetaan ja tiimissämme saat olla täysin oma itsesi.

Toivomme, että omaat kehitysmyönteisen ja avoimen työotteen sekä kestät elämän keskeneräisyyttä. Edellytyksenä on, että sinulta löytyy oppimisen halua ja intoa uusiin sekä vaihteleviin tehtäviin sekä työyhteisösi kehittämiseen.

Etelä-Suomen toimitiloissa voi tavata työkavereita ja harrastaa asiakkaiden kanssa monipuolisesti. Malminkartanon viihtyisä nuorisotila tarjoaa hyvät puitteet yhteiselle tekemiselle ja harrastamiselle. Maltsussa voit pelailla vaikka biljardia tai tehdä käsitöitä asiakkaiden kanssa. Etelä-Suomen päätoimipaikkamme on Pakilan toimintakeskus, jossa on yli 500m2 toiminnallista tilaa sisältäen mm. seinäkiipeilysalin, koripallokentän, saunatilat ja eri toimistohuoneita asiakastapaamisia varten.

Tulevaan Sosiaalipalvelut toimii Etelä-Suomessa, Keski-Suomessa, Lahdessa ja Rovaniemellä.

Sosiaaliohjaajana työskentelet pääsääntöisesti Etelä-Suomen alueella. Painotus on Espoon alueella. Vaikka työalue on laaja, rakennamme sinulle yhdessä sellaisen työkokonaisuuden, että kulkeminen ja työn suunnittelu on mahdollisimman helppoa. Työhösi kuuluu perhetyötä, tehostettua perhetyötä, ammatillista tukihenkilötyötä sekä aikuisasiakkaiden kanssa tehtävää kotiin vietävää tukityötä ja sosiaaliohjausta.

Toimit sosiaaliohjaajana ja tärkeänä tukikontaktina omille asiakasperheille tai nuorille/lapsille ja aikuisasiakkaille - haemme osaajia pääsääntöisesti pitkäkestoiseen työsuhteeseen. Meille on tärkeää, että asiakas saa tukea ja turvaa arkeen tutulta työntekijältä ja käytämme työssä mahdollisimman vähän sijaisia - kaikki työ toteutetaan meillä oman henkilökunnan toimesta eikä käytössä ole esimerkiksi vuokratyövoimaa tai alihankkijoita.

Työajat ovat vaihtelevia, mutta työ toteutuu pääsääntöisesti arkisin klo 8 ja 20 välillä - toimimme perheiden aikataulujen mukaan ja työ painottuu iltapäiväaikaan. Työtä on kuitenkin mahdollisuus tehdä myös aamuaikoina ja sinulla on oman työsi ammattilaisena varsin vapaat kädet kalenterin ja työaikojen suunnitteluun. Tuemme ja autamme, mutta emme tee puolesta: meillä luotetaan jokaisen omaan kykyyn rakentaa itselleen sopivin työviikko. Työkulttuuriimme ei kuulu, että työnantaja seuraa, valvoo tai suunnittelee työajat tai toimintamallit valmiiksi, vaan uskomme siihen, että luottamus ja työn arvostus tarkoittaa, että sinä olet oman työsi paras asiantuntija.

**Tarkista ennen hakemista, että nämä täyttyvät:**

- Sinulla on sosiaali- ja terveysalan AMK-tutkinto (tai aiempi vastaava opistotason tutkinto)

- Olet rekisteröitynyt JulkiTerhikkiin / JulkiSuosikkiin

- Sinulla on kokemusta sosiaalialan työtehtävistä ja toiminnasta lasten, nuorten tai perheiden parissa

- Pystyt tekemään itsenäistä työtä ja suunnittelemaan oman työsi

- Sairaanhoitaja AMK-tutkinto, kokemus mielenterveys- ja päihdetyöstä sekä nepsy-asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä katsotaan eduksi

- Kykenet toimimaan myös työparityössä työpari huomioiden
