jobs.title: Security Engineer, Detection and Response
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work, and protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build.




We’re looking for a hands-on Detection Engineer to build and operate the systems and workflows we use to detect and respond to attacks across Notion’s cloud-native environment. You’ll ship high-signal detections, improve the platform that powers them, participate in incident response, and help shape how detection and response engineering scales at Notion.




You’ll work closely with Engineering, Corporate Security, and Infrastructure, with broad latitude to identify gaps, prioritize investments, and build what’s needed next.




We view detection and response as a software engineering discipline: detections are code, platforms are products, and measurement matters




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Build and tune high-signal detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments, with review and mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp up.

 - Contribute to the detection platform, including rule lifecycle management, tuning, measurement, and rollout safety.

 - Build tooling and automation that speed up triage, enrichment, investigation, and detection authoring, including LLM-based workflows where useful.

 - Turn threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into detections, telemetry requirements, and response improvements.

 - Take part in investigations, incident response, and postmortems, and help turn what we learn into lasting fixes.

 - Help define and track metrics such as coverage, MTTD, and alert quality.

 - Join a shared on-call rotation for incident response.
   




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - We're hiring across a range of experience levels. If you have some of these skills but not all, we'd still like to hear from you.
   
   - 3+ years of experience in detection engineering, security operations, incident response, threat hunting, or a closely related security or software engineering role.
   
   - Have written or tuned detections that run in production, and care about signal quality and cutting noise.
   
   - Working knowledge of at least one detection or query language (Sigma, KQL, SPL, YARA-L, EQL, or Panther), or strong SQL or Python skills and the drive to learn one quickly.
   
   - An understanding of how attackers operate (for example, MITRE ATT&CK), and the ability to use it to decide what to detect.
   
   - Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, ideally including identity and access logs.
   
   - Have used SIEM, EDR, or SOAR tools in any size of environment.
   
   - Write clearly in runbooks, design docs, and incident notes, and can own well-scoped projects end to end.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Have led purple team, blue team, or adversary emulation exercises that improved detections or telemetry.

 - Experience running SIEM, EDR, or SOAR platforms at large scale.

 - Experience building or maintaining detection-as-code workflows (version control, CI, and tests for detections).

 - Experience applying LLMs or agent-style tooling to security workflows.

 - Experience securing AI-enabled systems or endpoint tooling.

 - Kubernetes or container detection experience.

 - Background in threat intelligence, malware analysis, or digital forensics.

 - Contributions to the security community through research, tooling, CTFs, or talks.

 - Experience at a high-growth startup or AI company.
   



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $185,000 - $280,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550 and and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Tekniker
jobs.description:
Vi søger en en tekniker til automationsopgaver i produktionsvirksomhed – hos en af vores faste industrikunder i Hedensted. Du vil indgå i vores faste serviceteam, hvor du primært får service- og optimeringsopgaver, men kan også deltage i projekter

Om jobbet

Kundens maskinpark omfatter alt fra gamle maskiner med relæstyring til nye produktionsanlæg med PLC, HMI og robotter. Du arbejder med alt fra fejlfinding på eksisterende anlæg til design og programmering af nye styringer – og både med el, mekanik og pneumatik. Du skal derfor trives med praktiske opgaver, hvor du indimellem får snavsede fingre. Vi forbereder løbende kundens produktionsanlæg med fokus på sikkerhed, driftsoptimering og betjening – og fungerer som kundens tætte rådgiver.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi forventer, at du er uddannet elektriker, tekniker eller lign. og har erfaring med eller flair for PLC-programmering; gerne Rockwell og Siemens. Du har den rette indstilling, bidrager positivt og tager ansvar for opgaven, indtil den er løst. Du hjælper dine kollegaer og holder den gode tone – og er derudover mødestabil.

Kjærgaard tilbyder dig

Du får en spændende stilling i en lille afdeling med ordnede forhold, kompetence kollegaer og gode muligheder for personlig udvikling i et selvstændigt og udfordrende miljø. Efter endt oplæring skal du deltage i vores vagtordning (ca. hver 8-10. uge). Du kommer til at arbejde i et uformelt miljø, hvor vi vægter samarbejde, kvalitet og faglig stolthed højt. Du får en central rolle i vores værksted og bliver en del af et stærkt hold.

  • et alsidigt job hvor du både arbejder med montage, service og tilpasning

  • frihed under ansvar og mulighed for selv at præge din hverdag

  • et fagligt stærkt miljø med gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone

  • en arbejdsplads hvor vi prioriterer trivsel og ordnede forhold

  • løn efter kvalifikationer

Du skal kunne identificere dig i overensstemmelse med vores værdisæt K7.

Ansøgning og CV

Vi arbejder på at besætte stillingen hurtigst muligt og tager ansøgere ind løbende. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte divisionschef Michael Haislund på mih@kia.dk eller 4080 0097.

Send din ansøgning ved at klikke på “Søg stillingen”-knappen til højre. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Selskabskoordinator hos Smag & Slægt
jobs.description:
Selskabskoordinator hos Smag & Slægt

Er du detaljeorienteret, serviceminded og god til at holde mange bolde i luften?

Hos Smag & Slægt søger vi en engageret Selskabskoordinator på fuld tid, som brænder for at skabe den bedste oplevelse for vores gæster – længe før de træder ind ad døren.

Du bliver den gennemgående kontaktperson for vores selskaber og arrangementer. Fra første tilbud til den endelige bekræftelse og opfølgning sikrer du, at alle detaljer er på plads, og at både gæster og kollegaer føler sig i trygge hænder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Udarbejdelse af tilbud og bekræftelser på selskaber og arrangementer.

  • Opfølgning på eksisterende og kommende selskaber.

jobs.title: Software Tester & Quality Specialist – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition
jobs.description:
Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Software Tester & Quality Specialist who likes to make a difference! 

Job description: 

As a Software Tester & Quality Specialist in the Quality Management team, you will work closely with developers, business experts, product owners, project managers, test managers, and fellow testers to help ensure the quality of Nordic RCC's systems and services.

We believe quality starts long before testing begins. Therefore, you will be involved early in the development process, helping teams identify risks, clarify requirements, and prepare testing activities before solutions are implemented. We are in the progress of strengthening our processes and “shifting-left” to achieve this target state.

You will contribute throughout the development lifecycle by reviewing acceptance criteria, creating test data, designing and executing tests, supporting business and operators is test decision and execution, and communicating test results and quality concerns. By working closely with both business and development teams, you will help ensure that quality is built into our solutions from the start.

Your key responsibilities are:

  • Work closely with developers, business experts, product owners, project managers, test managers, and fellow testers throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Participate in requirement reviews, refinement sessions, and solution discussions to identify risks, gaps, and testing needs as early as possible.

  • Help ensure that testing considerations are included early in development activities and that quality is addressed before implementation is completed.

  • Review requirements, user stories, and solution designs to identify potential risks, gaps, and ambiguities.

  • Identify dependencies, prerequisites, and test data requirements for testing activities.

  • Create, maintain, and analyse test data to support testing across different systems and environments.

  • Design, maintain, and execute test cases and test scenarios based on business and technical requirements.

  • Perform manual and exploratory testing to verify functionality, usability, integrations, and business processes.

  • Identify, document, and follow up on defects and quality issues in collaboration with development teams and business stakeholders.

  • Support investigation and root cause analysis of defects and recurring quality issues.

  • Contribute test cases, effort estimates, dependencies, and risks as input to test planning activities.

  • Document and communicate test results, findings, and quality concerns to support project and test management reporting.

  • Collaborate with developers and test automation specialists to improve testing practices and automated quality controls.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing methods, test data practices, and quality assurance processes across Nordic RCC.

Proactive position with outstanding attention to detail and excellent communication skills 

On the personal level you have attention to details, good communication and collaboration skills, analytical thinking and problem solving. You are a self-driven and proactive person, responsible, structured and have a strong focus on finding a solution to the problems at hand.

The ideal candidate is expected to have a minimum of 5 years in manual test experience, an education at BA or MA level in computer science or engineering, but experience from a similar role is more important.

Technical skills: 

  • Collaborate with internal and external development teams in the CI/CD process. 

  • Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc), tools, processes, and development cycles (SDLC). 

  • Experience with test data creation

  • Good understanding of test automation

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • ISTQB certification or equivalent 

  • Experience with test management tools - Azure DevOps, Jira, etc. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

Employment conditions 

You will join a team of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 22 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note: The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 1st November 2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

If you have any questions, please contact Håkon Rosenaa Nystad, Manager, Quality Management, hny@nordic-rcc.net.

jobs.description:

Hovedaktiviteterne på pladserne er håndtering af jord, have-/parkaffald, træ og øvrige affaldsfraktioner, der kommer ind på de forskellige pladser. 
Vi har en uformel omgangstone med gensidig respekt for hinanden og har med udgangspunkt fra kontoret i Kolding tæt kontakt med alle modtageanlæg samt vores hovedkontor i Aabenraa. Vi er et stærkt team med en ambition om at have tilfredse kunder og levere kvalitet hver gang.

Som chef for Trading (træ, metal m.m.) får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse og videreudvikling af afdelingen. Du leder et mindre team og står for styring og koordinering af samarbejdet med kunder, samarbejdspartnere og relevante specialister.

Der er tale om et forretningsområde i vækst, og du får en central rolle i både den strategiske og kommercielle udvikling af området.

Stillingen er placeret i Kolding, og du refererer direkte til direktøren for området. For den rette kandidat vil stillingen på sigt kunne medføre deltagelse i chefgruppen i Meldgaard-koncernen. 

Om dig
Vi søger en leder, der kan være det stabile omdrejningspunkt i en travl hverdag. Du bevarer overblikket, skaber struktur og sætter en tydelig retning, samtidig med at du bidrager med positiv energi og skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor medarbejderne trives og udvikler sig.

  • Har erfaring fra en lignende lederstilling - dog betyder det rigtige mindset mere end tidligere titel 
  • Har stærke kommercielle kompetencer og en veludviklet købmandsmæssig forståelse 
  • Er en dygtig leder, der kan skabe engagement og følgeskab 
  • Trives med ansvar og evner at skabe struktur i komplekse processer 
  • Er resultatorienteret og motiveres af at udvikle forretning

Det er samtidig vigtigt at du:

  • Kan sætte en tydelig retning og sikre opfølgning på mål og aktiviteter 
  • Er stærk i relationer og samarbejde med både kunder, leverandører og kolleger 
  • Har gennemslagskraft og naturlig autoritet 
  • Kan bevare roen og overblikket, også når tempoet er højt 
  • Bidrager aktivt til en positiv kultur og et godt arbejdsmiljø

Hos Meldgaard kan vi tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende stilling med gode løn- og ansættelsesforhold i en velkonsolideret familievirksomhed med over 55 års erfaring. Vores omgangstone er åben og uformel, og der er frihed under ansvar med korte kommandoveje. 

Har du uddybende spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte direktør Henrik Meldgaard pr. mail hm@meldgaard.com eller send os din ansøgning via Ansøg senest 22. oktober 2026. jobs.title: Project Manager for the EuroTeQ Pathway Project - Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs
jobs.employer: DTU Afdelingen for Uddannelse og Studerende
jobs.description:
Would you like to contribute to the development of DTU’s educational offers? Do you want to help shape the future of European higher education and collaborate with colleagues and partners across Europe?

The Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs (AUS) at DTU is looking for a proactive Project Manager to join the Office of International Education as Project Manager for the EuroTeQ Pathway Project, a newly awarded 24-month EU-funded project focused on the European Degree Label.

In this role you will help translate new European educational frameworks into practice and support their implementation across DTU, contributing to the continued development and internationalisation of DTU’s educational portfolio.

As Project Manager, you will be at the centre of this work, coordinating partners across Europe while taking responsibility for key training, stakeholder engagement, and implementation activities. Through your work, you will help strengthen DTU’s capacity to engage in new forms of European educational collaboration and turn emerging opportunities into lasting value for DTU and its students.

The job
You will join the Office of International Education, as part of the Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs (AUS), which has approximately 120 employees and is responsible for developing and supporting DTU’s educational processes, with a strong focus on our students.

As our new Project Manager, you will coordinate the EuroTeQ Pathway Project from planning and reporting, to partner coordination and delivery of key activities.

This is not a conventional project management position. You will also take an active role in developing the project’s content, leading training and stakeholder activities, and strengthening DTU’s understanding of the European Degree Label and its implications in a Danish context. You will work closely with consortium partners and DTU colleagues, while taking responsibility for the quality and delivery of the project activities within your remit.

The role offers an opportunity to combine international project leadership with educational development and stakeholder engagement, while helping translate European developments into value for DTU and its educational portfolio. We anticipate 5-10 travel days a year.

Your main responsibilities will include:
  • Coordinate the overall project plan, including timelines, milestones, budget, risks, and dependencies across the four work packages.
  • Coordinate consortium partners and EU project reporting, ensuring timely delivery of project outputs and milestones
  • Lead the development and implementation of key project activities, including training, communication, and stakeholder events.
  • Organise and facilitate the national stakeholder workshop and contribute to the project’s national roadmap.
  • Build and maintain relationships with national and international stakeholders across higher education, quality assurance, and policy.
  • Strengthen DTU’s institutional understanding of the European Degree Label and translate relevant project outcomes into value for DTU’s educational development.

Knowledge of Danish is not required for the position. However, as much of DTU's internal administration is conducted in Danish, you should expect to encounter Danish in larger meetings and institutional contexts.

Our expectations of you
You have a university degree and, ideally, experience from the education sector or another publicly funded organization, with experience in project management.

We would like you to:
  • Have a proactive and self-driven approach, with a strong sense of ownership. You take initiative, move activities forward independently, and know when to seek input and involve relevant colleagues
  • Seek out effective collaboration and cross-functional coordination
  • Be able to follow and devise formalised processes
  • Are able to familiarise yourself with study regulations and the legal framework in the education sector, for example, Knowledge of European higher education, particularly quality assurance, accreditation, and/or cross-border regulatory frameworks. Familiarity with frameworks such as the European Approach for Quality Assurance of Joint Programmes or EQAR would be an advantage.
  • Experience planning and delivering stakeholder events, from initial concept and logistics through to facilitation, delivery, and follow-up.

What we offer in return

jobs.title: Associate Professor in ‘Experimental Nanooptics’.
jobs.description:
The Mads Clausen Institute, Center for Nano Optics (www.sdu.dk/nano-optics) invites applications for an Associate Professor position in ‘Experimental Nano-Optics’. The starting date is Feb 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The successful candidate is expected to conduct cutting-edge experimental research within nano-optics involving advanced optical characterization of localized and propagating strongly enhanced and confined electromagnetic excitations with the state-of-the-art amplitude and phase-resolved near-field microscope available (NeaSpec). The near-field characterization is expected to be complemented with other optical characterization techniques as well as with performing advanced electromagnetic modelling. The candidate should have documented teaching experience at both BSc and MSc levels along with the corresponding teaching portfolio.

The application material should include a detailed motivation and an outline of the research activities that are to be pursued. In their applications, applicants should highlight their ten most significant journal publications, detailing also their author contributions. Applicants who wish to be considered should provide a link to a fully-updated ResearcherID (www.researcherid.com). The application material should also include detailed accounts on supervision and teaching experience.

The prospective candidates should have a Ph.D. degree in physics, preferably within nano-optics, and documented research experience in the aforementioned experimental techniques. They are expected to have a notable international profile, strong record of research publications, and demonstrated exceptional potential to excel in scientific research. We expect the candidate to actively engage in the development of academic research, conducting vigorous fund raising activities, and educational environment at the Centre for Nano Optics.

The candidate is expected to teach and instruct both graduate and undergraduet students as well as supervise bachelor and master projects. Furthermore, the candicate is expected to contribute actively to young-researcher education through supervision of Ph.D. students and postdoctorial researchers. 

For further information about the position and research infrastructure as well as Centre for Nano Optics, contact Prof. Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi (seib@mci.sdu.dk).

Read more on: http://www.sdu.dk/en/stillinger

Contact information
For information about the Mads Clausen Institute, please see www.sdu.dk/en/mci. 

Further information about this position is available Prof. Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi (seib@mci.sdu.dk).

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Application

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Research plan for the position in question (max. 2 pages). 
    Upload in the field called "Project description". 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, external funding etc.

  • Verified copies of official Certificates/Diplomas (BSc, MSc and PhD) 

  • List of publications with most relevant publications highlighted.

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers, who can provide an informed reference letter at short notice (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected.

jobs.title: Postdoc in Veterinary Microbiology
jobs.description:
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen



We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated veterinary microbiologist for a 2-year part-time postdoc position starting around 1st January 2027. The new postdoc is expected to contribute to the scientific and teaching activities of the research group One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) within the section of Veterinary Clinical Microbiology. Additionally, the postdoc will be responsible for defined scientific and management activities within the project SOA36 - Designing best veterinary practices to reduce antimicrobial and antiparasitic use (BEST-VET), funded by the European Partnership on Animal Health and Welfare (EUPAHW). These responsibilities include supporting the project Chair in the day-to-day coordination and management of the consortium, as well as planning and conducting research aimed at reducing antimicrobial use in pigs through improved diagnostic and treatment protocols for key endemic bacterial diseases, and active involvement in the development of clinical guidelines for prudent antimicrobial use in pig medicine, with a particular focus on developing evidence-based guidelines using the GRADE approach. Through these activities, the postdoc will contribute to strengthening antimicrobial stewardship and promoting evidence-based best practices in veterinary medicine.

Information on the department and the section can be found at: https://ivh.ku.dk/.

Our research
The postdoc will be part of the OHAR research group led by Prof. Luca Guardabassi. Our research is characterized by two focus areas:

  • Development of diagnostic tests and methods to reduce and rationalize antimicrobial use in animals.
  • Optimization of veterinary antimicrobial use to minimize selection and spread of antimicrobial resistance.
For more information, please check the OHAR homepage One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) – University of Copenhagen

Your job
You are a highly qualified veterinary microbiologist with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team. You will be required to be physically present in the laboratory to contribute to ongoing research projects and oversee experiments conducted by PhD, MSc, and BSc students. As part of the EU project BEST-VET, you will contribute to selected work packages and expert groups, including WP1 (Reduction of drug use in pigs), WP7 (Environmental impact of antimicrobial/antiparasitic drugs and phage therapy), Expert Group 1 (Phages and their environmental impact), Expert Group 3 (Standardization of sampling, metagenomics & analytical methods) and Expert Group 5 (Clinical guidance). You will be responsible for coordinating and following up on SOA36 activities related to these work packages and expert groups. You will also act as a key point of contact between the project management, work package leaders and expert groups. Your project management responsibilities will further include supporting the organisation of Management Board meetings, following up on project activities and deadlines, and maintaining the SOA36 SharePoint and associated project documentation. As part of the position, you will undertake a one-year training programme in evidence-based guideline development using the GRADE approach and subsequently contribute to the development of evidence-based clinical guidelines for veterinary medicine.

Profile
We are seeking a highly qualified scientist with a strong track record of independent research in veterinary bacteriology and experience in international collaborative research project coordination, as well as in the supervision and teaching of veterinary and postgraduate students.

Essential experience and skills:

  • A MSc degree in Veterinary Medicine
  • A PhD in Veterinary Microbiology or a closely related field
  • Previous postdoctoral experience
  • Outstanding publication record in relation to career stage
  • Excellent scientific writing and oral communication skills
  • Experience in supervising PhD, MSc, and BSc students
  • Experience in the coordination and management of collaborative research projects
  • Experience with bacterial whole-genome sequencing and genomic data analysis
  • Knowledge of key concepts in antimicrobial stewardship
Desirable experience and skills:

  • Research experience in antimicrobial resistance
  • Experience in metagenomics
  • Experience in routine bacteriological and mycological diagnostics
  • Experience in preparing research proposals and applications for external funding
Place of employment
The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories that are fully equipped to perform traditional and molecular microbiology, including omics.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 per week.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

Questions
For further information please contact Luca Guardabassi (lg@sund.ku.dk).

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Please include

  • Curriculum vitae
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers
After the expiry date or applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Application deadline: 15 October 2026, 23.59 CEST.

Interviews are expected to be held in weeks 44-45 (26th October – 5th November 2026).

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, nationality, race, religion or sexual orientation. Appointment will be based on merit alone.

jobs.title: Sales Executive  - Ready to turn Software/ERP expertise into closed deals? Interform HQ Birkerød, DK or Remote
jobs.description:
The role

Interform builds InterformNG2, an Output Management platform that sits next to the ERP and handles the documents a business runs on: invoices, labels, delivery notes, e-invoicing. When output fails, shipments stop and invoices get rejected. Our customers buy certainty that this never happens.

You will sell InterformNG2 to new customers across Europe - with our core markets in the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux and the UK - typically manufacturing, logistics and distribution companies running ERPs such as Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or IBM i. You own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed agreement.

There is no BDR team here, but you are not starting from a blank sheet either. We identify the most relevant accounts together, backed by an AI-driven engine that tracks buying signals across our markets. Your job is what happens next: the outreach, the conversations, the proposals and the close.

What you will do

  • Turn qualified target accounts into meetings, pipeline and closed deals across your European territory.

  • Open doors through direct outreach and your own network of ERP consultants, partners and IT decision-makers.

  • Run full sales cycles - qualification, demo coordination, proposal, negotiation, close - in close collaboration with the rest of the commercial team.

  • Work with our partner ecosystem around Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i and other ERP platforms as a second route to market.

  • Feed what you learn in the market back into how we position and price.

Who you are

  • Driven. You show up every day ready to do your best, and you keep that standard through long sales cycles.

  • Connected in the ERP ecosystem. Ecosystem knowledge is essential in this role: you know at least one major ERP ecosystem in real depth - the partners and implementation consultants in it, how they influence a deal and when to bring them in - and you bring a working network you can call on from day one.

  • Self-starting. You plan your own work, execute without being chased, and deliver.

  • Accountable. You own your number and you follow up - customers can trust that you are always a step ahead.

  • At home in the ERP world. You have sold software or services into environments running Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i or comparable ERP platforms, and you speak the language of IT managers and operations directors.

  • AI-forward. You already use AI in your daily sales work - research, preparation, follow-up - and want a company that works the same way.

  • A closer. You have proven you can turn outreach into pipeline and pipeline into signed deals - not just manage inbound.

  • Languages: fluent English is required. German, Danish or Dutch on top is a strong advantage - ideally you cover one of our core markets natively.

What we offer

  • A place in a solid company: profitable, in strong growth, and with a large market still ahead of us.

  • A product that is easy to stand behind: more than 4,500 installations worldwide, and customers who stay.

  • A defined category - Output Management - where we compete on depth, not noise.

  • Short decision paths and direct access to management.

  • An AI-driven account-based marketing engine that shows you which companies are in the market - so your time goes to conversations, not list-building.

  • A competitive package that rewards what you close.

About Interform A/S

Interform has built Output Management software since 1987 from our headquarters in Birkerød, Denmark. Our platform, InterformNG2, works with any ERP, any format and any environment - customers change or upgrade their ERP and keep their output running. Our first customer from 1987 is still with us today. Our customer base is international - companies across the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux, the UK and further afield - and our own team works across borders in the same way, with colleagues based in Denmark and Germany. We are a profitable, solidly run company in strong growth, and investment backing supports continued development of the platform.

Practical details

  • Location: our office in Birkerød, Denmark, or remote from anywhere in our European markets - we already have employees working outside Denmark, so a distributed setup is nothing new to us.

  • Travel: limited. Most sales work runs remotely, with occasional customer, partner and event travel.

  • Reports to: our Chief Commercial Officer - you will work alongside the rest of the commercial team.

  • Start: as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter, including the deals you are most proud of.

Birkerød I Remote

jobs.title: Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about Embedded Linux and eager to make a real impact across industries? Join Prevas as an Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant, helping our clients navigate technology transitions, ensure product security, and build new embedded solutions for a safer, smarter world. Whether you come from a consultancy background or have experience as a technical leader in product development, this could be your next step.

About the Role: Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

As part of our team, you will collaborate with a wide variety of organizations – from global enterprises to innovative startups. Your main focus will be on embedded Linux development, secure firmware, and technical consulting. You will play an essential role in supporting our clients as they develop, update, and secure their embedded systems, particularly in response to evolving security standards and regulations.

Key Responsibilities in Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

  • Design, develop, and optimize embedded Linux software for various hardware platforms.

  • Work closely with our skilled engineers and customers.

Desirable: Additional Responsibilities

  • Collaborate on hardware root-of-trust, secure boot, and chain-of-trust implementations.

  • Assist in system hardening, configuration for security, encryption, and access control mechanisms and embedded patch management.

What We’re Looking For: Skills & Experience in Embedded Linux.

  • Background in software development and embedded systems, specifically with Linux.

  • Ability to work with Linux both in user and kernel space.

  • Experience working with Yocto

  • Structured, analytical, and reliable approach to problem solving.

  • Excellent English communication and writing skills, able to convey technical detail concisely and clearly.

Desirable: Additional Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience in cybersecurity, software lifecycle management, or security architecture (from any industry – embedded, medical, IT, defense, etc.).

  • Experience working with security standards – e.g. IEC 62443-4-1/2, IEC 81001-5-1, ETSI EN 303 645, EN 18031, ISO 27001.

  • Hands-on experience with secure software development technologies such as secure bootloaders, encrypted data storage, threat modelling (e.g. STRIDE), and system authentication methods.

Why Join Prevas? Career Growth in Embedded Linux & Consulting

  • Be part of a dynamic team where you work closely with experts who value problem solving, personal growth, and technical passion.

  • Opportunities to influence product security strategies in real-world projects.

  • Work with a great mix of industries and customers – from large corporations to dynamic startups.

  • Create lasting impact in both products and organizations through your consulting work.

About Prevas: Engineering Excellence in Embedded Linux & Electronics

At Prevas, embedded technology is at our core. Over the last 40 years, we have completed more than 5,000 development projects across software and electronics. We see development as a natural part of life – from idea to product, and from career to personal growth. Our open, inclusive atmosphere provides you with the space to be yourself and develop your ideas, while working across disciplines with dedicated colleagues.

If you share our passion for problem-solving, teamwork, and learning, and you want to help shape the future of embedded systems and secure IoT solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Contact Us

For more information or an informal conversation about the role, please contact VP Technology Peter Aagaard Kristensen at +45 51 54 33 66. You can also find out more about us on our website and LinkedIn page.

We look forward to welcoming you to Prevas – where every day is a chance to build something great together.

jobs.title: Head of Regulatory Reporting - (CDI) (m/f)
jobs.employer: Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services & Banking (Luxembourg) S.A.
jobs.description:
Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services and Banking (Luxembourg) S.A. (MIBL) is a Bank incorporated in Luxembourg and is fully owned by Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation, member of   the    Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, one of the largest financial groups worldwide.

MIBL provides a wide range of financial services to institutional investors including depositary, custody, fund administration, and other banking-related services.

MIBL now has an opening in its Finance Department for a:

Head of Regulatory Reporting - (CDI)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   (Ref: MIBLHRR_092026)

Responsibilities:

• Coordinate and manage all activities relating to the Regulatory Reporting function.
• Ensure the timely, accurate and complete preparation, review, and submission of all regulatory reports.
• Oversee the regulatory reporting calendar and ensure compliance with regulatory deadlines.
• Maintain appropriate governance, controls, reconciliations, validations, and escalation processes for regulatory reporting activities.
• Provide advice, management information and escalation on regulatory reporting matters, risks, and issues to the Head of Finance and General Management.
• Act as the primary contact for regulatory reporting matters with internal and external stakeholders.
• Manage FINREP reporting requirements for the CSSF and CBI.
• Manage prudential reporting under the applicable CRR framework, including COREP, LAREX, LCR, NSFR and other regulatory returns.
• Manage statistical reporting requirements to the Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL).
• Coordinate regulatory surveys, information requests and ad hoc reporting required by competent authorities.
• Participate in regulatory, system and Bank-wide projects impacting regulatory reporting requirements (OneSumX migration, IFRS 18 implementation, etc.).
• Coordinate testing, validation and implementation of new reporting requirements, system upgrades, and reporting solutions.
• Provide regulatory reporting expertise for system migrations, data mapping, testing, reconciliation, and validation activities
• Investigate and resolve reporting, calculation, and data quality issues with relevant stakeholders.
• Participate in the production of Regulatory reports.
• Assist the Head of Finance Department during the statutory audit of the Bank, by providing external auditors with the necessary supporting documents.
• Establish and maintain robust controls over reporting data, interfaces, and regulatory submissions.
• Coordinate corrective actions, report resubmissions and related regulatory communications where required.
• Maintain appropriate documentation, audit trails, policies, procedures and working instructions.
• Supervise and manage Regulatory Reporting staff.
• Conduct performance reviews and allocate responsibilities within the team.
• Ensure appropriate segregation of duties, knowledge transfer, and business continuity.
• Promote staff motivation, training, and professional development.

Qualifications:

• Master's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

Required Skills:

• Minimum 5 years of experience in banking regulatory reporting.
• Strong knowledge of FINREP, COREP, CRR/CRD, Basel, IFRS and EBA requirements.
• Good knowledge of CSSF, BCL and CBI reporting frameworks.
• Experience with regulatory reporting systems, preferably OneSumX/RRH.
• Experience in regulatory change, system implementation, and transformation projects.
• Advanced Excel skills.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
• People management and stakeholder management experience.
• Ability to work independently under tight deadlines.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to reporting accuracy.
• Fluent English, written and spoken. French is an advantage.

Preferred Skills

• French is an advantage.

Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services & Banking (Luxembourg) S.A.
Attention: Human Resources Department
287, Route d'Arlon
L – 1150 Luxembourg

jobs.title: Director Payment Integrity
jobs.description:
Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes
  • Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements
  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff
  • Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA
  • Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities
  • Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights
  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others
  • Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs
  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers
  • Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items
  • Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines
  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Platform
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role: 

We are seeking talented distributed systems engineers who are passionate about building innovative solutions for application deployment. Your mission will be to enhance the capabilities of Replit Infrastructure, optimize performance across global regions, and drive efficiency while delivering an exceptional user experience. If you have a strong foundation in software development, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a track record of delivering high-quality code, we want to hear from you. 



In this role you will:

 - Expand Replit's cloud infrastructure offerings: Launch new cloud products to be used by Replit Agent to build complex apps. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement these features, empowering developers with a comprehensive suite of tools to build and deploy their applications efficiently.

 - Enhance reliability and scalability: Identify bottlenecks, optimize critical paths, and implement robust monitoring and alerting systems. Work closely with the SRE team to ensure high availability and minimal downtime. Enable our customers to seamlessly scale their applications to meet the demands of their growing user base.

 - Improve utilization of cloud infrastructure: Analyze our infrastructure costs and identify opportunities for optimization. Implement strategies to reduce cloud expenses without compromising performance or reliability. This could involve techniques such as resource provisioning, auto-scaling, cost-aware scheduling, and data lifecycle management. Your efforts will directly contribute to the financial efficiency of our cloud services.



Required skills and experience:

 - Distributed systems: Track record of working with platform-as-a-service, distributed storage, or information retrieval systems. Experience in designing scalable architectures and optimizing systems for latency or cost. 

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex challenges pragmatically and devise effective solutions. You think radically but ship incrementally.

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Able to work independently, set priorities, and drive projects forward. You take ownership and initiative.

 - Versatility and flexibility: Able to wear multiple hats and tackle a wide range of challenges. You are comfortable working across different layers of the stack and adapting to the needs of the project.

 - Continuous learning and adaptability: Passionate about staying up-to-date with industry trends and expanding your skill set. You embrace change and adapt quickly.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit enables people to build software with AI. The systems underneath that experience must support safe production changes, measurable reliability, and predictable performance as usage grows.

This Engineering Manager will lead SRE across observability, incident management, load testing, performance engineering, cloud cost and capacity, and rollout infrastructure. You'll lead and grow an existing team that builds and operates production platforms and works hands-on across application and infrastructure boundaries.

This is a software-building leadership role, not simply an incident-management function. You'll help teams ship safely, understand production behavior, and remove performance bottlenecks through concrete engineering improvements. You should be comfortable going deep on a rollout failure or performance investigation while developing technical leaders and sustainable ownership across a distributed team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Observability. Build and operate metrics, logs, traces, and alerting capabilities. Help teams establish meaningful SLOs and use production telemetry to diagnose problems and verify improvements.

 - Incident Management. Own incident tooling and practices, coordinate cross-team response, and turn incident reviews into engineering improvements that reduce recovery time and repeat failures.

 - Load Testing. Build and maintain load/failure testing capabilities. Validate critical paths under expected demand, quantify headroom, and test recovery and production readiness with service owners.

 - Performance Engineering. Lead deep engagements with internal teams on SLOs and end-to-end performance. Use profiling, telemetry, and load tests to identify bottlenecks and deliver improvements with service owners—not just recommendations.

 - Stay technically engaged. Review designs and production changes, debug difficult failure modes, and use AI coding tools—including Replit—to prototype and automate. Apply rigorous review and verification to AI-generated changes.

 - Build and grow a high-ownership engineering team. Coach engineers, develop technical leaders, manage performance, and hire against agreed needs. Make distributed collaboration, mentoring, and backup coverage deliberate rather than relying on a few permanent escalation points.

 - Measure outcomes and close the loop. Track rollout safety, recovery time, repeat incidents, critical-path latency/throughput, test coverage, and improvements arising from cost/capacity analysis. Agree success measures and continuing ownership with partner teams.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Demonstrated engineering management. You have led and developed engineers, made prioritization and performance decisions, hired thoughtfully, and delivered through a team—not only acted as its strongest individual contributor.

 - Software-oriented production systems depth. You have built and operated distributed systems or reliability platforms and can reason across deployment behavior, Kubernetes, telemetry, service dependencies, and recovery mechanisms.

 - Safe-change and performance judgment. You have led consequential migrations or incidents and used measurement to diagnose reliability or performance problems. You can distinguish symptoms from causes and validate fixes under realistic conditions.

 - Platform-product and cross-team judgment. You can build capabilities other teams adopt, lead hands-on engagements without absorbing every service's operations, and make clear tradeoffs among reliability, performance, engineering effort, and cost.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with GitOps or progressive-delivery platforms such as Harness, ArgoCD, or Kargo.

 - Experience with observability, profiling, load-testing, and failure-testing systems, including OpenTelemetry or comparable tooling.

 - Experience with cloud cost attribution, capacity planning, and provider coordination, particularly on GCP.

 - Experience growing distributed teams and using AI tools to increase engineering output while preserving production safeguards.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Ads
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

Help turn “I built a business” into “I have customers.” As a Staff Software Engineer on Replit’s Money team, you’ll help shape Agentic Ads: an emerging area focused on using AI to make customer acquisition more accessible to businesses built on Replit.

 

This role focuses on intelligent, advertiser-facing software—not ad-serving infrastructure, an ad exchange, or a real-time bidding engine. You’ll tackle problems at the intersection of AI, business growth, measurement, and trustworthy automation, turning complex decisions into clear, useful experiences.

 

You’ll help define a new product area, working closely with product, design, and engineering to discover customer needs and deliver practical solutions. This is a hands-on Staff role: you’ll own architecture, lead delivery across teams, mentor engineers, and turn an ambitious vision into incremental customer value.




YOU WILL:

 - Set technical direction for Agentic Ads, translating customer needs into an architecture and roadmap that balance rapid learning with long-term reliability.

 - Build agent-powered experiences that help businesses make informed growth decisions, translating user goals into understandable recommendations and appropriately authorized actions.

 - Design extensible integrations with external services, using well-defined APIs and abstractions that accommodate changing provider capabilities and requirements.

 - Partner with product and data teams to establish reliable measurement, connect product activity to business outcomes, and address data quality, delayed feedback, and uncertainty.

 - Develop intelligent automation that learns from performance signals and helps users improve outcomes within their goals and constraints.

 - Make financial control a product requirement: scoped authorization, explicit approvals, budget limits, auditable decisions, clear reporting, and reliable pause controls. Distinguish recommendations from actions that commit customer spend.

 - Make cross-platform workflows reliable with durable state, idempotency, safe retries, reconciliation, observability, and recovery from partial failures, expired credentials, rate limits, and provider API changes.

 - Establish agent evaluations and production monitoring for plan quality, tool selection, policy compliance, spend safety, and verified execution. Partner on experiments that distinguish attributed results from incremental customer value.

 - Lead ambiguous initiatives across product, design, AI, data, security, and partnerships. Stay hands-on with implementation, define incremental milestones, mentor engineers, and own the quality and operation of what the team ships.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - A track record of Staff-level technical leadership on complex customer-facing products or platforms: setting direction, resolving ambiguity, and delivering through launch and production operation across multiple teams.

 - Strong hands-on software engineering and system design skills across APIs, data modeling, distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, and customer-facing product experiences.

 - Experience building and operating third-party integrations that remain correct under duplicate requests, partial failures, rate limits, changing schemas, and inconsistent external state.

 - Practical experience shipping LLM-powered products or agentic workflows, including tool use, orchestration, evaluations, and safeguards for actions taken against external systems.

 - Strong data and measurement judgment: experience using instrumentation and experiments to evaluate product outcomes, and the ability to reason about noisy data, delayed feedback, uncertainty, and correlation versus causation.

 - Sound judgment around systems that act on a user’s behalf, including authentication, authorization, sensitive data, approval boundaries, and limits on consequential actions.

 - Demonstrated ability to align cross-functional teams, explain technical trade-offs, mentor engineers, and drive execution without relying on reporting authority.

 - A product-minded approach to simplifying complex workflows for non-experts, with hands-on ownership from prototype through reliable production operation.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building advertiser-facing products, marketing automation, campaign-management tools, growth platforms, or software that helps businesses acquire customers.

 - Experience integrating advertising or marketing APIs; familiarity with account onboarding, campaign lifecycles, and platform requirements.

 - Working knowledge of conversion tracking, attribution, customer acquisition cost, return on ad spend, budget pacing, and the limits of optimizing with low conversion volume.

 - Experience with experimentation, incrementality measurement, constrained optimization, recommendation systems, or decision-making under uncertainty.

 - Experience building permissioned, multi-tenant products with approval workflows, budget controls, audit trails, and privacy-aware handling of customer and conversion data.

 


BONUS POINTS: 

 - Experience with agent tooling, durable workflow execution, delegated authorization, or evaluation frameworks for agents that take consequential actions.

 - Experience connecting application events or server-side conversion signals to advertising platforms, or integrating creative generation and landing-page experimentation into growth workflows.

 - Experience building for small businesses or first-time advertisers, where clear guidance, limited budgets, and sparse data shape the product.

 - These are additional strengths, not a checklist. Experience with every ad platform is not expected; ad-serving infrastructure experience and an ML research background are not prerequisites.




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Customer outcomes: success means helping a business acquire qualified leads and customers—not merely connecting an account, launching a campaign, or increasing spend.

 - User control and trust: agents explain recommendations, act within explicit authority, and make budgets, costs, and consequential changes understandable.

 - Evidence over activity: we validate measurement, acknowledge uncertainty, and test whether a change improves business outcomes rather than treating attribution as proof of causality.

 - End-to-end ownership: we own the journey from a business goal through campaign execution, measurement, and ongoing improvement.

 - Pragmatic technical leadership: we build on existing ad platforms, ship focused increments, and invest in correctness and extensibility where they matter.

 - Clear collaboration: we document decisions, surface risks early, and help other teams and partners succeed.

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.

- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect (Customer Success)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.

 

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR

 - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers

 - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact

 - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts

 - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working

 - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Additional languages

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. jobs.title: Operations Manager- Zoku Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Looking for an Operations Manager role where you can genuinely make your mark? As a key member of our leadership team, you'll balance strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, empowering teams, improving the guest experience, and driving operational excellence across the house.

What makes this role unique? Your impact. At Zoku, decisions are made close to the operation, ideas are welcomed, and leaders are trusted to take ownership. As a growing company, you'll have the opportunity to shape how we work, develop your leadership skills, and influence decisions that directly impact both the business and the people around you.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of business hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

As our Operations Manager, you'll be responsible for the smooth running of Zoku Copenhagen's day-to-day operations while safeguarding the unique Zoku guest experience. You'll lead our Front of House operation, including Front Office, F&B Services and Co-working, ensuring every guest interaction reflects the warm and welcoming atmosphere we're known for.

Forget everything you know about a traditional hotel reception. At Zoku, you'll oversee our vibrant social spaces, including the Kindred Spirits bar, Living Kitchen restaurant, co-working areas, and rooftop terrace. Together with your teams, you'll create memorable experiences for our guests while continuously looking for opportunities to improve operational excellence.

Beyond Front of House, you'll act as a key connector across the business. Working closely with our Maintenance, Housekeeping, People & Culture, Kitchen, Meeting & Events and Support Office teams, you'll ensure seamless collaboration and help keep all moving parts aligned.

Of course, you won't be doing this alone. You'll lead and develop a team of Duty Managers and Sidekicks, providing coaching, support and guidance while helping them grow both professionally and personally.

As a valued member of the Management Team, you'll work closely with and report directly to the General Manager. Together, you'll drive performance, lead operational improvements and ensure Zoku Copenhagen continues to be a place where both guests and colleagues feel at home.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?
No day looks the same as an Operations Manager… but here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Operational coach: Guide, train and manage our operational team, including organizing regular check-ins and quarterly goal setting.
